items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出残差学习框架，将网络层显式改写为以该层输入为参照的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数，从而降低极深网络的训练难度。大量实验表明，残差网络更易优化，并能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 上，深达 152 层的残差网络比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低，其集成模型在测试集上取得 3.57% 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名；我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。仅凭极深的表征，COCO 目标检测即获得 28% 的相对提升。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让 152 层网络易训练并夺得 ImageNet 冠军
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：网络越深，表达力越强；但简单堆叠层数会出现“退化”：训练误差反而上升，优化困难。
• 方法：作者提出残差学习，让模块学习输入与输出之间的差值 F(x)，再用跳跃连接把输入 x 加回输出，即让网络拟合 F(x)+x。这样网络只需学“相对输入的改动”，恒等映射变得容易，梯度也能沿捷径直接回传。
• 结果：在 ImageNet 上训练 152 层残差网络，深度是 VGG 的 8 倍而计算量更低；多模型集成在测试集上错误率 3.57%，夺得 ILSVRC 2015 分类第一。CIFAR-10 上验证 100 层乃至 1000 层网络仍可训练并获益。仅靠更深特征，COCO 目标检测相对提升 28%。
• 为何重要：残差连接解开了深层网络的训练死结，使“很深”真正可用，此后成为视觉乃至众多领域深度网络的默认结构组件。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上认识其功能。经巨大的实验努力，约 10 万种独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只占已知数十亿条蛋白质序列的极小部分，瓶颈在于测定单个结构往往需数月到数年。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质三维结构——“蛋白质折叠问题”的结构预测部分——五十多年来一直是重要的开放难题。现有方法远未达到原子级精度，尤其在没有同源结构时。我们提出首个能在无相似结构可用时也常以原子精度预测结构的计算方法：完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold 在 CASP14 评估中多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法，其关键在于把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物知识（多序列比对）融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: AlphaFold 首次在无同源结构时达到接近原子级精度
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：蛋白质功能由三维结构决定，但实验测定（X 射线晶体学、冷冻电镜等）一个结构常需数月到数年；已知序列有数十亿条，已解结构仅约十万个，缺口巨大。仅凭序列预测结构已悬置五十余年。
• 方法：AlphaFold 用深度神经网络直接从氨基酸序列预测原子的三维坐标，把多序列比对（同源序列中的进化共变信息）以及关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物先验嵌入算法设计与训练之中，模型经过彻底重新设计。
• 结果：在 CASP14 盲测中，多数目标上的预测精度与实验结构相当，大幅超越其他参赛方法，尤其是在没有已知相似结构可用时首次达到接近原子级精度。
• 为何重要：这使大规模结构生物信息学成为可能，把“结构决定功能”的分析从少数已解结构推广到蛋白质组尺度，对基础生物学与药物设计影响深远。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：经深度学习设计的一组无源衍射层协同工作，可学会实现各种功能。我们在太赫兹波段用 3D 打印的 D2NN 实验演示了该框架，使其学会手写数字分类并实现成像透镜的功能。借助现有丰富的 3D 打印、光刻与空间光调制器手段，该全光深度学习框架能以光速完成计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中得到应用，还能催生可学习执行独特任务的新型相机与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用 3D 打印衍射层让光以光速完成神经网络推理
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：常规神经网络依赖电子计算，能耗与时延受限；能否让光本身“计算”，用无源光学元件完成分类等任务？
• 方法：把多层衍射面（每层具有可设计的相位与振幅图案）当作网络的一层层“权重”，光在各层之间的自由空间传播相当于层间连接。先用计算机按深度学习（误差反传）训练这些层的参数，再用 3D 打印制造实体器件，在太赫兹波段搭建 D2NN。
• 结果：实验中，3D 打印的 D2NN 实现了手写数字分类，并实现了一个成像透镜的功能，验证了“训练—加工—推理”的可行路径。
• 为何重要：推理以光速、近乎无源地完成，适合全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，还可能催生能“学习”执行特定任务的新型相机与光学元件；随着 3D 打印、光刻与空间光调制器成熟，其扩展性可观。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，它被数据科学家广泛用于在众多机器学习挑战中取得当前最优结果。我们提出面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图；更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些设计，XGBoost 在资源远少于现有系统的情况下，可扩展到数十亿样本以上。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知算法与系统优化让树提升扩展到十亿级样本
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：梯度提升树精度高、用途广，但面对超大规模数据与稀疏特征时，现有系统在速度、内存与可扩展性上受限。
• 方法：XGBoost 作为端到端系统，提出稀疏感知的分裂查找算法（为缺失值自动学习默认分支方向，只处理非缺失部分），用加权分位数草图在近似学习中高效寻找分裂点；并借助列块存储、缓存友好的访问模式、数据压缩与分片等工程手段，支持分布式与核外计算。
• 结果：综合这些设计，系统在资源远少于同类的情况下可扩展到数十亿样本，成为当时众多机器学习竞赛获胜方案的基础。
• 为何重要：它把统计上表现优异的模型与工程上可扩展的实现结合起来，成为表格数据建模的事实标准之一，也启发了后续梯度提升系统的设计思路。

items.title_en: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.title_zh: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏智能体的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 Gamer，一个为复杂交互环境中的长时程任务构建的通用智能体框架。其端到端架构结合了感知、记忆管理以及多步推理。共享的训练与部署流水线支持与传统的 2D 图形界面和复杂的 3D 模拟世界进行交互。我们首先在由数万小时的设备级键盘和鼠标交互构建的数据集上进行继续预训练。这些轨迹跨越模拟游戏和具身环境，使模型能够学习跨物理和虚拟领域的环境动力学。随后，稀疏思考指令调优大幅减少冗余计算，同时保留复杂决策所需的推理。我们使用一种稳定的多轮强化学习方法训练策略以进行长时程交互，该方法解决了有限上下文窗口、累积的 rollout 误差和稀疏奖励问题。对于实时交互，一个云-边推理引擎同时服务众多模拟游戏环境，支持无界上下文执行，并保持较低的在线推理延迟。在多个具有挑战性的 3D 开放世界游戏中，Gamer 展现出与熟练玩家相当的稳健泛化和运行效率。它在一系列传统 2D 游戏基准上也取得了有竞争力的结果。这些结果表明，即使是重复性的键盘和鼠标轨迹，也能通过扩展数据和学习算法带来显著收益。在这些轨迹上训练有助于 Gamer 在同时具有物理和数字属性的环境中更稳定地学习复杂技能。这种方法为能够在数字世界和物理世界之间交互的通用智能体提供了一条路径。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：一个用于视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的精确开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能够使用针孔和鱼眼镜头模型，以单目、双目和 RGB-D 相机执行视觉、视觉惯性和多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个主要创新是基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM 系统，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计。其结果是系统能够在小型和大型、室内和室外环境中实时稳健运行，并且比先前方法精确 2 到 5 倍。第二个主要创新是一个多地图系统，它依赖一种新的、具有更高召回率的地点识别方法。得益于此，ORB-SLAM3 能够在长时间视觉信息较差的情况下存活：当它丢失时，会启动一个新地图，并在重访已建图区域时与先前地图无缝合并。与仅使用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计系统相比，ORB-SLAM3 是首个能够在所有算法阶段复用所有先前信息的系统。这允许将共视关键帧纳入光束法平差，即使它们在时间上相隔很远或来自先前的建图会话，这些关键帧也能提供高视差观测，从而提升精度。我们的实验表明，在所有传感器配置下，ORB-SLAM3 与文献中可用的最佳系统一样稳健，并且显著更精确。值得注意的是，我们的双目惯性 SLAM 在 EuRoC 无人机上达到平均 3.6 cm 的精度，在 TUM-VI 数据集房间内的快速手持运动下达到 9 mm，该设置代表了 AR/VR 场景。为造福社区，我们公开了源代码。

items.title_en: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
items.title_zh: DySENSE：利用卫星影像的动态时空能量合成与仿真
items.abstract_en: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies have made progress, they are limited by data and methodological gaps. Existing studies are largely predictive for existing cities rather than generative for future cities; fine-grained, aligned monthly dynamic energy data are scarce; and existing GenAI models struggle to generate dynamic urban functional monthly energy. We present DySENSE, a joint multimodal GenAI framework that synthesizes static urban satellite imagery together with spatially aligned, dynamic monthly building energy consumption maps. We decouple long-term static urban morphology from short-term dynamic energy consumption. By conditioning on static urban land use, DySENSE can generate realistic, diverse and new static urban imagery with aligned energy maps. By conditioning on dynamic monthly and climate prompts, DySENSE can jointly generate dynamic, monthly energy consumption maps while keeping the urban morphology static. Experiments across four cities (New York, Washington, Norfolk, Busan) demonstrated that DySENSE can generate annotated high-fidelity synthetic energy data using less than 25% labelled data, boosting downstream prediction performance by 8% mIoU, and achieving strong energy dynamic consistency. Compared to existing methods, DySENSE significantly improved prediction performance (8.7% accuracy) and reduced prediction error (9%-18% CVRMSE, ASHRAE). DySENSE offers an effective foundation for energy-efficient cities, peak-load analysis, building performance simulation and dynamic demand response for city, energy, and building science. The data and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE2 and https://github.com/kailaisun/DySENSE
items.abstract_zh: 城市占全球能源的三分之二以上，并占全球二氧化碳排放的70%以上。城市能源对实现2050年净零目标和联合国可持续发展目标7与11至关重要。尽管现有研究已取得进展，但仍受数据和方法缺口的限制。现有研究大多是对现有城市的预测，而非对未来城市的生成；细粒度、空间对齐的月度动态能源数据稀缺；现有GenAI模型难以生成动态的城市功能月度能源。我们提出DySENSE，一个联合多模态GenAI框架，可将静态城市卫星影像与空间对齐的动态月度建筑能耗图进行合成。我们将长期静态城市形态与短期动态能耗解耦。以静态城市土地利用为条件，DySENSE可生成真实、多样且新的静态城市影像及对齐的能源图。以动态月度和气候提示为条件，DySENSE可联合生成动态月度能耗图，同时保持城市形态静态。在四个城市（纽约、华盛顿、诺福克、釜山）的实验表明，DySENSE可利用少于25%的标注数据生成带标注的高保真合成能源数据，将下游预测性能提升8% mIoU，并实现强能量动态一致性。与现有方法相比，DySENSE显著提升预测性能（8.7%准确率）并降低预测误差（9%-18% CVRMSE，ASHRAE）。DySENSE为城市、能源和建筑科学中的节能城市、峰值负荷分析、建筑性能仿真和动态需求响应提供了有效基础。数据与代码：https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE2 和 https://github.com/kailaisun/DySENSE

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Learning gene co-regulation across cells with Multicellular Transformer
items.title_zh: 利用Multicellular Transformer学习跨细胞基因共调控
items.abstract_en: Understanding how genes coordinate across cells is central to explaining tissue function and disease, yet most existing models still take a single cell as input and therefore emphasize cell-intrinsic regulation. We present the Multicellular Transformer (MCT), a foundation model built around a different assumption: cells function together within tissues, so the appropriate unit of input is not one cell in isolation but a set of cells from the same sample. By jointly modeling multiple cells, MCT learns context-aware gene embeddings that capture gene-gene interactions across the tissue environment. Trained on a large set of tissue samples (>4200) across more than 30 tissue types, MCT recovers ligand-receptor interactions, infers cross-cell signaling programs, and reveals spatial co-localization patterns directly from scRNA-seq data. Its contextual embeddings identify disease-specific rewiring of gene neighborhoods in systemic lupus erythematosus and COVID-19 and predict population-level perturbation effects in cancer without additional training. By linking gene-level regulation to tissue-scale organization, MCT provides a scalable framework for modeling multicellular biology and enables in silico discovery of therapeutic targets and tissue-specific dependencies.
items.abstract_zh: 理解基因如何在细胞间协调是解释组织功能和疾病的核心，但大多数现有模型仍以单个细胞为输入，因而强调细胞内在调控。我们提出Multicellular Transformer（MCT），这是一个基础模型，围绕不同的假设构建：细胞在组织内共同发挥功能，因此合适的输入单元不是孤立的单个细胞，而是来自同一样本的一组细胞。通过联合建模多个细胞，MCT学习捕捉组织环境中基因-基因相互作用的上下文感知基因嵌入。在超过30种组织类型的4200多个组织样本上训练后，MCT可恢复配体-受体相互作用，推断跨细胞信号程序，并直接从scRNA-seq数据揭示空间共定位模式。其上下文嵌入可识别系统性红斑狼疮和COVID-19中疾病特异性的基因邻域重连，并在无需额外训练的情况下预测癌症中群体水平的扰动效应。通过将基因水平调控与组织尺度组织化联系起来，MCT为建模多细胞生物学提供了可扩展框架，并支持治疗靶点和组织特异性依赖的计算发现。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Symmerty-Engineered Moire Metasurface for Multibeam Control
items.title_zh: 对称性工程化莫尔超表面实现多波束调控
items.abstract_en: Moiré metasurfaces offer a versatile platform for wavefront engineering through the relative rotation of periodic structures. Despite extensive demonstrations of continuous beam steering, the physical mechanisms governing beam multiplicity remain poorly understood, hindering the systematic design of multibeam radiation states. Here, we establish a predictive framework for engineering beam multiplicity in reflective moiré metasurfaces based on the dominant Fourier coefficients of their constituent patterns. We reveal that the rotational symmetry of these Fourier components in reciprocal space fully determines the symmetry of the resulting moiré unit cell and, consequently, its radiation characteristics. By further incorporating their phase information, both beam multiplicity and steering trajectories can be accurately predicted. We demonstrate this approach using reflective moiré metasurfaces constructed from patterns with p6m, p3m1, and p4m plane-group symmetries, achieving one-, two-, three-, four-, and six-beam radiation states with continuously tunable steering trajectories. Beyond symmetry-based design, we identify two additional degrees of freedom for beam multiplicity control. Selecting different rotation centers reshapes the phase distributions of the dominant Fourier coefficients, enabling further manipulation of beam multiplicity and spatial arrangement, while varying the relative twist angle alters the pairing of Fourier components, inducing transitions between distinct beam multiplicities. These findings establish a systematic framework for versatile and reconfigurable multibeam wavefront engineering.
items.abstract_zh: 莫尔超表面通过周期结构的相对旋转为波前工程提供了灵活平台。尽管连续波束偏转已被大量演示，但决定波束数目的物理机制仍不清楚，阻碍了多波束辐射态的系统化设计。本文基于构成图案的主导傅里叶系数，建立了反射式莫尔超表面波束数目的可预测设计框架。我们揭示：这些傅里叶分量在倒空间中的旋转对称性完全决定了莫尔单胞的对称性，进而决定其辐射特性；进一步引入相位信息后，波束数目与偏转轨迹均可被准确预测。我们以具有 p6m、p3m1 和 p4m 平面群对称性的图案构建反射式莫尔超表面进行验证，实现了一、二、三、四、六波束辐射态，且偏转轨迹连续可调。除对称性设计外，我们还发现两个额外自由度：选择不同旋转中心可重塑主导傅里叶系数的相位分布，从而进一步操控波束数目与空间排布；改变相对扭转角则会改变傅里叶分量的配对关系，诱导不同波束数目之间的转换。这些结果建立了通用、可重构多波束波前工程的系统框架。
items.highlight_zh: 用傅里叶分量对称性预测莫尔超表面的波束数目与轨迹
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：莫尔超表面由两层周期图案相对旋转叠加而成，能连续偏转波束，但「为什么会出现多个波束、出现几个」缺乏理论解释，设计多波束器件只能靠试错。

方法：作者把每个构成图案分解为傅里叶级数，只看其中最强的几个「主导傅里叶分量」。他们发现，这些分量在倒空间（描述空间频率的数学空间）里的旋转对称性，直接决定了叠加后莫尔单胞的对称性，也就决定了最终能辐射出几束光；再把分量的相位信息纳入，还能算出每束光的偏转轨迹。作者用具有 p6m、p3m1、p4m 三种平面群对称性的图案制作反射式超表面做验证。

结果：成功得到一、二、三、四、六波束的辐射态，偏转轨迹可连续调节。此外还找到两个额外调控旋钮：换一个旋转中心会改变主导傅里叶分量的相位分布，从而改变波束数目与空间排布；改变两层之间的扭转角会改变傅里叶分量的配对方式，使波束数目发生跳变。

为何重要：这把原本靠经验的莫尔超表面多波束设计，变成了可以「先算后做」的预测性设计流程，对需要多目标、可重构波束的通信、雷达与成像应用有直接价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: 面向递归自我改进的经验交接强化学习
items.abstract_en: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g., a playbook) is itself not learned. We want the best of both worlds: gradient updates from a scalar reward, while also utilizing environment information to hand off experience. As a concrete testbed, we fix the Agentic Context Engineering (\ace{}) harness and train one model to act, reflect, and curate task-local playbooks. Our method, \acerl{}, evaluates candidate experience-handoff artifacts by their downstream effect on future actor rollouts, and co-optimizes the role-specific behaviors (action generator, insight reflector, and playbook curator) under a fixed scaffold. Across agentic benchmarks, \acerl{} achieves higher held-out performance than baseline methods. The results suggest that agent training should optimize not only the actions in the current rollout, but also the model-written experience that future rollouts inherit.
items.abstract_zh: 用标量奖励对大型语言模型（LLM）做智能体任务的强化学习十分常见，但这种方式丢掉了智能体在试错过程中获得的细粒度环境信息（如错误日志）。为利用这些丰富信息，近期工作把智能体包在「挽具」中，通过反思或压缩来精炼自身输入，并把过往经验交接给后续 rollout，但这些交接产物（如攻略手册）的构建过程本身并未被学习。我们希望兼顾两者：既从标量奖励获得梯度更新，又利用环境信息完成经验交接。作为一个具体试验台，我们固定 Agentic Context Engineering（ACE）挽具，训练单个模型同时承担行动、反思与任务本地攻略手册的整理。我们的方法 ACERL 以下游未来 actor rollout 的效果来评估候选经验交接产物，并在固定脚手架下协同优化各角色行为（动作生成器、洞见反思器与攻略整理器）。在多个智能体基准上，ACERL 的留出性能优于基线方法。结果表明，智能体训练不应只优化当前 rollout 中的动作，还应优化模型所写、会被未来 rollout 继承的经验。
items.highlight_zh: 让模型学会自己写经验手册，供未来回合继承
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：训练语言模型做智能体任务时，通常只给它一个分数（标量奖励）来学习，而智能体在尝试过程中产生的大量有用信息——比如报错日志、哪一步走错了——被直接丢弃。近期有做法让模型「反思」并把经验写进一个攻略手册交给下一轮使用，但手册怎么写、写得好不好，本身是靠人工脚手架固定的，没有被训练优化。

方法：作者固定住 ACE（Agentic Context Engineering）这套脚手架，训练同一个模型扮演三个角色：执行动作的「行动者」、总结教训的「反思者」、整理手册的「策展者」。关键在于评估方式——不再直接判断手册写得好不好，而是看这本手册交给未来的行动回合后，实际带来多少性能提升，用这个下游效果作为训练信号来协同优化三个角色。

结果：在多个智能体基准测试上，该方法在未参与训练的留出集上表现优于基线。

为何重要：它把「智能体训练」的目标从只优化当前这一步动作，扩展到同时优化模型自己写下的、将被未来回合继承的经验。这为语言模型的递归自我改进——即用自己产生的经验让自己越用越强——提供了一条可训练、可评估的路径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

reference_review.reason_zh: 双向语言表示预训练的原始研究与作者代码，适合编码器、微调和语言理解方法的比较。

items.title_zh: BERT：面向语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 旨在通过在所有层中同时联合左右两侧上下文，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层即可微调，无需大量任务特定的结构改动，便能在问答、语言推断等广泛任务上取得当前最优结果。BERT 在概念上简单，在实证上强大：它在十一个自然语言处理任务上刷新最优成绩，包括把 GLUE 分数提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点）、MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6 个百分点）、SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 提升至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5 点）、SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 提升至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1 点）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练 + 单层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：在 BERT 之前，语言表示模型多是单向的——读句子时只能从左往右看，或者把左右两个方向的模型简单拼接。这让模型难以同时利用上下文的两侧信息，而很多语言理解任务恰恰需要「前后兼顾」。

方法：BERT 用 Transformer 的编码器结构，在所有层中同时关注左右两侧上下文，做真正的深度双向预训练。预训练用两个任务：一是「掩码语言模型」，随机遮住句中的一些词让模型猜；二是「下一句预测」，判断两句话是否原本相邻。预训练完成后，只需在顶部加一个小的输出层，在具体任务上微调即可，不必为每个任务重新设计网络结构。

结果：在十一个自然语言处理任务上刷新当时最优成绩。GLUE 基准提升到 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%（提升 4.6 点），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 达到 93.2（提升 1.5 点），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达到 83.1（提升 5.1 点）。

为何重要：这篇论文确立了「大规模无标注预训练 + 下游小改动微调」的范式，概念简单却效果显著，深刻影响了此后几乎所有自然语言处理系统的研发方式，是预训练语言模型时代的奠基工作之一。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接的 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，并有两项关键创新，使其能实现快速、鲁棒且精确的 LiDAR 导航（与建图）。第一项是直接将原始点云配准到地图（并随后更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征。这既可利用环境中的细微特征从而提高精度，也因去除了人工设计的特征提取模块而天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。第二项创新是用增量式 k-d 树数据结构 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持增量更新（点插入、删除）与动态再平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d 树）相比，ikd-Tree 综合性能更优，且天然支持在树上做降采样。我们在来自多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做了详尽基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以远低的计算量稳定取得更高精度。我们还对小视场固态 LiDAR 开展了多项真实场景实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（例如在大型室外环境中可达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图）、鲁棒（例如在杂乱室内环境中旋转高达 1000 度/秒时仍能可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转式与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），同时精度仍高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 免特征提取直接配准，配合增量 k-d 树实现 100 Hz 建图
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人或无人机要知道自己在哪、周围长什么样，常靠 LiDAR 加惯性测量单元（IMU）做里程计与建图。传统流程要从点云里先提取边缘、平面等「特征」再匹配，这一步既耗时，又会丢掉环境中的细微信息；而且换一种扫描方式的 LiDAR，特征提取就得重新设计。地图的数据结构在大场景下也容易成为瓶颈。

方法：FAST-LIO2 用紧耦合的迭代卡尔曼滤波把 LiDAR 与 IMU 数据融合。两个关键改动：一是跳过特征提取，把原始点云直接配准到地图并同步更新地图，既保留细微特征提升精度，也让它适配各种扫描模式的雷达；二是用自研的增量式 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 管理地图，支持点的插入、删除与动态再平衡，并能直接在树上降采样。

结果：在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做基准比较，精度稳定高于现有先进系统，计算量却低得多。真实实验中，大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图；在杂乱室内以高达 1000 度/秒的角速度旋转时仍能可靠估计位姿；可运行于多线旋转式与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器。

为何重要：它把「快、稳、通用、准」四件事同时做到了，且不依赖特定雷达的特征设计，因而对不同硬件和新一代固态 LiDAR 都有很好的适应性，成为该领域被广泛采用的开源基准方案。

items.title_en: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
items.title_zh: 拆解多模态视觉编码：视觉先验、专用容量与融合位置
items.abstract_en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型如何编码视觉输入仍无定论：多数用预训练视觉编码器，也有方案与语言模型联合从零训练甚至完全去掉编码器。编码器实际捆绑了三种设计选择：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量、以及把该容量置于多模态主干之前。由于公开模型在数据、架构与算力上各异，直接比较无法分离各因素。我们将所有模型在相同数据上从零预训练，并在等量生命周期算力下比较视觉问答与语言基准。结果显示视觉先验并非必需，联合从零训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量——无编码器模型即便扩大主干仍落后。但该容量不必位于融合前：在融合中向早期层加入纯视觉模块效果相当，还能降低首字延迟。这些结论支持与主干联合训练、置于主干早期的专用视觉容量。
items.highlight_zh: 视觉先验非必需，专用视觉容量才是关键
items.digest_zh:
【要解决的问题】能看图说话的多模态大模型，通常先用一个专门的视觉编码器把图片变成向量，再交给语言模型。这个编码器到底必要吗？它其实捆绑了三样东西：(1) 上游预训练带来的“视觉先验”；(2) 专门留给视觉的参数量；(3) 把视觉放在多模态融合之前的位置。以往公开模型在数据、结构、算力上都不一样，因此无法判断到底是哪一项在起作用。

【方法】作者把所有模型都放到同一份数据上从零开始训练，并让它们在整个训练生命周期内消耗相同的总算力，然后比较它们在视觉问答和纯语言任务上的表现，把三个因素逐一拆开来检验。

【结果】1) 视觉先验不是必需的：与语言模型一起从零训练的编码器，和预训练编码器打平，还省掉一个独立的训练阶段；2) 真正重要的是“专用视觉容量”——必须给视觉留出参数，把主干按编码器的参数量加大也补不回来；3) 容量不必放在融合之前：在融合过程中往主干靠前的层里插入视觉模块，效果差不多，还能更快吐出第一个 token。

【为何重要】这给多模态模型设计提供了清晰指引：不必执着于预训练视觉编码器，而应保留独立的视觉容量、与主干联合训练并放在早期层，同时也为降低推理延迟提供了可行方案。结论在多种主干规模下、以及把编码器预训练视作“免费”或从预训练语言模型出发时都成立。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Models Reproduce a Human Mental-Extrapolation Bias in the Watanabe Illusion
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型复现渡边错觉中的人类心理外推偏差
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for visual judgments, yet whether they share human perceptual biases, and where in the model such biases arise, is unclear. We addressed this with the Watanabe Illusion, a stimulus not previously studied quantitatively: an oblique segment inside a circle whose extension geometrically hits the topmost of 11 dots, yet human observers (n = 131) reported a dot near the middle of the column. Five VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 7B, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5 Instant, Gemini 3.5 Flash), given the identical stimulus and wording, all deviated in the same direction. In the open-weight Qwen2.5-VL-32B, linear probes on the vision encoder recovered the line angle and the target dot six to eight times more accurately than its behavioral responses. A layer-wise logit lens showed that the correct answer dominates in the middle layers of the language model and is overwritten in late layers only under a visual-judgment frame. Naming the illusion, requesting suppression of prior knowledge, forcing a visual chain of thought, and 390 semantic preambles left the response center unchanged; only disclosing the correct answer moved it. VLMs may therefore carry human perceptual biases at the language-generation stage, where they resist declarative correction.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）日益用于视觉判断，但它们是否具有与人类相同的知觉偏差、偏差位于模型何处仍不清楚。我们借助此前未被定量研究的渡边错觉来探究：圆内一条斜线段的几何延长线恰好经过 11 个点中最上方的一点，但人类被试（n=131）却报告看到接近该列中部的一点。五个 VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-32B 与 7B、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5 Instant、Gemini 3.5 Flash）在相同刺激与措辞下全部朝同一方向偏离。在开源 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 中，对视觉编码器的线性探针恢复线段角度与目标点的准确率比其行为回答高 6–8 倍；逐层 logit lens 显示正确答案在中间层占优，仅在“视觉判断”框架下于后层被覆盖。命名错觉、要求抑制先验、强制视觉思维链以及 390 条语义前言都未改变回答中心，只有直接告知正确答案才会移动。因此 VLM 可能在语言生成阶段携带人类知觉偏差，且难以通过陈述性纠正消除。
items.highlight_zh: VLM 复现人类错觉偏差，且偏差出现在语言生成阶段
items.digest_zh:
【问题】视觉语言模型越来越多被用来“看图作答”，但它们会不会像人一样犯系统性的知觉错误？如果会，这种偏差出现在模型的哪个部分？

【方法】作者用一个此前未被定量研究过的经典视错觉——渡边错觉：圆里有一条斜线段，把这条线几何延长出去，恰好穿过一列 11 个点中最上面那个点；但 131 名人类被试普遍报告看到的是靠近该列中间的点，也就是说人脑在“外推”时把线看偏了。作者把完全相同的图形和相同的问法喂给五个主流 VLM。

【结果】五个模型全部朝与人类相同的方向偏离。作者进一步解剖开源模型 Qwen2.5-VL-32B：对视觉编码器表示做线性探针，能以比模型最终回答高 6–8 倍的准确率读出线段角度和目标点，说明模型“看到”的其实是对的；逐层 logit lens 显示正确答案在语言模型中间层一度占优，只在以“视觉判断”的形式作答时，才被后面的层覆盖掉。各种提示干预——点破这是错觉、要求忽略先验知识、要求视觉思维链、换 390 条不同的开场语——都没能把回答拉回中心，只有直接告知正确答案才有效。

【为何重要】这说明模型可能继承了人类式的知觉偏差，而且偏差不在感知环节而在“作答”环节，靠提示词难以纠正。对把 VLM 用于测量、图像审阅等需要客观判断的场景，这是重要警示，也提示需要更强的可解释与干预手段。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
items.title_zh: 用智能体 AI 发现容错量子线路
items.abstract_en: Scaling quantum computing toward practical quantum advantage is currently limited by the efficiency of circuits that operate on information encoded by quantum error-correcting codes. The full stack of quantum computing encompasses several tasks: preparation of logical code states, implementation of logical gates, logical routines on encoded qubits, etc. Yet, these circuits are largely designed by hand for individual cases, with some recent works incorporating machine learning for certain aspects. We formulate this problem as agentic evolutionary program synthesis, wherein a large language model, leveraging its pretraining knowledge and tool-use proficiency, and guided by a circuit verifier, evolves a program that defines a Clifford circuit for a wide range of curated tasks such as logical state preparation, logical gate design, and logical routines such as code-switching, code growth, etc. Our approach consistently finds fault-tolerant circuits for all of these tasks, each verified by an exhaustive check over faults.
items.abstract_zh: 迈向实用量子优势受限于作用在量子纠错码所编码信息上的线路效率。量子计算全栈包含多项任务：逻辑码态制备、逻辑门实现、编码比特上的逻辑流程等。然而这些线路大多针对个别案例手工设计，近期一些工作开始在某些环节引入机器学习。我们把该问题表述为智能体式进化程序合成：由大语言模型借助其预训练知识与工具使用能力、在量子线路验证器引导下，进化出一个定义 Clifford 线路的程序，覆盖逻辑态制备、逻辑门设计以及码切换、码增长等逻辑流程等一批精选任务。该方法在所有任务上都能稳定找到容错线路，且每条线路都通过对故障的穷举检查得到验证。
items.highlight_zh: 大语言模型智能体自动合成经穷举验证的容错量子线路
items.digest_zh:
【问题】量子计算要真正超越经典计算机，必须靠量子纠错码保护信息；而针对编码后的“逻辑信息”做操作——制备逻辑态、实现逻辑门、执行码切换和码增长等——都需要精心设计的量子线路。这些线路传统上靠专家对每个案例手工打磨，既慢又难以扩展。

【方法】作者把线路设计改写成“智能体式进化程序合成”：让大语言模型充当智能体，利用它在预训练中获得的知识和调用工具的能力，反复编写并修改一段程序，这段程序会生成一个 Clifford 量子线路；同时有一个线路验证器负责检查该线路是否真正容错，并把结果反馈回去，驱动模型迭代“进化”。

【结果】在作者整理的一批任务上（逻辑态制备、逻辑门设计、码切换、码增长等），这套方法都能稳定找到容错线路，而且每条线路都经过了穷举式故障检查——把可能出现的故障情况全部查一遍，而不是抽样验证。

【为何重要】它把“设计量子线路”这种高度依赖专家直觉的创造性工作交给 AI 智能体自动完成，并附带可验证的正确性保证，为构建量子计算软件栈提供了一条可扩展的路径；同时展示了“大语言模型 + 验证器 + 进化搜索”这一范式在硬科学问题上的潜力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
items.title_zh: Transformer 范式：动态处理与一种新的推理原理
items.abstract_en: We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a different principle of inference. We interpret the Transformer as a system in which token representations are transformed by parameterized transformations, or transforming concepts. During inference, some of these transformations are dynamically constructed from the current input: previously acquired transformations are first adapted and then applied. At the mechanical-structural level, this dynamic processing is realized through output-weight interconnections, whereby outputs of some networks determine the weights of others. The resulting mode of processing, which we call Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP), provides a framework for explaining strong prompt sensitivity and opens research directions concerning interpretability, control, alternative AI architectures, neuromorphic systems, and possible biological realizations of dynamic processing.
items.abstract_zh: 我们认为，把 Transformer 革命仅仅理解为深度学习的量级扩张并不充分，它其实代表了一种基于不同推理原理的新范式。我们把 Transformer 视为这样一个系统：词元表示被参数化的变换（即“变换概念”）所改造。在推理过程中，其中一些变换是根据当前输入动态构建的：先对先前习得的变换加以适配，再予以应用。在机械-结构层面，这种动态处理通过输出-权重互连实现，即某些网络的输出决定了另一些网络的权重。由此得到的处理方式我们称为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP），它为解释强烈的提示敏感性提供了框架，并开辟了可解释性、控制、替代 AI 架构、神经形态系统以及动态处理可能的生物学实现等研究方向。
items.highlight_zh: Transformer 是动态构造变换的新推理范式（SIDPP）
items.digest_zh:
【核心主张】人们常把 Transformer 的成功归结为“模型更大、数据更多”的量变。作者认为这不够准确：Transformer 代表的是一种新的推理原理。

【怎么理解】可以把 Transformer 想成一套“变换概念”——每个词元（token）的表示都会被一系列带参数的变换改造。关键在于：推理时，其中一部分变换是固定不变的，另一部分则根据当前输入现场构建出来——先把已学到的变换加以适配，再施加到表示上。这种“边读边造工具”的机制，是它与传统前馈网络最根本的区别。

【结构上如何实现】作者指出，这种动态性通过“输出-权重互连”实现：某些网络的输出直接决定另一些网络的权重，于是处理流程会随输入而变。作者把这种模式称为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）。

【解释力】它给一个长期困扰使用者的现象提供了框架性解释：为什么提示词改动几个字，模型输出会大不相同——因为输入本身参与了计算规则的构造。

【为何重要】这一视角把 Transformer 从“更大的神经网络”重新定位为一种新的推理范式，并由此提出若干研究方向：可解释性（如何读懂动态构造的变换）、控制（如何干预这些变换）、设计替代架构、神经形态硬件，以及这种动态处理在生物神经系统中可能的实现形式。

items.title_en: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
items.title_zh: WebArena-Pro：面向 Web 智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准
items.abstract_en: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型与视觉-语言模型驱动的 Web 智能体，正越来越多地用于跨异构应用、含多模态内容且有状态流程的真实浏览器工作。然而现有可复现的 Web 智能体基准只覆盖少数软件类别中的少量 Web 应用，且模态仅限文本与视觉；实时（Live）基准虽扩大了站点覆盖，却因页面与数据在两次运行间漂移而牺牲了可复现性；此外，现有基准无法真正评估智能体能否理解并使用网页任务中嵌入的音频与视频内容。为此，我们提出 WebArena-Pro：包含 20 个自托管 Web 应用、6 个领域类别下的 300 个任务，覆盖不同的界面约定、工作流与数据模型。在受评智能体中，Codex 搭配 GPT 6.1 Sol 与 Claude Code 搭配 Claude Opus 5.5 同以 62.3% 取得最佳成绩，OpenCode 搭配 Kimi 3.1 Pro 以 60.7% 紧随其后；最强的 GenericAgent 配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro omni 与 Gemma4 31B）均为 30.3%。在可复现、人工整理的 Web 智能体基准中，WebArena-Pro 提供了迄今最广的应用覆盖与最全面的多模态支持：音频与视频与文本、视觉一样被视为核心观测，并为每类模态设计了专门的信息抽取动作。每个任务隔离运行，支持可复现的并行评测；任务经专门标注界面撰写、LLM 辅助筛选，并在发布前由人工校验。
items.highlight_zh: 20 个自托管应用、300 个任务，音频视频也成核心观测
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】让 AI 智能体像人一样用浏览器完成真实工作（订票、填表、跨站点搬运信息）是热门方向，但评测标准跟不上：已有的可复现基准往往只测少数几个网站、几类软件，而且只看文字和图片；覆盖站点多的"实时基准"又不可复现，因为网页和数据每次运行都在变。更关键的是，网页里嵌的音频、视频内容几乎没被考察过。
【用了什么方法】作者构建 WebArena-Pro：20 个自托管 Web 应用、跨 6 个领域类别的 300 个任务，各应用的界面风格、操作流程与数据模型都不一样，尽量模拟真实的多应用环境。音频和视频被提升为"核心观测"，并为每种模态设计了专门的动作来抽取信息。每个任务在隔离环境中运行，可并行、可复现；任务由专门的标注界面撰写，经 LLM 辅助筛选，发布前由人工校验。
【有什么结果】最强成绩来自 Codex 配 GPT 6.1 Sol 与 Claude Code 配 Claude Opus 5.5，同为 62.3%；OpenCode 配 Kimi 3.1 Pro 为 60.7%；而最强的通用型智能体配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro omni、Gemma4 31B）只有 30.3%。也就是说，即便是最好的系统，仍有近四成任务失败，且专用智能体框架与"开箱即用"的通用配置之间存在约 30 个百分点的巨大鸿沟。
【为何重要】它在可复现、人工整理的 Web 智能体基准里实现了最广的应用覆盖与最全的多模态支持，把音频、视频纳入评测，填补了既有基准的两处空白，为衡量智能体能否胜任真实浏览器工作提供了统一标尺。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
items.title_zh: EgoX：以具身"做梦"实现第一人称跨具身操作
items.abstract_en: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming (MXT+) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MXT+ assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics. Across 13 task-embodiment pairs spanning five tasks and six robot embodiments, including five physical robots and one simulated humanoid, cross-embodiment pretraining raises MXT+'s average normalized task progress from 0.63 to 0.80 over training from scratch. The gains are particularly pronounced under out-of-distribution conditions, where average task progress increases from 0.53 to 0.77. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of broader pretraining mixtures, modular interfaces, and embodiment dreaming, with dreaming producing more similar latent geometry across embodiments. Project page: egox-dream.github.io.
items.abstract_zh: 通用操作策略可以从人类、真实机器人与仿真智能体的互补经验中获益，但形态、传感与控制接口的差异使得从这些混合示范中有效学习变得困难。我们提出 EgoX，一个第一人称（egocentric）跨具身学习框架，通过语义上对应的观测与动作模态来组织异构示范。EgoX 在该混合数据上预训练带具身做梦（Embodiment Dreaming）的模块化跨具身 Transformer（MXT+），再在目标具身的示范上微调。在每种具身内部，MXT+ 为每个观测模态分配专用 tokenizer、为每个动作模态分配专用专家，而 Transformer 主干在所有具身间共享。一个仅在训练时使用的"具身做梦"目标预测未来视觉与本体状态的潜在表示，促使共享主干建模各具身的动力学。在覆盖 5 个任务、6 种机器人具身（5 台实体机器人加 1 个仿真人形）的 13 个任务-具身对上，跨具身预训练使 MXT+ 的平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提升到 0.80；在分布外条件下增益尤为明显，平均任务进度从 0.53 提升到 0.77。消融实验证实了更广的预训练混合、模块化接口与具身做梦的收益，其中做梦使不同具身之间的潜在几何更为接近。
items.highlight_zh: 共享主干加具身做梦，跨具身预训练进度 0.63→0.80
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】要训练"什么机器人都会干"的通用操作策略，最理想的是把人类示范、真实机器人数据和仿真智能体经验合在一起用。但不同机器人（甚至人）的身体结构、传感器和控制方式都不一样，这些示范很难直接混着学，模型容易只学会某一种身体的"方言"。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 EgoX：用第一人称视角把各种来源的示范组织起来，让不同具身的观测和动作在语义上对齐。在此混合数据上预训练 MXT+——即带"具身做梦"的模块化跨具身 Transformer——再在目标机器人的数据上微调。MXT+ 的关键设计是：每种具身内部，观测的每个模态（图像、本体状态等）用专属 tokenizer，动作的每个模态用专属"专家"，而 Transformer 主干由所有具身共享；此外加了一个只在训练时使用的"具身做梦"目标，让模型预测未来视觉与本体状态的潜在表示，从而逼着共享主干去理解每种身体自己的动力学。
【有什么结果】在覆盖 5 个任务、6 种机器人具身（5 台实体机器人加 1 个仿真人形）的 13 个任务-具身对上，跨具身预训练把平均归一化任务进度从 0.63 提到 0.80；在分布外条件下提升更明显，从 0.53 到 0.77。消融显示，更广的预训练数据混合、模块化接口和具身做梦三者都有贡献，并且"做梦"让不同具身在潜在空间里的表示几何更加相似。
【为何重要】它提供了一条把异构数据源汇入同一个操作大模型的可行路径，尤其能改善机器人到新场景时的泛化，为跨身体形态的通用操作策略打下基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Unlocking Cross-Attention in Label-Scarce Regimes: A Weakly Supervised Approach for Video Semantic Segmentation
items.title_zh: 在标签稀缺场景中释放交叉注意力：一种用于视频语义分割的弱监督方法
items.abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Video Semantic Segmentation (WS-VSS) aims to learn temporally consistent semantic object masks in videos using only video-level labels. While fully supervised models successfully learn temporal relationships by means of cross-attention, training these temporal weights under weak supervision is unstable and even pushes the model below its single-frame baseline. Therefore, existing WS-VSS methods exploit temporal consistency by relying on external priors, such as optical flow. Unfortunately these cues are non-semantic, computationally expensive and noisy, degrading the supervisory signal. Instead of supervising attention weights directly or using external priors, we propose MemCAM, a WS-VSS transformer framework that learns temporal cross-attention directly through feature-space self-supervision. MemCAM introduces a CAM Propagation Algorithm that synthesizes a supervisory signal by propagating past CAMs according to patch-level feature similarities in the latent space. Specifically, we constrain their induced CAMs through a consistency objective between predicted and propagated maps, stabilizing temporal attention learning. Experiments on the YouTube-Objects v2.2 and WS$^2$ datasets demonstrate that MemCAM consistently outperforms the temporal localization and segmentation performance of WS-VSS alternatives, showing that cross-attention can be effectively trained in label-scarce video settings through internal self-supervision.
items.abstract_zh: 弱监督视频语义分割（WS-VSS）旨在仅使用视频级标签学习视频中时间一致的语义对象掩码。完全监督模型通过交叉注意力成功学习时间关系，而在弱监督下训练这些时间权重不稳定，甚至会使模型低于其单帧基线。因此，现有WS-VSS方法依赖外部先验（如光流）来利用时间一致性。不幸的是，这些线索是非语义的、计算昂贵且含噪，会降低监督信号。我们提出MemCAM，一种WS-VSS Transformer框架，不直接监督注意力权重或使用外部先验，而是通过特征空间自监督直接学习时间交叉注意力。MemCAM引入CAM传播算法，该算法根据潜在空间中块级特征相似性传播过去的CAM来合成监督信号。具体而言，我们通过预测图与传播图之间的一致性目标约束其诱导的CAM，从而稳定时间注意力学习。在YouTube-Objects v2.2和WS$^2$数据集上的实验表明，MemCAM在时间定位和分割性能上持续优于WS-VSS替代方法，表明可以通过内部自监督在标签稀缺的视频设置中有效训练交叉注意力。

items.title_en: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: 面向生物学家的AI：智能体系统时代基础模型的知识边界
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations. Agentic systems, AI assistants built on large language models, can run multistep analyses from plain-language requests and increasingly call foundation models as tools. Yet it is often unclear when these models' outputs can be trusted. We frame this as a model's knowledge boundary: the range of inputs, tasks, and conditions over which its outputs are reliable. This review explains how foundation models are built and proposes that five design elements (data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis) define this boundary. We examine evidence on where current models succeed or fail and present standardized descriptions of model limits so that researchers, and the agents acting for them, can use these tools reliably.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变生物学研究的方式。基于数百万核苷酸、蛋白质和单细胞测量训练的生物基础模型可预测蛋白质结构、突变效应以及细胞对遗传扰动的响应。智能体系统——构建于大语言模型之上的AI助手——能够根据自然语言请求运行多步骤分析，并越来越多地将基础模型作为工具调用。然而，这些模型的输出何时可信往往并不明确。我们将其表述为模型的知识边界：即其输出可靠所覆盖的输入、任务和条件范围。本综述解释基础模型如何构建，并提出五个设计要素（数据、架构、训练方案、评估方案和分析后处理）界定该边界。我们考察当前模型在何处成功或失败的证据，并提出模型局限的标准化描述，以便研究人员及其代为行动的智能体能够可靠地使用这些工具。

items.title_en: Chip-Based Discrete-Modulated Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution with Uncertainty-Principle-Based Composable Security
items.title_zh: 基于芯片的离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发：具有基于不确定性原理的可组合安全性
items.abstract_en: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution offers a promising platform for scalable quantum networks through its compatibility with standard telecommunications technology and photonic integration. High-order discrete modulation facilitates practical implementation while approaching the key-rate performance of ideal Gaussian modulation, but its finite-size composable security analysis entails substantial computational overhead. Here, we develop an uncertainty-principle-based security framework that enables finite-size composable key-rate evaluation against collective attacks for constellations up to 256-QAM. By introducing a heterodyne-measured ancillary mode into the entanglement-based source description, we incorporate additional source correlations into the security analysis that allow the Heisenberg uncertainty principle alone to provide a tight bound for the unknown correlations in a covariance matrix characterizing the whole system. Matrix symmetrization further reduces the key-rate optimization to a one-dimensional search, while subsequent mode reduction yields an analytical lower bound requiring no numerical search. Experimental demonstrations using 256-QAM on discrete-component and silicon-photonic-receiver platforms achieve finite-size composable secret key rates of 17.436 and 0.519 Mbps, respectively, over a 50 km fiber link. This approach facilitates the practical deployment of high-speed, real-time and compact quantum key distribution systems. Beyond quantum key distribution, the principle of tightening uncertainty-constrained bounds via source-mode expansion offers a paradigm for exploring the information-theoretic properties of complex non-Gaussian systems.
items.abstract_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发通过与标准电信技术和光子集成的兼容性，为可扩展量子网络提供了有前景的平台。高阶离散调制便于实际实现，同时接近理想高斯调制的密钥率性能，但其有限码长可组合安全性分析带来大量计算开销。在此，我们开发了一个基于不确定性原理的安全性框架，可针对集体攻击对高达256-QAM的星座进行有限码长可组合密钥率评估。通过将外差测量的辅助模式引入基于纠缠的光源描述，我们将额外的光源相关性纳入安全性分析，使得仅凭海森堡不确定性原理就能为表征整个系统的协方差矩阵中的未知相关性提供紧致界。矩阵对称化进一步将密钥率优化简化为二维搜索，随后模式约简产生无需数值搜索的解析下界。在50 km光纤链路上，使用256-QAM在分立元件和硅光子接收机平台上的实验演示分别实现了17.436和0.519 Mbps的有限码长可组合秘密密钥率。该方法有助于高速、实时和紧凑量子密钥分发系统的实际部署。除量子密钥分发之外，通过光源模式扩展收紧不确定性约束界这一原理，为探索复杂非高斯系统的信息论性质提供了范式。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
items.title_zh: 基于分解式JEPA的非对称多模态学习
items.abstract_en: Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$. We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. Under information asymmetry, alignment-only training undergoes catastrophic semantic collapse on compositional reasoning benchmarks, surviving only on binary queries. D-JEPA averts this collapse, substantially improving downstream accuracy over both alignment-only and alignment-with-reconstruction baselines, and restoring a positive multimodal synergy gap in place of the baseline's inverted gap. Information-theoretic audits confirm that D-JEPA recovers most of the mutual information available from a frozen backbone, and causal fiber-swap interventions demonstrate that the recovered information is causally localized in the private fibers.
items.abstract_zh: 跨模态对齐是构建多模态表示的标准目标。我们表明，只要模态在信息上是不对称的——即任一模态都无法表达另一模态所携带的信息——将对齐作为唯一目标就是有损的。视觉问答是一个明显例子：问题是一个选择性关系算子，用于探测密集视觉场，而任何查询都无法恢复该视觉场的细粒度特征，因此对齐所保留的并非任务所需。我们证明了对齐冗余界：仅对齐的狄利克雷能量最小化至多保留冗余信息原子 Red(Z; X_1, X_2)，并湮灭私有模态特定结构 Unq(Z; X_m) 与跨模态协同 Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)。我们提出分解式JEPA（D-JEPA），将潜在变量分解为对齐的共享核心和私有的模态特定纤维。共享核心保留对齐所针对的大部分结构；私有纤维通过上下文掩码预测和非对称跨子空间独立性恢复对齐所丢弃的信息。在信息不对称下，仅对齐训练在组合推理基准上经历灾难性语义坍缩，仅在二元查询上幸存。D-JEPA避免了这种坍缩，在仅对齐基线和带重建的对齐基线之上显著提高下游准确率，并恢复了正的多模态协同差距，而非基线的倒置差距。信息论审计确认，D-JEPA恢复了冻结骨干网络所能提供的大部分互信息，因果纤维交换干预表明恢复的信息因果地定位于私有纤维中。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
items.title_zh: ModHarness-RL：将执行框架重构为智能体强化学习中可学习且可演化的程序
items.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on a harness, the scaffold around the model that decides what it sees of its own interaction and what guidance it receives. Most existing approaches train under a hand-written harness that stays fixed throughout. However, an effective harness depends on the domain, the data and the model, and keeps changing as the model trains. We introduce ModHarness-RL, which recasts the harness as programs that are learned from data and evolve as the model trains with RL. ModHarness-RL records the interaction as structured State, a set of typed blocks, and two core components of the harness are programs over these blocks, a Compression program that assembles the accumulated history into the model's context and a Steering program that supplies guidance when behavior deviates. During RL training, candidate programs are proposed from recent trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed over past trajectories, so the harness tracks how the model's behavior shifts. We study CodeSearch in depth and further analyze ALFWorld and BIRD SQL, with models from 1.5B to 8B. The proposed Compression and Steering mechanisms improve held-out performance over the fixed-harness baseline in most settings. These results suggest that a harness for agentic RL can be learned from the task's data and evolved with the model.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）越来越依赖执行框架（harness），即模型周围的脚手架，它决定模型能看到自身交互的哪些内容以及获得何种引导。大多数现有方法在手写且全程固定的执行框架下训练。然而，有效的执行框架取决于领域、数据和模型，并会随着模型训练而变化。我们提出ModHarness-RL，它将执行框架重构为从数据中学习并随模型进行RL训练而演化的程序。ModHarness-RL将交互记录为结构化State，即一组类型化块，执行框架的两个核心组件是作用于这些块的程序：Compression程序将累积历史组装到模型上下文中，Steering程序在行为偏离时提供引导。在RL训练期间，候选程序从近期轨迹中提出，经执行验证，并在过去轨迹上重放，从而使执行框架跟踪模型行为的变化。我们深入研究CodeSearch，并进一步分析ALFWorld和BIRD SQL，模型规模从1.5B到8B。所提出的Compression和Steering机制在大多数设置中相较固定执行框架基线提升了留出集性能。这些结果表明，面向智能体RL的执行框架可以从任务数据中学习，并随模型演化。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
items.title_zh: 展望智能体机器人：机器人系统的新时代
items.abstract_en: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks. It operates in a closed loop: observing the environment, interpreting user intent, reasoning about the task, invoking skills and tools, verifying outcomes, and adapting its strategy. Despite these advances, the community has yet to converge on a shared definition, a reliable evaluation framework, or a research roadmap. We argue that Embodied System 2, realized by a foundation model together with an embodied harness, forms the decision-making core of agentic robotics. Its central challenge is to translate general-purpose reasoning into effective and verifiable actions under physical constraints such as limited reaction time, mechanical limits, unpredictable environment changes, and irreversible consequences. Motivated by this perspective, we propose an evaluation framework that measures both model capabilities and closed-loop system performance. Furthermore, we identify the principles that carry over from digital to physical agents and the challenges that must be addressed to achieve reliable physical autonomy. On top of the Embodied System 2 and the evaluation framework, we envision a research roadmap toward sustained autonomy: the ability to perform work safely and reliably with progressively broader responsibility, from executing individual primitives to fulfilling standing roles.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6 Astra的发布标志着机器人学新范式的出现：智能体机器人。在数周内，配备智能体执行框架的前沿模型在许多具身基准上匹配或超过了任务专用策略。智能体机器人系统不是为每个任务族训练专用策略，而是将基础模型应用于开放世界具身任务。它在闭环中运行：观察环境、解释用户意图、推理任务、调用技能和工具、验证结果并调整策略。尽管取得了这些进展，社区尚未就共享定义、可靠评估框架或研究路线图达成一致。我们认为，由基础模型与具身执行框架共同实现的具身系统2构成了智能体机器人的决策核心。其核心挑战是在物理约束（如有限反应时间、机械极限、不可预测的环境变化和不可逆后果）下，将通用推理转化为有效且可验证的动作。受此观点启发，我们提出一个评估框架，既衡量模型能力，也衡量闭环系统性能。此外，我们识别出从数字智能体迁移到物理智能体的原则，以及实现可靠物理自主性必须应对的挑战。在具身系统2和评估框架之上，我们展望一条通向持续自主性的研究路线图：即从执行单个基元到承担常设角色，以逐步扩大的责任范围安全可靠地完成工作的能力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
items.title_zh: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体式重建
items.abstract_en: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
items.abstract_zh: 直接图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，使持久的3D力学平衡、推演中途干预和反事实力控制无法实现。相反，从未标定照片进行单遍程序化3D重建会使单目深度和支撑间隙约束不足，导致重建场景相互穿透或在重力下坍塌。我们提出TelePhysica，一个闭环框架，可从单张照片重建可执行的多物理机制世界，以驱动有状态3D交互和基于轨迹的视频合成。一个视觉-语言编码智能体在两阶段验证循环内合成可分离视觉网格和声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓评判与零力重力平衡预检配对。经验证的世界编译为一个统一求解器，耦合刚体、铰接链、同维布料壳层和3D四面体弹性动力学，其模拟推演通过像素对齐的结构流为预训练视频扩散模型提供条件。在100个场景的单图像基准上，闭环执行将平衡验证的世界恢复率从单遍合成的0%提高到81%。受控本构消融显示，有限元布料中的局部角点位移和面外褶皱比匹配的刚性板代理大一个数量级以上。以模拟轨迹为视频扩散提供条件，将动态运动掩码重叠提高2×–5×，并在直接图像到视频模型失败的反事实力反向情况下保持运动方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: Protein Language Models Fail To Capture Contact Predictions Under Invariant Relabeling
items.title_zh: 蛋白质语言模型在不变重标记下未能捕捉接触预测
items.abstract_en: Protein language models (pLMs) produce highly accurate contact maps from single-sequence inputs. People often take this accuracy as proof that these models implicitly learn invariant coevolutionary statistics, extracting the same signals as classical alignment-based methods like Potts. In this work, we introduce a diagnostic framework around a global bijective relabeling of the amino-acid alphabet. This transformation permutes residue letters while leaving all alignment-level information, column entropies, and pairwise edit distances unchanged. Pseudolikelihood Potts models and inverse-covariance estimators remain invariant under this transformation, but pLMs fail the test. Across multiple architectures (ESM-2, MSA Transformer, AMPLIFY) and model scales (8M to 3B parameters), pLM contact maps collapse under arbitrary relabeling. Using Hamming distance controls and biochemical grouping interventions, we attempt to isolate what likely causes this degradation and find that these models rely on explicit, canonical residue identities (``alphabet anchoring'') rather than pure coevolutionary statistics. Increasing scale makes models more responsive to biochemical classes, but their performance still degrades under relabeling. Our findings show a gap between how pLMs and classical coevolutionary models compute contacts. More broadly, our work shows how diagnostic perturbations that leave classical models provably unchanged can expose hidden representation biases and prevent over-reliance on neural black boxes in biological modeling.
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型（pLM）可从单序列输入生成高精度接触图。人们常将这种准确性视为这些模型隐式学习不变共进化统计量的证据，提取与Potts等经典基于比对的方法相同的信号。在这项工作中，我们围绕氨基酸字母表的全局双射重标记引入一个诊断框架。该变换置换残基字母，同时保持所有比对层面信息、列熵和成对编辑距离不变。伪似然Potts模型和逆协方差估计器在此变换下保持不变，但pLM未通过该测试。在多种架构（ESM-2、MSA Transformer、AMPLIFY）和模型规模（8M至3B参数）上，pLM接触图在任意重标记下崩溃。利用汉明距离对照和生化分组干预，我们试图分离出可能造成这种退化的原因，并发现这些模型依赖显式的规范残基身份（“字母表锚定”），而非纯共进化统计量。增大规模使模型对生化类别更敏感，但其性能在重标记下仍会退化。我们的发现表明，pLM和经典共进化模型在计算接触的方式上存在差距。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明，使经典模型可证明保持不变的诊断性扰动，如何能够揭示隐藏的表征偏差，并防止在生物建模中过度依赖神经黑箱。

items.title_en: Mapping the Phase Space of Cubic Chiral Semiconductors: High-Throughput Search,Stability, and Prototype Families
items.title_zh: 绘制立方手性半导体的相空间：高通量搜索、稳定性与原型家族
items.abstract_en: Chiral crystals show unique electronic, magnetic, and optical characteristics that make them attractive for topological and spintronic applications. Nevertheless, the limited set of identified chiral semiconductors, especially those with cubic symmetry, has so far constrained their technological application. In this work, we perform a high-throughput computational search for semiconducting chiral compounds in the cubic space group $P4_332$ (No. 212). By integrating machine-learning techniques with density functional theory, we obtain 24\,227 cubic chiral structures containing up to five elements, and identify 368 thermodynamically stable semiconductors on the convex hull and 3\,048 within 50~meV/atom. We analyze their structural motifs, stability, and electronic band structures, highlighting recurring prototype families, several of which show intrinsic intermediate-band features. Our results substantially expand the known phase space of cubic chiral semiconductors and may guide future efforts in the discovery and design of chiral materials.
items.abstract_zh: 手性晶体表现出独特的电子、磁性和光学特性，使其在拓扑和自旋电子学应用中具有吸引力。然而，已识别的手性半导体集合有限，尤其是具有立方对称性的手性半导体，迄今限制了其技术应用。在这项工作中，我们在立方空间群P4_332（No. 212）中对手性半导体化合物进行高通量计算搜索。通过将机器学习技术与密度泛函理论相结合，我们获得24,227个包含至多五种元素的立方手性结构，并识别出368个位于凸包上的热力学稳定半导体以及3,048个在50 meV/atom范围内的半导体。我们分析其结构基元、稳定性和电子能带结构，突出反复出现的原型家族，其中若干表现出本征中间带特征。我们的结果大幅扩展了立方手性半导体的已知相空间，并可能指导未来手性材料的发现与设计工作。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: OpenLayout: An Open and Agentic-Driven Platform for Holistic VLSI Physical Design and Benchmarking
items.title_zh: OpenLayout：一个面向整体VLSI物理设计与基准测试的开放智能体驱动平台
items.abstract_en: Physical design automation of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) has made significant strides, progressing from single-stage placement and routing toward increasingly integrated full-flow implementation. Yet, existing approaches struggle with the vast design space optimization (DSO) arising from diverse technology nodes, circuit designs, and varied constraints. The substantial runtime of physical-design tools further exacerbates this challenge, leaving industrial workflows heavily dependent on experienced engineers to navigate the design space and achieve power, performance, and area (PPA) targets, incurring significant engineering effort. We argue that large language models (LLMs) with strong reasoning capabilities, enriched with distilled human design expertise, offer a promising path toward efficient and automated DSO. Unlike traditional algorithms, LLMs can interpret complex design contexts and naturally incorporate human expertise expressed in natural language for reasoning, acting, observing, and adapting throughout the design process, a capability that conventional optimization methods cannot exploit. To this end, we present OpenLayout, an agentic platform that leverages multi-agent collaboration with embedded design knowledge to enable self-iterative DSO. We further introduce OpenLayout-Bench, a benchmark targeting advanced technology nodes with commercial EDA tools to systematically evaluate physical design automation capabilities of LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that OpenLayout achieves state-of-the-art performance, with approximately 20% accuracy improvement over baseline methods. Our work is open-sourced at https://github.com/fenggev56/OpenLayout
items.abstract_zh: 超大规模集成电路（VLSI）的物理设计自动化已取得重大进展，从单阶段布局布线发展到日益集成的全流程实现。然而，现有方法难以应对由多样技术节点、电路设计和各种约束带来的巨大设计空间优化（DSO）问题。物理设计工具的大量运行时间进一步加剧了这一挑战，使工业工作流严重依赖经验丰富的工程师来导航设计空间并实现功耗、性能与面积（PPA）目标，从而产生大量工程投入。我们认为，具有强推理能力并通过蒸馏人类设计专业知识加以丰富的大语言模型（LLM），为实现高效且自动化的DSO提供了一条有前景的路径。与传统算法不同，LLM能够解释复杂的设计上下文，并自然地纳入以自然语言表达的人类专业知识，在整个设计过程中进行推理、行动、观察和适应，这是传统优化方法无法利用的能力。为此，我们提出OpenLayout，一个利用嵌入设计知识的多智能体协作来实现自迭代DSO的智能体平台。我们进一步引入OpenLayout-Bench，一个使用商业EDA工具面向先进技术节点的基准，用于系统评估LLM的物理设计自动化能力。实验结果表明，OpenLayout达到最先进性能，相较基线方法准确率提升约20%。我们的工作在https://github.com/fenggev56/OpenLayout开源。

items.title_en: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
items.title_zh: VEPO：通过视觉证据引导的偏好优化缓解LVLM中的多语言幻觉
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet they remain prone to object hallucination---generating answers that are linguistically fluent but visually ungrounded. This issue is especially severe in low-resource languages, where weaker cross-modal alignment causes models to rely more on language priors than on image evidence. Existing remedies either require costly multilingual annotations or external translation/reward models, or intervene at inference time in ways that can distort the output language. We propose VEPO(Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization), a training-time method that transfers reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models. VEPO first localizes key visual evidence using English queries via mid-layer cross-modal attention, then constructs preference pairs that share the same correct answer but differ in evidence sufficiency (full image vs.\ key-region masked image). Direct preference optimization on these pairs encourages low-resource inputs to prefer answers supported by complete visual evidence. Experiments on multilingual POPE and MME with Chinese, French, and Hindi show consistent hallucination reduction and perception gains, with the largest improvements on the lowest-resource language. Analyses further confirm that VEPO sharpens question-relevant attention and that evidence-guided masking outperforms random masking.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）实现了强大的多模态性能，但仍易出现物体幻觉——生成语言流畅但视觉上缺乏依据的答案。该问题在低资源语言中尤为严重，因为较弱的跨模态对齐使模型更依赖语言先验而非图像证据。现有补救措施要么需要昂贵的多语言标注或外部翻译/奖励模型，要么在推理时进行干预，而这种方式可能扭曲输出语言。我们提出VEPO（视觉证据引导的偏好优化），一种训练时方法，可在不使用外部模型的情况下将可靠的视觉依据从英语迁移到其他语言。VEPO首先通过中间层跨模态注意力使用英语查询定位关键视觉证据，然后构建偏好对，这些偏好对共享相同的正确答案，但在证据充分性上不同（完整图像 vs. 关键区域被掩蔽的图像）。对这些偏好对进行直接偏好优化，鼓励低资源输入偏好由完整视觉证据支持的答案。在中文、法语和印地语的多语言POPE和MME上的实验显示，幻觉持续减少且感知性能提升，其中最低资源语言的改进最大。分析进一步证实，VEPO使与问题相关的注意力更锐化，并且证据引导的掩蔽优于随机掩蔽。

items.title_en: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
items.title_zh: HALO：用于全身移动操作的人类对齐数据收集
items.abstract_en: Learning whole-body mobile manipulation requires demonstrations that coordinate bimanual actions with locomotion across extended workspaces. However, existing interfaces trade off direct robot control, perception and action alignment, and natural operator mobility, making such demonstrations difficult to collect. We introduce HALO, a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation. The system aligns the operator's perception and action space with the robot while preserving direct physical feedback and natural locomotion. Operators guide the robot end-effectors through kinesthetic teaching and move a low-resistance platform without the deployed mobile base while performing bimanual manipulation. This interface enables more natural whole-body demonstrations, but the close human-robot coupling introduces discrepancies between the demonstration and deployment settings. We address these discrepancies with deployment-aligned demonstration processing, which calibrates and temporally aligns platform motion with the deployed base response and masks and inpaints demonstrator hands in recorded observations. Compared with Mobile ALOHA and VR teleoperation, HALO enables up to 2.9x faster demonstration collection while maintaining comparable or higher success rates. Policies trained with HALO perform precise manipulation tasks, including zip-tie fastening, and achieve a 73.3% success rate on a six-stage long-horizon mobile manipulation task involving repeated coordinated base and arm motion. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/
items.abstract_zh: 学习全身移动操作需要能够在扩展工作空间中协调双臂动作与移动的演示。然而，现有接口在直接机器人控制、感知与动作对齐以及操作者自然移动性之间进行权衡，使此类演示难以收集。我们提出HALO，一个面向全身移动操作的人类对齐数据收集系统。该系统将操作者的感知和动作空间与机器人对齐，同时保留直接物理反馈和自然移动。操作者通过动觉示教引导机器人末端执行器，并在执行双臂操作时移动一个不搭载已部署移动底座的低阻力平台。该接口能够实现更自然的全身演示，但密切的人机耦合引入了演示与部署设置之间的差异。我们通过部署对齐的演示处理来解决这些差异，该校准平台运动并将其与部署底座响应在时间上对齐，并在记录的观测中掩蔽和修复演示者的手。与Mobile ALOHA和VR遥操作相比，HALO在保持相当或更高成功率的同时，将演示收集速度最高提升至2.9倍。使用HALO训练的策略执行精确操作任务，包括扎带紧固，并在涉及重复协调底座与手臂运动的六阶段长时程移动操作任务上达到73.3%的成功率。项目页面：https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/

items.title_en: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
items.title_zh: 从图像到定位编辑：面向手写作文中文语法纠错的真实世界基准
items.abstract_en: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.
items.abstract_zh: 中文语法纠错（CGEC）通常被表述为文本到文本问题。虽然这适用于数字文本，但这种表述在真实世界的 K-12 教育中并不够用，因为 AI 辅助纠错被期望直接作用于作文图像，而这些图像主要是手写的，并表现出许多不规则性。为弥合这一差距，我们引入基于定位的中文语法纠错（G-CGEC），这是一个图像到定位编辑的任务，要求系统同时预测纠错内容及其在作文图像上的位置。我们提出 G-CGEC-Eval，一个包含真实世界 K-12 中文作文图像及细粒度标注的基准。在评估方面，我们改编了目标检测中基于 IoU 的指标，并提出了一种基于中心距离匹配、更宽容的替代指标。利用该基准，我们在直接单次通过的设置下，以及在通过流水线或智能体化封装协调辅助组件（OCR 和字符定位）的设置下，评估了开源和专有视觉语言模型。结果表明，即使顶级专有模型在单次通过设置下也表现得出奇地差，而流水线和智能体化封装带来了有意义的改进。值得注意的是，基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得了最佳性能，使其成为未来 G-CGEC 研究的最强基线。通过消融和细粒度分析，我们发现该任务仍远未解决，语言错误发现和字符级定位是主要瓶颈。这凸显了需要更好地整合视觉感知与语言推理及视觉定位的模型。

items.title_en: Paired multiomic profiling defines the healthy human synovium infrapatellar fat pad stromal continuum
items.title_zh: 配对多组学分析界定健康人滑膜与髌下脂肪垫的基质细胞连续谱
items.abstract_en: The synovium and infrapatellar fat pad (IPFP) are anatomically contiguous tissues implicated in osteoarthritis, yet their cellular and molecular organization in the healthy human knee remains poorly defined. We combined bulk RNA sequencing with paired single-nucleus transcriptomic and chromatin accessibility profiling to establish a quantitative multiomic reference of healthy human synovium and IPFP. Analysis of 54,716 nuclei from six cadaveric donors identified 23 synovial and 20 IPFP cell populations and indicated that the two tissues share one transcriptionally continuous, largely quiescent stromal compartment. Stromal populations shared core transcriptional programs but differed primarily in extracellular matrix output, with transcripts of inhibitory regulators predominating over those of their functional opponents. TIMP3 exceeded MMP14 in 42 of 43 single-nucleus populations across both tissues and by 13- to 39-fold in bulk tissue. Chromatin accessibility primarily distinguished stromal lineages and resolved transcriptionally defined subtypes, separating synovial lining from sublining fibroblasts and adipocytes from fibroblasts. Fibroblast and adipocyte populations occupied a common transcriptional trajectory accompanied by declining expression of organelle-turnover programs and little proliferation, with no dividing adipocytes and fewer than 0.05% of fibroblasts in the cell cycle. Despite this shared organization, the IPFP exhibited greater inferred intercellular signaling, attributable in part to BMP5, which was not detected in synovium. These findings describe healthy synovium and IPFP as regionally specialized parts of a transcriptionally continuous stromal compartment and provide a quantitative reference for identifying cellular and regulatory changes in joint disease.
items.abstract_zh: 滑膜和髌下脂肪垫（IPFP）是解剖上相连、与骨关节炎相关的组织，但其在健康人膝关节中的细胞和分子组织仍定义不清。我们将 bulk RNA 测序与配对的单核转录组和染色质可及性分析相结合，建立了健康人滑膜和 IPFP 的定量多组学参考。对来自六名尸体供者的 54,716 个细胞核进行分析，鉴定出 23 个滑膜细胞群和 20 个 IPFP 细胞群，并表明这两个组织共享一个转录上连续、基本处于静息状态的基质区室。基质细胞群共享核心转录程序，但主要在细胞外基质输出方面不同，抑制性调节因子的转录本超过其功能对手的转录本。在两个组织中，TIMP3 在 43 个单核细胞群中的 42 个中超过 MMP14，在 bulk 组织中高出 13 至 39 倍。染色质可及性主要区分基质谱系，并解析转录定义的亚型，将滑膜衬里与衬下成纤维细胞、脂肪细胞与成纤维细胞分开。成纤维细胞和脂肪细胞群体占据共同的转录轨迹，伴随细胞器周转程序的表达下降和很少的增殖，没有分裂的脂肪细胞，处于细胞周期中的成纤维细胞少于 0.05%。尽管有这种共享组织方式，IPFP 表现出更强的推断细胞间信号传导，部分归因于 BMP5，而 BMP5 在滑膜中未检测到。这些发现将健康滑膜和 IPFP 描述为转录连续基质区室中区域特化的部分，并为识别关节疾病中的细胞和调控变化提供了定量参考。

items.title_en: Tunable coupling between valley and magnetic excitons in WS2/CrSBr heterostructures
items.title_zh: WS2/CrSBr 异质结构中谷激子与磁性激子之间的可调耦合
items.abstract_en: Interfacial coupling in van der Waals two-dimensional (2D) heterostructures offers an effective route to tailor the electronic, optical, and magnetic properties of materials. Versatile control and precise engineering of such interlayer interactions can be further achieved through external parameters, like electric field, magnetic field, optical excitation, as well as layer stacking geometries. Here, we examined the magneto-optical properties of 2D semiconductor heterostructures made of antiferromagnetic CrSBr and a monolayer WS2, both of which host intriguing excitonic properties. We identified a type-II band alignment between these two layers and the magnetic proximity effects from CrSBr, manifested by an enhanced Zeeman valley splitting in the WS2 layer. The interlayer charge transfer shows strong spin selectivity and is governed by the relative alignment between the valley-spin polarization of photoexcited carriers in WS2 and the magnetization in CrSBr, giving rise to spin-sensitive circularly polarized photoluminescence (PL) from WS2. Furthermore, the highly anisotropic electronic dispersion in CrSBr enables stacking-dependent control of interlayer interactions, as inferred from a twist-angle dependence of PL quenching. Our work establishes a highly tunable 2D system that integrates valleytronics and magnetic excitons through multiple coupling channels, opening up new opportunities in all-optical manipulation of spin and magnon states and for the development of flexible spin-optoelectronic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 范德华二维（2D）异质结构中的界面耦合为定制材料的电子、光学和磁性质提供了一条有效途径。此类层间相互作用的多功能控制和精确工程化还可通过外部参数进一步实现，如电场、磁场、光激发以及层堆叠几何结构。在这里，我们研究了由反铁磁 CrSBr 和单层 WS2 构成的二维半导体异质结构的磁光性质，二者都具有引人注目的激子性质。我们确定了这两层之间的 II 型能带对齐以及来自 CrSBr 的磁邻近效应，表现为 WS2 层中增强的塞曼谷分裂。层间电荷转移表现出强自旋选择性，并由 WS2 中光激发载流子的谷-自旋极化与 CrSBr 中磁化之间的相对对齐所支配，从而产生来自 WS2 的自旋敏感圆偏振光致发光（PL）。此外，CrSBr 中高度各向异性的电子色散使得层间相互作用可通过堆叠依赖的方式控制，这从 PL 猝灭的扭转角依赖性可以推断。我们的工作建立了一个高度可调的二维系统，通过多个耦合通道整合谷电子学和磁性激子，为自旋和磁振子态的全光操控以及柔性自旋光电子器件的发展开辟了新机会。
