items.title_en: WeatherDreamer: Learning a World Model from Multimodal Earth Observations
items.title_zh: WeatherDreamer：从多模态地球观测中学习世界模型
items.abstract_en: Machine learning weather models now rival operational global forecasts but still start from analyses produced by separate, expensive data assimilation (DA) systems, which for global models are typically updated every six hours. Observation-to-observation models avoid this dependence, but most omit the recursive filtering cycle that lets DA systems carry a background state through sparse, irregular observations. We introduce WeatherDreamer, a world model that learns this cycle end-to-end from 18 global observing systems, without reanalysis. It infers a latent state from observations, carries it forward hour by hour with learned dynamics, corrects it each hour with new observations, and can predict what any of its observing systems would measure at any location. At held-out stations, its ensembles beat NOAA's Global Ensemble Forecast System (GEFS) for temperature, dew point and wind out to 12 h and are better calibrated than GEFS and the ECMWF ensemble. Precipitation, cloud-top height and solar irradiance, never inputs at inference, are inferred with skill matching or exceeding operational products at short leads. Against the first guess of NOAA's Gridpoint Statistical Interpolation (GSI) DA system, WeatherDreamer's short-range departures are within 10% of GSI's at surface stations and within 25% for moisture-sensitive microwave channels, but up to five times larger for temperature-sounding channels. Never given observation errors, its learned update assumes errors close to known instrument and retrieval errors of microwave sounders and scatterometer winds. WeatherDreamer also separates viewing geometry from atmospheric state, recovering 83-96% of observed limb darkening and producing seamless nadir-view imagery. Producing an hourly global analysis in about 1.5 minutes on one GPU, WeatherDreamer shows that assimilation and forecasting can be learned together directly from observations.
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习天气模型如今可与业务全球预报相媲美，但仍从由单独的、昂贵的数据同化（DA）系统生成的分析场出发，而全球模型的这类分析场通常每六小时更新一次。观测到观测模型避免了这种依赖，但大多数省略了让 DA 系统通过稀疏、不规则观测携带背景状态的递归滤波循环。我们提出 WeatherDreamer，一个完全端到端地从 18 个全球观测系统学习这一循环、无需再分析的世界模型。它从观测推断潜状态，用学习到的动力学逐小时向前携带，每小时用新观测校正，并能预测其任一观测系统在任一位置会测量到什么。在留出站点上，其集合预报在温度、露点和风方面到 12 小时优于 NOAA 的全球集合预报系统（GEFS），并且比 GEFS 和 ECMWF 集合校准得更好。降水、云顶高度和太阳辐照度在推理时从未作为输入，却在短期预报中以达到或超过业务产品的技巧被推断出来。相对于 NOAA 网格点统计插值（GSI）DA 系统的初猜，WeatherDreamer 的短程离差在地面站点上处于 GSI 的 10% 以内，在湿度敏感微波通道上处于 25% 以内，但在温度探测通道上高达五倍。从未给定观测误差，其学习到的更新所假设的误差接近微波探测器和散射计风场已知的仪器与反演误差。WeatherDreamer 还将观测几何与大气状态分离，恢复了观测到的 83-96% 临边昏暗，并生成无缝天底视角图像。在一块 GPU 上约 1.5 分钟生成逐小时全球分析，WeatherDreamer 表明同化和预报可以直接从观测中一起学习。

items.title_en: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
items.title_zh: 通过设计保障多智能体系统安全
items.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体系统通过将复杂任务分解为子任务、将子任务委派给智能体，并使用聚合规则聚合智能体的响应来求解复杂任务。恶意智能体可以通过对其分配的子任务提供恶意响应来操纵最终解。在本文中，我们首先提出响应操纵攻击（ReMA），它迭代优化恶意响应以最大化攻击有效性。具体而言，我们将无目标和有目标攻击表述为优化问题，并开发一种方法，通过基于替代多智能体系统的反馈迭代细化恶意响应来近似求解这些问题。为了防御此类攻击，我们进一步提出 SecMAS，这是一种安全聚合规则，利用智能体响应之间的语义相似性，选择与足够大的其他响应子集最一致的响应。我们从理论上建立了 SecMAS 针对无目标和有目标攻击的安全保证。大量评估表明，现有聚合规则易受 ReMA 攻击，而 SecMAS 能有效防御所有评估的攻击，包括 ReMA 的自适应变体，同时保持与现有聚合规则相当的效用。

items.title_en: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
items.title_zh: 在仿真中训练推理模型以原生使用真实机器人
items.abstract_en: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. We build a Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR) and use it to train the model on simulated robot tasks at scale with robot-use reinforcement learning (RURL), mirroring how frontier models acquire computer use. We find that the skills acquired in simulation generalize well beyond the training tasks: they transfer to an unseen robot, to the real world, and to novel instructions. After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, the model succeeds in 60% of our trials on a real dual-arm robot, whereas the base model succeeds in none. On LIBERO, training raises the success rate from 1.6% to 74.4%, approaching GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on demonstrations, our model is substantially more robust to changes in the task itself. On LIBERO-Pro, $π_{0.5}$ succeeds in only 0.75% of episodes when assigned a new task in a familiar scene whereas our model succeeds in 57.4%. Finally, the model retains its general capabilities, with no measurable degradation on nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks. These results highlight robot-use reinforcement learning as a promising component of foundation-model post-training.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人使用智能体（RUA）已成为通用机器人控制的一种有前景的方法。然而，迄今为止，强性能仅由 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.2 等前沿专有模型实现，而开放权重模型的能力仍明显较弱。我们表明，一个开放权重的 27B 推理模型可以通过强化学习被训练为原生使用真实机器人，整个过程完全在仿真中进行且无需示范。像计算机使用智能体（CUA）一样，该模型观察环境，在思维链中推理，并生成下一个末端执行器位姿，无需任何封装框架。我们构建了面向智能体机器人的后训练引擎（PEAR），并使用它通过机器人使用强化学习（RURL）在大规模仿真机器人任务上训练该模型，仿照前沿模型获得计算机使用能力的方式。我们发现，在仿真中获得的技能能很好地泛化到训练任务之外：它们可迁移到未见过的机器人、真实世界和新指令。在仿真中的 LIBERO 和 RoboDojo 上训练后，该模型在真实双臂机器人上的试验中成功率达到 60%，而基础模型成功率为零。在 LIBERO 上，训练将成功率从 1.6% 提高到 74.4%，在最大推理努力下接近 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol。与在示范上微调的视觉-语言-动作模型 π0.5 相比，我们的模型对任务本身的变化要稳健得多。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，当在熟悉场景中被分配新任务时，π0.5 仅在 0.75% 的回合中成功，而我们的模型成功率为 57.4%。最后，该模型保留了其通用能力，在九项推理、编码和视觉基准上没有可测量的退化。这些结果突显了机器人使用强化学习作为基础模型后训练一个有前景组成部分的潜力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否优化预训练神经网络权重？YOLO26目标检测中无梯度编辑的多阶段实证评估
items.abstract_en: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.
items.abstract_zh: 直接权重编辑为微调预训练检测器提供了一种无梯度替代方案，但其泛化性以及大型语言模型（LLM）指导的价值仍不确定。我们使用YOLO26模型和MS COCO评估五个实验阶段，将确定性缩放、随机扰动、差分进化、CMA-ES、结构化干预、真实本地LLM提议、失败感知指导以及混合LLM-CMA-ES与匹配的随机策略对照进行比较。优化使用原生Ultralytics mAP50-95，在1,000张COCO Val2017图像上进行；入选候选在一个不相交、此前已检查的1,500张图像子集上评估，并在可获得时单独报告COCO API AP50-95。将CMA-ES预算从8次评估增加到250次评估，使开发集增益从+0.11个百分点提高到+0.28个百分点，而选择变化仍为负值（-0.03至-0.12个百分点）；250次评估的结果使用一个随机种子。混合LLM方法未显示出相对于随机策略指导的统计学确立优势（预算8、25和50时p = 0.612、0.369和0.694）。五种子YOLO26m重复实验得到COCO API AP差异为+0.004个百分点（95% CI：-0.026至+0.034）。在225个存档LLM提议中，53个满足最终严格模式；早期张量级执行无法完全验证。真正的LLM介导权重编辑是可行的，但所测试方法未证明在开发子集之外具有一致迁移性或可测量的LLM优势。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Multimodal private information and reward value shape information use during ant foraging
items.title_zh: 多模态私有信息和奖励价值塑造蚂蚁觅食过程中的信息使用
items.abstract_en: Animals use both private information acquired through experience and social information produced by conspecifics when making behavioural decisions. The combination of sensory cues and their associated reward value may influence how animals weigh private information against social information. We investigated information use during foraging in the ant Pristomyrmex punctatus using Y-maze experiments with learned visual and olfactory cues and trail pheromones. Workers learned both types of private cue and showed no significant preference between them when they were placed in conflict. When private information conflicted with a high-concentration pheromone trail, workers preferred the pheromone-marked route following visual, olfactory or multimodal training. At a lower pheromone concentration, route choice depended on training modality: workers trained with either unimodal cue preferred the pheromone trail, whereas workers trained with multimodal cues (combined visual and olfactory cues) showed no significant preference between the routes. When learned visual and olfactory cues were placed in conflict, workers favoured the cue paired with the higher sucrose concentration under both reciprocal reward assignments. In contrast, workers still preferred a pheromone trail when it had been associated with a lower-quality reward than the competing multimodal cues. These results show that ants adjust their use of learned private information according to expected reward and suggest that multimodal private information can influence the balance between private and social information during foraging.
items.abstract_zh: 动物在做出行为决策时，既使用通过经验获得的私有信息，也使用同种个体产生的社会信息。感官线索及其相关奖励价值的组合可能影响动物如何权衡私有信息与社会信息。我们利用Y型迷宫实验，结合学习获得的视觉和嗅觉线索以及路径信息素，研究蚂蚁Pristomyrmex punctatus觅食过程中的信息使用。工蚁学会了两种私有线索，并在二者发生冲突时对它们没有显著偏好。当私有信息与高浓度信息素路径冲突时，经过视觉、嗅觉或多模态训练的工蚁偏好信息素标记的路线。在较低信息素浓度下，路线选择取决于训练模态：接受任一单模态线索训练的工蚁偏好信息素路径，而接受多模态线索（视觉和嗅觉线索组合）训练的工蚁在两条路线之间没有显著偏好。当学习获得的视觉和嗅觉线索发生冲突时，在两种互换奖励分配下，工蚁都偏好与较高蔗糖浓度配对的线索。相反，当信息素路径与质量低于竞争性多模态线索的奖励相关联时，工蚁仍偏好信息素路径。这些结果表明，蚂蚁根据预期奖励调整对学习获得的私有信息的使用，并提示多模态私有信息可影响觅食过程中私有信息与社会信息之间的平衡。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Optical Representation Neural Networks Enabled by Weakly Supervised Learning
items.title_zh: 弱监督学习赋能的光学表示神经网络
items.abstract_en: Diffractive optical neural networks (ONNs) show remarkable promise in high-speed and energy-efficient optical computing. However, most existing ONNs are optimized to reproduce predefined output intensity distributions, with the desired optical responses explicitly specified before training. Here, we introduce optical representation neural networks (ORNNs) enabled by coarse-grained weak supervision. Using handwritten Devanagari, Arabic, and English characters as three semantic groups, a modified contrastive objective encourages samples from the same script to cluster into similar optical representations. Remarkably, ORNNs improve the classification accuracy by approximately 9% over conventional supervised ONNs, while requiring only around 18% of the training steps to reach a stable test accuracy of 84.5%. These features can be selectively interpreted using corresponding semantic decoders. Building on this concept, we further realized semantic optical encryption with electronic neural network (ENN) decryption using experimentally acquired representations from a single-layer diffractive network fabricated by two-photon polymerization lithography (TPL). Here, we combine information from different scripts into a mixed optical ciphertext that is then first optically classified before being decrypted with a matched ENN. This work broadens the training paradigm of ONNs by coupling upstream optical representation learning with downstream task-specific decoding, opening new avenues for optical information processing.
items.abstract_zh: 衍射光学神经网络（ONN）在高速度和节能光学计算中展现出显著前景。然而，大多数现有ONN被优化以复现预定义的输出强度分布，所需光学响应在训练前被明确指定。在此，我们提出由粗粒度弱监督实现的光学表示神经网络（ORNN）。以手写天城文、阿拉伯文和英文字符作为三个语义组，一种改进的对比目标鼓励来自同一文字的样本聚类为相似的光学表示。值得注意的是，ORNN相较传统监督ONN将分类准确率提高约9%，同时仅需约18%的训练步骤即可达到84.5%的稳定测试准确率。这些特征可使用相应语义解码器进行选择性解释。基于这一概念，我们进一步利用由双光子聚合光刻（TPL）制造的单层衍射网络经实验获取的表示，实现了语义光学加密并用电子神经网络（ENN）解密。在此，我们将来自不同文字的信息组合成混合光学密文，该密文先经过光学分类，再使用匹配的ENN进行解密。这项工作通过将上游光学表示学习与下游任务特定解码耦合，拓宽了ONN的训练范式，为光学信息处理开辟了新途径。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: PACT: A Decoder-Confidence-Guided Two-Round Receiver for Joint Channel and Phase-Noise Estimation in Sub-THz OFDM
items.title_zh: PACT：一种用于亚太赫兹OFDM中联合信道与相位噪声估计的解码器置信度引导两轮接收机
items.abstract_en: Frequency-selective fading and oscillator phase noise (PN) jointly impair coded sub-THz OFDM reception. We propose a decoder-confidence-guided two-round receiver combining a {pilot-aware complex transformer} (PACT) estimator, banded linear minimum mean-square error equalization, and neural normalized min-sum decoding. PACT jointly estimates the frequency-domain channel and effective time-domain PN through interacting complex-valued branches. Decoder-derived pseudo-pilots and continuous constellation-aware confidence guide second-round refinement through PACT inputs and attention, with parameters shared across rounds. At $E_b/N_0=30$~dB, the PACT receiver achieves approximately $70\%$ and $57\%$ lower code-block error rates than the best-performing learning-based baseline in the two benchmark settings, respectively. Frozen-weight tests further demonstrate applicability across channel/PN models, carrier frequencies, and FFT/bandwidth configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 频率选择性衰落和振荡器相位噪声（PN）共同损害编码亚太赫兹OFDM接收。我们提出一种解码器置信度引导的两轮接收机，结合导频感知复数Transformer（PACT）估计器、带状线性最小均方误差均衡和神经归一化最小和解码。PACT通过相互作用的复值分支联合估计频域信道和有效时域PN。解码器导出的伪导频和连续星座感知置信度通过PACT输入和注意力引导第二轮细化，且参数在各轮之间共享。在$E_b/N_0=30$~dB时，PACT接收机在两种基准设置下分别比表现最佳的学习型基线实现约$70\%$和$57\%$更低的码块错误率。冻结权重测试进一步证明其适用于不同信道/PN模型、载波频率以及FFT/带宽配置。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
items.title_zh: 基准不会回应：通过自我分歧学习
items.abstract_en: A benchmark usually measures a language model alone with a question, and deployment rarely looks like that: answers get contested, and models give up correct ones under counter-reasoning that is itself wrong. We show that what fails there is not a shortfall of accuracy but a capability in its own right -- knowing when to hold a position and when to yield to a better one -- which we call dialectical competence. It stands on first-answer accuracy without following from it: a model can be made materially better at answering and no better at this, and training for accuracy alone can drift against it. Nor can it be bought at inference, by self-reflection or by sampling more. Taking a cue from the dialectical tradition in philosophy, in which productive opposition arises within a position rather than being imposed on it from outside, we hypothesize that this capability can be trained from opposition the model supplies itself. It states a position, generates the strongest case against that position -- its antithesis -- rules on whether the case stands, and is trained on that ruling, with no second model at training or at deployment. We call this learning through Self-Disagreement: reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards throughout, where the same check that scores an answer against its reference scores the ruling too, so no reward model, no preference data and no human annotation enter anywhere. The capability is trained rather than elicited: weak in the base model, it arrives with the reward, is not paid for out of first-answer accuracy, and holds against challengers the model never trained against, including ones stronger than itself. The opposition a model needs in order to improve, it turns out, need not come from outside it.
items.abstract_zh: 基准通常只用一个问题单独衡量语言模型，而部署很少如此：答案会受到质疑，模型会在本身错误的逆向推理下放弃正确答案。我们表明，在那里失败的不是准确率不足，而是一种本身独立的能力——知道何时坚持立场、何时让位于更好的立场——我们称之为辩证能力。它建立在首答准确率之上，但并不由后者推出：一个模型可以在回答上显著变好，却在此能力上没有变好；仅以准确率为目标训练也可能使其漂移下降。它也无法在推理时通过自我反思或增加采样获得。受哲学中辩证传统的启发——其中富有成效的对立产生于一个立场内部，而不是从外部强加于它——我们假设这种能力可以从模型自身提供的对立中训练得到。模型陈述一个立场，生成反对该立场的最强论据——其反题——裁定该论据是否成立，并基于该裁定接受训练，训练或部署时都不需要第二个模型。我们将此称为通过自我分歧学习：全程采用可验证奖励的强化学习，其中用同一项检查既根据参考答案给答案打分，也给裁定打分，因此任何地方都不引入奖励模型、偏好数据或人工标注。该能力是被训练出来的，而非被诱导出来的：它在基础模型中很弱，随奖励出现，不以首答准确率为代价，并且能抵御模型从未训练对抗过的挑战者，包括比自身更强的挑战者。事实证明，模型为了改进所需要的对立，不必来自其外部。

items.title_en: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
items.title_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型：设计、训练与部署的全生命周期综述
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt web-pretrained vision-language models to output robot actions, so that web knowledge carries over to physical control. In under 4 years the field has moved from RT-2, the first VLA, to open models that fine-tune on a single consumer GPU and to proprietary generalists that clean unseen homes. This survey reviews 88 works from December 2022 to October 2026, mainly on manipulation and navigation, plus humanoid control, world-action models and evaluation. We follow a VLA through its life cycle, from model design to training and deployment, along seven axes. Model design covers (a) inputs and memory, what the model observes; (b) architecture, how its pipeline is built; (c) action output, how it produces motor commands; and (d) intermediate predictions, what else it predicts, from reasoning steps to future observations. Training covers (e) pretraining data, the mix of robot, web, human and simulated data, and (f) post-training, adaptation to the target robot. Deployment covers (g) real-time execution, keeping pace with the robot. We analyse 22 models on these axes and report their training data, model size, inference speed and hardware. Three trends emerge: (i) training data has broadened, from about 10,000 hours of teleoperated robot data ($π_0$) to 23,000 community-collected episodes (SmolVLA) and 20,000 hours of egocentric human video (GR00T N1.7); (ii) model sizes have split: most recent models have 3-7 billion parameters, while a new group under one billion runs on consumer GPUs; and (iii) generalist VLAs are emerging that handle both manipulation and navigation, such as UniVLA and Qwen-VLA. We also compare VLAs with world-action models, which predict future observations as well as actions. We review evidence that some VLAs with near-perfect benchmark scores fail when objects or the camera move slightly, and open up further research questions.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型把在网络数据上预训练的视觉-语言模型改造为输出机器人动作的模型，使网络知识迁移到物理控制中。不到四年，该领域已从首个 VLA 模型 RT-2 发展到可在单张消费级 GPU 上微调的开源模型，以及能在未见过的家庭中清理打扫的商业通用系统。本综述回顾了 2022 年 12 月至 2026 年 10 月间的 88 项工作，主要涉及操作与导航，并涵盖人形控制、世界-动作模型与评测。我们沿七个轴线，按照"模型设计—训练—部署"的生命周期考察 VLA：模型设计包括 (a) 输入与记忆，即模型观察到什么；(b) 架构，即流水线如何搭建；(c) 动作输出，即如何产生运动指令；(d) 中间预测，即除动作外还预测什么，从推理步骤到未来观测。训练包括 (e) 预训练数据，即机器人、网络、人类与仿真数据的配比；(f) 后训练，即对目标机器人的适配。部署包括 (g) 实时执行，即如何跟上机器人的节奏。我们沿这些轴线分析了 22 个模型，并报告其训练数据、模型规模、推理速度与硬件。三条趋势浮现：(i) 训练数据不断拓宽，从约 1 万小时的遥操作机器人数据（π0）到 2.3 万条社区采集的片段（SmolVLA）以及 2 万小时的第一人称人类视频（GR00T N1.7）；(ii) 模型规模出现分化，近期多数模型为 30 亿至 70 亿参数，同时出现了一批可在消费级 GPU 上运行、参数量低于 10 亿的新模型；(iii) 同时处理操作与导航的通用 VLA 正在出现，如 UniVLA 与 Qwen-VLA。我们还比较了 VLA 与世界-动作模型（后者同时预测未来观测与动作）。
items.highlight_zh: 沿七大轴线梳理 88 篇 VLA 工作，揭示数据拓宽与规模分化
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型把已经在网络图文数据上训练好的视觉-语言模型改造成能直接输出机器人动作的控制器，相当于让"懂网络知识的大脑"去驱动身体。这个方向从 2022 年底的 RT-2 起步，不到四年就出现了能在单张消费显卡上微调的开源模型，以及能在陌生家庭里打扫的商用通用系统。技术演进极快，亟需一份系统的梳理。
【用了什么方法】作者按"生命周期"组织综述，回顾 2022 年 12 月至 2026 年 10 月的 88 项工作，主要覆盖操作与导航，兼顾人形控制、世界-动作模型与评测。他们设了七条分析轴线：模型设计四个方面——输入与记忆（模型看到什么）、架构（流水线如何搭建）、动作输出（如何生成运动指令）、中间预测（是否额外预测推理步骤或未来画面）；训练两个方面——预训练数据配比（机器人、网络、人类、仿真数据如何混合）与后训练（如何适配到目标机器人）；部署一个方面——实时执行（能否跟上机器人的控制频率）。并在这些轴线上对 22 个具体模型做了横向对比，列出训练数据、模型规模、推理速度和硬件。
【有什么结果】三条趋势：一是训练数据快速拓宽，从 π0 约 1 万小时遥操作数据，到 SmolVLA 的 2.3 万条社区采集片段，再到 GR00T N1.7 的 2 万小时第一人称人类视频；二是模型规模分化，多数新模型为 30 亿至 70 亿参数，另有一批小于 10 亿参数、可在消费级 GPU 上运行的模型；三是同时胜任操作与导航的通用 VLA 开始出现，如 UniVLA、Qwen-VLA。综述还把 VLA 与"世界-动作模型"（同时预测未来观测和动作）作了对比。
【为何重要】它为想快速进入该领域的研究者和工程师提供了一张按设计、训练、部署分区的"地图"，帮助判断数据从哪来、模型该多大、能否实时跑，看清通用机器人基础模型的整体走向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。 这是综述或观点文献，应与可运行实现区分。

items.title_en: Rethinking Visual Reasoning in Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
items.title_zh: 重新思考文本到图像奖励建模中的视觉推理
items.abstract_en: Reward models are a core component of modern text-to-image systems, serving as the objective for inference-time selection and RL-based post-training. A key prerequisite is visual understanding: to judge prompt adherence and ground aesthetic preferences, a reward model must bind attributes, resolve relations, and count reliably. We find that widely-used reward models perform poorly on targeted visual reasoning evaluations. Even when starting from strong vision-language backbones, preference fine-tuning erodes these capabilities, and continual-learning baselines fail to mitigate a steep tradeoff between visual reasoning and preference accuracy. We propose a data-centric intervention that injects visual reasoning supervision into preference learning by flipping the pairing axis. To complement conventional human preference data (paired images under a shared prompt), we convert existing visual reasoning datasets into preference pairs that share the same image but differ in prompt, and train on the mixture. This yields a Pareto improvement in both visual understanding and preference prediction. Across inference-time best-of-n selection and RL post-training, the resulting reward model improves text-to-image generation on challenging compositional prompts (GenEval) by an average of 4.0% and 5.5% respectively, outperforming HPSv3 which was trained on 6x more preference pairs.
items.abstract_zh: 奖励模型是现代文本到图像系统的核心组件，作为推理时选择与基于强化学习的后训练的目标。一个关键前提是视觉理解：为了判断提示遵循度并建立审美偏好基础，奖励模型必须可靠地绑定属性、解析关系并进行计数。我们发现，广泛使用的奖励模型在针对性的视觉推理评估上表现不佳。即使从强视觉-语言骨干模型出发，偏好微调也会侵蚀这些能力，而持续学习基线无法缓解视觉推理与偏好准确率之间的陡峭权衡。我们提出一种以数据为中心的干预方法，通过翻转配对轴将视觉推理监督注入偏好学习。为补充传统人类偏好数据（同一提示下的成对图像），我们将现有视觉推理数据集转换为共享同一图像但提示不同的偏好对，并在混合数据上训练。这在视觉理解和偏好预测上均带来帕累托改进。在推理时 best-of-n 选择与 RL 后训练中，所得奖励模型分别在具有挑战性的组合式提示（GenEval）上将文本到图像生成平均提高 4.0% 和 5.5%，优于在 6 倍更多偏好对上训练的 HPSv3。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Expanded ME-model analysis capabilities enable genetic recoding, proteostasis, RNA decay, and cofactor essentiality in bacterial models
items.title_zh: 扩展的 ME 模型分析能力可在细菌模型中实现遗传重编码、蛋白质稳态、RNA 降解与辅因子必需性分析
items.abstract_en: Genome-scale metabolic models (M-models) are widely used to understand and manipulate microbial metabolism in silico, and are characterized by an extensive availability of automated reconstruction, analysis tools, and simulation software. The scope and accuracy of M-models was greatly improved by the development of metabolic and gene expression models (ME-models) aimed to infer the optimal allocation of individual macromolecules such as proteins, RNA, and enzymatic complexes which constrain metabolic fluxes to their availability and abundance. Although ME-models reconstruction and simulation is currently aided by open-source software such as coralME, COBRAme, ECOLIme, and solveME, they lag behind their M-model counterparts and lack formal analysis tools such as gene essentiality analysis, that would facilitate a broader adoption of ME-models in research. Moreover, the rigid and incomplete formulation of ME-models limit advanced analyses they are theoretically capable of, including the simulation of genomically recoded organisms, protein homeostasis, enzyme cofactor essentiality, and RNA decay. Here, we present coralME v1.3, a vastly improved software version aimed to expand the applicability of ME-models by adding support for translation of non-canonical amino acids, protein and RNA degradation reactions, use of arbitrary coupling coefficients and parameter values, and formalized gene and cofactor essentiality analyses. This work expands, formalizes, and streamlines ME-model reconstruction and analyses for applied research.
items.abstract_zh: 基因组尺度代谢模型（M 模型）广泛用于在计算机中理解和操控微生物代谢，其特点是具有大量可用的自动化重建、分析工具和仿真软件。旨在推断蛋白质、RNA 和酶复合物等单个大分子的最优分配——这些大分子通过其可用性和丰度约束代谢通量——的代谢与基因表达模型（ME 模型）的发展，极大提升了 M 模型的范围和准确性。尽管 ME 模型的重建和仿真目前得到 coralME、COBRAme、ECOLIme 和 solveME 等开源软件的支持，但它们落后于相应的 M 模型，并缺乏正式分析工具（如基因必需性分析），这会妨碍 ME 模型在研究中的更广泛采用。此外，ME 模型严格且不完整的表述限制了其理论上能够进行的高级分析，包括对基因组重编码生物、蛋白质稳态、酶辅因子必需性和 RNA 降解的仿真。在此，我们提出 coralME v1.3，一个大幅改进的软件版本，旨在通过增加对非经典氨基酸翻译、蛋白质和 RNA 降解反应、任意耦合系数和参数值的使用以及形式化基因和辅因子必需性分析的支持，扩展 ME 模型的适用性。这项工作为应用研究扩展、形式化并简化了 ME 模型的重建与分析。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 区分计算预测、回顾性分析与实验验证；不把模型输出作为临床结论，数据和权重许可需单独核对。

items.title_en: Digital Coherent Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution with Gaussian-Modulated Coherent States
items.title_zh: 使用高斯调制相干态的数字相干双场量子密钥分发
items.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables information-theoretically secure key sharing between two distant parties. Recently, one promising QKD protocol which can distribute a secret key over long distances called twin-field QKD (TF-QKD) has been developed. However, it requires active compensation for experimental imperfections such as phase, polarization, and frequency fluctuations with expensive devices and this makes its experimental implementation challenging. Here, we propose a long-distance continuous-variable QKD (CV-QKD) protocol which is inspired by TF-QKD. Our protocol can remove these requirements by using Gaussian-modulated coherent states and digital signal processing which is widely used in recent digital coherent optical communication and experimental implementations of CV-QKD. For security analysis, we use a numerical optimization approach with a photon-number cutoff assumption. We propose a new set of constraints for numerical optimization which can efficiently constrain a highly non-Gaussian quantum state shared by two legitimate parties in our protocol. We show that the key rate of our protocol exceeds the key rate of a direct-transmission CV-QKD protocol at long distances and it can overcome the repeaterless bound.
items.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）使两个相距遥远的参与方能够共享信息论安全的密钥。最近，一种有前景的、可在长距离上分发密钥的 QKD 协议——双场 QKD（TF-QKD）——已被开发出来。然而，它需要使用昂贵设备对相位、偏振和频率波动等实验缺陷进行主动补偿，这使其实验实现具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出一种受 TF-QKD 启发的长距离连续变量 QKD（CV-QKD）协议。我们的协议通过使用高斯调制相干态以及数字信号处理（广泛应用于近期数字相干光通信和 CV-QKD 实验实现中）能够消除这些要求。对于安全性分析，我们使用带有光子数截断假设的数值优化方法。我们提出了一组新的数值优化约束，可以有效地约束我们协议中两个合法参与方共享的高度非高斯量子态。我们表明，我们的协议的密钥率在长距离上超过直接传输 CV-QKD 协议的密钥率，并且能够克服无中继界限。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Linear Dynamic Range Extension for Rydberg Atomic Receiver via Band-Limited Reconstruction
items.title_zh: 通过带限重建扩展里德堡原子接收机的线性动态范围
items.abstract_en: Rydberg-atom receiver offers a promising approach to radio-frequency (RF) signal reception in wireless communication and sensing systems, combining high sensitivity with the potential for broad frequency coverage. However, the limited linear dynamic range (LDR) of the atomic system causes nonlinear distortion at high input signal levels, thereby restricting the receiver's effective linear input range. To address this issue, we analyze the mechanisms underlying nonlinear distortion in Rydberg atomic receivers and propose a physics-informed band-limited iterative reconstruction (PI-BLIR) method. Specifically, by exploiting the known nonlinear atomic response and signal bandwidth prior, we formulate a constrained maximum-likelihood problem to reconstruct the distorted complex intermediate-frequency (IF) waveform. With the bandwidth constraint absorbed into the frequency-domain parameterization, the constrained maximum-likelihood problem is transformed into an unconstrained optimization problem, which is solved using gradient descent. The proposed method relies solely on digital post-processing and requires no changes to the local-oscillator (LO) field strength, optical parameters, or atomic operating conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that PI-BLIR extends the receiver's LDR by more than 14 dB and enhances the demodulation performance of the atomic receiver.
items.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子接收机为无线通信和传感系统中的射频（RF）信号接收提供了一种有前景的方法，兼具高灵敏度与宽频率覆盖的潜力。然而，原子系统有限的线性动态范围（LDR）会在高输入信号电平下造成非线性失真，从而限制接收机的有效线性输入范围。为解决这一问题，我们分析了里德堡原子接收机中非线性失真的机制，并提出一种物理信息带限迭代重建（PI-BLIR）方法。具体而言，通过利用已知的非线性原子响应和信号带宽先验，我们构建一个约束最大似然问题，以重建失真的复中频（IF）波形。将带宽约束吸收到频域参数化中，约束最大似然问题被转化为无约束优化问题，并使用梯度下降求解。所提方法仅依赖数字后处理，无需改变本振（LO）场强、光学参数或原子工作条件。仿真结果表明，PI-BLIR 将接收机的 LDR 扩展超过 14 dB，并增强原子接收机的解调性能。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
items.title_zh: 学习扩散语言模型何时应重新生成
items.abstract_en: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
items.abstract_zh: 重掩码使扩散语言模型能够重新审视已生成的文本，但有效纠正需要知道何时以及修改什么。我们在数独上的诊断揭示了两点差距。隐藏状态包含错误信息，而 token 置信度不能可靠地暴露这些信息；并且，在周围上下文保持不变时，对孤立错误进行重掩码通常会重现该错误。这些发现促成了 DiVR，一个预测部分生成的序列是否会得到正确答案的验证器。DiVR 在模型自身轨迹的最终正确性上训练，决定何时重新生成一个块以及保留哪个替代项，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 上的五个推理基准中，DiVR 以贪心解码的 1.9–3.5 倍成本，将微调生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提高到 43.4%，高于使用 3.8–7.4 倍成本的搜索基线。它还能补充监督微调和强化学习等后训练，并可泛化到其他生成器，包括 Dream。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Objectives as Policies: Vision-Language Model Cost Programs for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.title_zh: 目标即策略：面向接触丰富操作的视觉-语言模型成本程序
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong semantic and spatial reasoning capabilities in 3D environments. Recently, connecting VLMs with model-predictive controllers (MPC) has emerged as a paradigm for combining strong semantic reasoning with physics-based planning. However, connecting these two for contact-rich robotic manipulation requires a task representation that bridges the two and captures how physical interactions can be reasoned by VLMs. In this work, we introduce Objectives as Policies (OaP), a framework that connects a pretrained VLM to a shared sampling-based MPC through an editable objective program. Each program specifies a sequence of stages for completing a task, combining running and terminal costs from a cost library with stage completion conditions. Given a natural-language task instruction and scene observation, we build a simulation-based digital twin through real-to-sim, and the VLM generates an objective program that is executed by the MPC in the simulation. The program is iteratively updated by the VLM based on MPC rollouts, before being deployed in the real world. We evaluate our framework in both simulation and the real world on four tabletop manipulation tasks, and show that it outperforms strong baselines. Additional videos and examples are available on the project website: https://zihaolu001.github.io/oap-project/
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已在 3D 环境中展现出强大的语义和空间推理能力。最近，将 VLM 与模型预测控制器（MPC）连接，已成为结合强语义推理与基于物理的规划的一种范式。然而，将二者连接用于接触丰富的机器人操作，需要一种能够桥接二者并刻画 VLM 如何推理物理交互的任务表示。在这项工作中，我们提出 Objectives as Policies（OaP），一个通过可编辑目标程序将预训练 VLM 连接到共享的基于采样的 MPC 的框架。每个程序规定完成任务的一系列阶段，将来自成本库的运行成本和终端成本与阶段完成条件相结合。给定自然语言任务指令和场景观测，我们通过真实到仿真（real-to-sim）构建基于仿真的数字孪生，VLM 生成一个目标程序，由 MPC 在仿真中执行。该程序由 VLM 根据 MPC 推演进行迭代更新，然后部署到真实世界。我们在仿真和真实世界中对四个桌面操作任务评估该框架，并表明其优于强基线。更多视频和示例见项目网站：https://zihaolu001.github.io/oap-project/

items.title_en: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
items.title_zh: 第8届LSVOS挑战赛报告：移动统一多模态理解
items.abstract_en: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告总结了与ECCV 2026同期举办的第8届大规模视频目标分割（LSVOS）挑战赛中的移动统一多模态理解（MUMU）赛道。MUMU要求单一统一模型在0.5B参数和8 GB峰值推理内存的预算内，联合执行针对质量、场景和事件词表的多概念图像标注、开放词汇目标检测以及简洁图像描述。提交结果按加权任务分数乘以效率因子进行排名。我们描述了任务、规则与评估协议，报告最终结果，并回顾前三名团队的方法。三个领先方案均建立在紧凑的Florence-2-base模型之上，但以不同方式对其扩展：带跨任务推理细化的轻量标注头；在覆盖感知的多源数据上训练、并采用任务相关解码的共享低秩适配器；以及一个免训练流水线，将描述映射为标签并应用检测测试时增强。结果表明，当针对每个任务分别设计监督、解码和跨任务线索时，紧凑的基于提示的视觉-语言模型可以服务全部三类输出，而新类别上的开放词汇检测仍是主要瓶颈。

items.title_en: Genomic tessellations
items.title_zh: 基因组镶嵌
items.abstract_en: Periodicity is ubiquitous in genomic data. Assembled sequences are dense with homopolymers, microsatellites, and large satellite arrays, which contribute to phenotype, variation, and disease. Third-generation sequencing technologies, such as Oxford Nanopore (ONT) and PacBio HiFi, has enabled longer and increasingly accurate reads, but have brought with them systematic error biases in repetitive regions, where insertions and deletions can distort array lengths and mimic or obscure biological variation. This periodicity is not benign: local repetitiveness makes sequence alignment ambiguous and genome assembly error-prone. In sequence analysis, these two manifestations of periodicity are simultaneously at play, each compounding the challenges of the other; a unified representation of repetitive and non-repetitive sequence is necessary to account for their combined effects consistently. We propose a paradigm under which (either repetitive and non-repetitive) DNA is split into its identity (its irreducible components) and its geometry (how its components are realized). A genomic tessellation {tau} is a canonical factorization of any sequence S of length n over the DNA alphabet into a sequence of tiles partitioning S, where each t in {tau}S is described as a quasi-periodic run of a canonical unit identity ut with geometry consisting of span st, phase {varphi}t, and a set of exceptions Xt. We show that, for a prescribed error bound k [≥] 1 and fixed maximum unit length P, S can be tessellated in O(n) time such that every tile has a unique identity whose periodic expansion differs from the tiled sequence by at most k edits, and that tiles sharing an identity are related by a bounded number of geometric adjustments. We introduce the tessellated Burrows-Wheeler transform (tBWT), which indexes {tau}S by concatenating, over all tiles in order, the identity ut of each tile. For a tessellated query q of m tiles, the tBWT counts the repeat-agnostic occurrences of q in O(m) time, and for sampling interval r locates its h occurrences in {tau}S in O(m + hr) time. We demonstrate that tessellations avoid the well-known speed-accuracy tradeoff and outperform state-of-the-art long-read mappers in repeat-dense regions in both speed and accuracy. On a 20x simulated set of both ONT and HiFi reads on the HG002 maternal X chromosome with synthetically-expanded repeat arrays, locating and chaining exact tile identity matches obtained from the tBWT is up to 57x and 83x faster, respectively, than the state-of-the-art mappers minimap2 and Winnowmap2, with comparable accuracy. Furthermore, by abstracting away differences in geometry, tessellations of a set of input sequences onto itself (an autotessellation) reveals homology otherwise obscured by array-length variation and local sequence divergence. A geometry-only polishing of an an ONT-only assembly of the HG002 maternal X chromosome with [~]50x PacBio HiFi reads improves assembly QV from 45.4 to 60.6 in under a minute using less than 10GB of memory. Tessellated-read evidence over the autotessellation of this assembly organizes 167 mitochondrial contigs totaling [~]4 Mbp into a single family with a [~]16.5kbp representative, which aligns to the HG002 Q100 mitochondrial genome with 100% identity. Genomic tessellations provide a canonical representation of repetitive and non-repetitive DNA and enable efficient sequence analyses while preserving homology.
items.abstract_zh: 周期性在基因组数据中无处不在。组装序列中密集分布着同聚物、微卫星和大型卫星阵列，它们对表型、变异和疾病均有贡献。Oxford Nanopore（ONT）和PacBio HiFi等第三代测序技术使读长更长且日益准确，但也带来了重复区域中的系统性错误偏倚，其中插入和缺失可扭曲阵列长度，并模拟或掩盖生物学变异。这种周期性并非无害：局部重复性使序列比对变得模糊，使基因组组装易于出错。在序列分析中，周期性的这两种表现同时起作用，彼此加剧对方的挑战；需要对重复与非重复序列进行统一表示，才能一致地考虑二者的联合效应。我们提出一种范式，将DNA（无论重复还是非重复）拆分为其身份（其不可约组分）与其几何（其组分如何实现）。基因组镶嵌 {tau} 是将DNA字母表上长度为n的任意序列S规范分解为划分S的瓦片（tile）序列，其中{tau}S中的每个t被描述为规范单元身份ut的准周期连续段，其几何由跨度st、相位{varphi}t和异常集合Xt构成。我们证明，对于给定误差界k [≥] 1和固定的最大单元长度P，S可在O(n)时间内被镶嵌，使得每个瓦片具有唯一身份，其周期展开与瓦片序列至多相差k处编辑，且共享同一身份的瓦片之间通过有界次数的几何调整相关联。我们引入镶嵌Burrows-Wheeler变换（tBWT），它通过对所有瓦片按顺序拼接每个瓦片的身份ut来索引{tau}S。对于由m个瓦片组成的镶嵌查询q，tBWT在O(m)时间内统计q的与重复无关的出现次数，并在采样间隔r下于O(m + hr)时间内定位其在{tau}S中的h次出现。我们证明镶嵌避免了众所周知的速度—准确度权衡，并在重复密集区域于速度和准确度两方面均优于最先进的长读长比对器。在HG002母源X染色体上、含人工扩展重复阵列的20x模拟ONT和HiFi读长集合中，对从tBWT获得的精确瓦片身份匹配进行定位与链接，分别比最先进的比对器minimap2和Winnowmap2快至多57倍和83倍，且准确度相当。此外，通过抽象掉几何差异，将一组输入序列镶嵌到自身（自镶嵌，autotessellation）可揭示原本被阵列长度变异和局部序列分歧所掩盖的同源性。使用约50x PacBio HiFi读长对HG002母源X染色体的仅ONT组装进行仅几何的抛光，在不到一分钟内、使用不到10GB内存，将组装QV从45.4提升到60.6。在该组装的自镶嵌上获得的镶嵌读长证据将总计约4 Mbp的167个线粒体contig组织为一个家族，其代表序列约16.5kbp，与HG002 Q100线粒体基因组以100%一致性比对。基因组镶嵌为重复和非重复DNA提供了规范表示，并在保留同源性的同时实现高效的序列分析。

items.title_en: Antihelical Edge States in Photonic Metacrystals
items.title_zh: 光子超晶中的反螺旋边缘态
items.abstract_en: Antihelical edge states represent a gapless form of boundary transport in which modes with opposite spin counterpropagate along a given boundary, while modes sharing the same spin propagate in the same direction on opposite boundaries. Here we show that such states arise naturally within a modified Kane-Mele framework realized in an electromagnetic-dual photonic metacrystal with staggered bianisotropy. Reversing the spin-dependent next-nearest-neighbor coupling on one sublattice reorganizes the bulk spectrum into a spin-polarized Dirac semimetal characterized by spin-dependent energy shifts of the Dirac cones rather than a bulk gap. This bulk reorganization generates tilted edge-mode dispersions in zigzag ribbons and gives rise to antihelical edge transport coexisting with bulk states. Full-wave simulations confirm the corresponding bulk and edge behaviors. Extending the analysis to finite geometries, simulations further reveal discrete corner-localized modes. A realistic design based on split-ring metaatoms is proposed to realize the required staggered bianisotropy and spin-dependent energy shifts of the Dirac cones. Furthermore, we show that the tensorial freedom of the bianisotropic constitutive relations enables continuous manipulation of the electromagnetic pseudospin basis while preserving the antihelical boundary transport. These results provide a practical route for engineering unconventional gapless boundary transport in photonic Dirac systems.
items.abstract_zh: 反螺旋边缘态代表一种无带隙的边界输运形式，其中自旋相反的模沿给定边界反向传播，而具有相同自旋的模在相对边界上沿同一方向传播。本文表明，这类态在修改的Kane-Mele框架内自然出现，该框架在具有交错双各向异性（staggered bianisotropy）的电磁对偶光子超晶中实现。在一个子格上反转自旋依赖的次近邻耦合，会将体谱重组为自旋极化狄拉克半金属，其特征是狄拉克锥的自旋依赖能量移动而非体能隙。这种体重组在锯齿形条带中产生倾斜的边缘模色散，并产生与体态共存的反螺旋边缘输运。全波模拟证实了相应的体态和边缘行为。将分析扩展到有限几何结构，模拟进一步揭示离散的角局域模。提出了一种基于开口环超原子的实际设计，以实现所需的交错双各向异性和狄拉克锥的自旋依赖能量移动。此外，我们表明双各向异性本构关系的张量自由度能够在保持反螺旋边界输运的同时连续操控电磁赝自旋基。这些结果为在光子狄拉克系统中工程化非常规的无带隙边界输运提供了实用途径。

items.title_en: DeltaVisionX: A Low-Cost Vision-Guided Automation System Using YOLOv11 and PLC-Based Actuation
items.title_zh: DeltaVisionX：一种使用YOLOv11与基于PLC驱动的低成本视觉引导自动化系统
items.abstract_en: This paper presents DeltaVisionX, a low-cost industrial automation system that integrates real-time computer vision with PLC-based actuation for object classification and sorting. The system uses the YOLOv11 (You Only Look Once) deep learning model to detect objects on an operating conveyor belt and communicates detection results to a Delta DVP-SE PLC, which actuates pneumatic pistons for sorting. A custom dataset was created, labeled, and augmented to train the YOLOv11 model, achieving a mean average precision of 0.97 with real-time inference of 100 ms per frame. Encoder-based tracking ensures reliable synchronization between detection and actuation, supporting a throughput of 80 objects per minute. Results show that affordable, locally developed automation can reduce labor dependency and improve manufacturing efficiency. The novelty of the proposed system lies in its encodersynchronized vision-PLC integration rather than in the detection model itself. Future work includes integrating a highspeed Delta robot with EtherCAT-based servo control for advanced pick-and-place operations.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出DeltaVisionX，一种低成本工业自动化系统，将实时计算机视觉与基于PLC的驱动相结合，用于目标分类与分拣。系统使用YOLOv11（You Only Look Once）深度学习模型检测运行中的传送带上的目标，并将检测结果传送给Delta DVP-SE PLC，由后者驱动气动活塞进行分拣。创建、标注并增强了一个自定义数据集以训练YOLOv11模型，达到0.97的平均精度均值，实时推理速度为每帧100 ms。基于编码器的跟踪确保检测与驱动之间的可靠同步，支持每分钟80个目标的分拣吞吐量。结果表明，可负担的本地开发自动化可降低对人工的依赖并提高制造效率。所提出系统的新颖性在于其编码器同步的视觉—PLC集成，而非检测模型本身。未来工作包括集成采用基于EtherCAT伺服控制的高速Delta机器人，以实现高级抓取放置操作。

items.title_en: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病中的形态学简化：基于连续语音的计算分析与识别
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech. This study asked which morphological features distinguish speakers with AD from healthy controls, how well morphology classifies AD compared with other linguistic levels and BERT-based models, and whether the signal exceeds transcript length and vocabulary. Method: Fifty-five automatic measures in eight families, seven of them new and theory-motivated, were computed from participant speech in the ADReSS Cookie Theft descriptions (78 AD, 78 controls) and analyzed with group comparisons, equivalence tests, SHAP, family ablation, likelihood-ratio tests, feature-selection classifiers, and BERT-based models. The automatic measures were validated manually, and models were transferred to two other corpora. Results: Nineteen of 38 measures differed between groups: speakers with AD produced fewer suffixed and inflected words, shorter verbs and nouns, and fewer present-progressive but more past-tense forms (largest effect r = -0.42), whereas errors were rare and statistically equivalent between groups. Eight measures survived adjustment for length and lexical frequency. With test-set feature selection, morphology reached a macro-F1 of 0.85, on par with syntax and above fine-tuned BERT (0.80 over five seeds); fully cross-validated selection gave 0.62. Adding morphology to BERT improved AUC (0.91 vs. 0.89) but not macro-F1. Transfer was limited, although two thirds of the effects kept their direction in mild cognitive impairment. Conclusions: AD connected speech shows morphological simplification and temporal reanchoring rather than breakdown. Morphology is more informative than its reputation suggests. Keywords: Alzheimer's disease; morphology; connected speech; ADReSS; inflection; tense and aspect; SHAP; machine learning; BERT
items.abstract_zh: 目的：形态学通常被认为在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中相对保留，且很少在连续语音中建模。本研究探究哪些形态特征可区分AD说话者与健康对照，形态学与其他语言层面以及基于BERT的模型相比在AD分类上的效果如何，以及该信号是否超出转录文本长度和词汇量的影响。方法：从ADReSS Cookie Theft描述任务中的参与者语音（78例AD，78例对照）计算八个家族共55个自动指标，其中七个为新的、有理论依据的指标，并采用组间比较、等效性检验、SHAP、家族消融、似然比检验、特征选择分类器和基于BERT的模型进行分析。自动指标经人工验证，模型被迁移至另外两个语料库。结果：38个指标中有19个在组间存在差异：AD说话者产生更少的带后缀词和屈折词、更短的动词和名词、更少的现在进行时但更多的过去时形式（最大效应r = -0.42），而错误很少且在组间统计等效。八个指标在对长度和词汇频率进行调整后仍然成立。在使用测试集特征选择时，形态学达到宏F1为0.85，与句法相当，并高于微调的BERT（五个随机种子平均0.80）；完全交叉验证的选择结果为0.62。将形态学加入BERT提高了AUC（0.91 vs. 0.89），但未提高宏F1。迁移效果有限，尽管三分之二的效应在轻度认知障碍中保持方向一致。结论：AD连续语音表现为形态学简化与时间重新锚定，而非崩溃。形态学比其声誉所暗示的更具信息量。关键词：阿尔茨海默病；形态学；连续语音；ADReSS；屈折；时与体；SHAP；机器学习；BERT

items.title_en: A Generalizable Approach to Safety-Aware Robotic Behavior Planning with an Explicit Constraint Space
items.title_zh: 具有显式约束空间的可泛化安全感知机器人行为规划方法
items.abstract_en: Large language and vision-language models have substantially advanced robotic behavior planning from natural-language instructions and visual observations. However, safe manipulation in tabletop environments remains challenging because the safety constraints required for a task depend on the surrounding scene and may not be explicitly specified in the instruction. We propose a safety-aware behavior planning framework based on an explicit Constraint Space that stores reusable textual safety rules. Rather than retrieving rules solely by semantic similarity, we formulate constraint selection as task- and environment-conditioned applicability learning. A lightweight query-conditioned dual-tower model identifies the constraints applicable to the current context, which are then provided together with the original task and image to a multimodal behavior planner. To handle incorrect constraint selections and previously unseen hazards, we introduce a multimodal Safety Inspector that evaluates generated primitive plans, reconstructs the complete applicable constraint set, and provides corrective planning feedback. Validated inspection feedback is further used for test-time adaptation of constraint applicability and parameter-efficient adaptation of the Safety Inspector through LoRA, while newly identified constraints are incorporated into the Constraint Space. The resulting framework integrates explicit safety knowledge representation,context-aware constraint selection, corrective safety inspection, and test-time knowledge adaptation for safety-aware robotic behavior planning.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型和视觉-语言模型已大幅推进了基于自然语言指令和视觉观测的机器人行为规划。然而，桌面环境中的安全操作仍具挑战性，因为任务所需的安全约束取决于周围场景，且可能未在指令中明确指定。我们提出一个基于显式约束空间的安全感知行为规划框架，该空间存储可复用的文本安全规则。我们不只按语义相似度检索规则，而是将约束选择形式化为以任务和环境为条件的适用性学习。一个轻量级的查询条件双塔模型识别适用于当前上下文的约束，随后这些约束与原始任务和图像一起提供给多模态行为规划器。为处理错误的约束选择和此前未见的危险，我们引入多模态安全检查器（Safety Inspector），它评估生成的原始计划、重建完整的适用约束集，并提供纠正性规划反馈。经校验的检查反馈进一步用于约束适用性的测试时自适应，以及通过LoRA对安全检查器进行参数高效自适应，同时新识别出的约束被纳入约束空间。由此形成的框架集成了显式安全知识表示、上下文感知的约束选择、纠正性安全检查以及测试时知识自适应，用于安全感知的机器人行为规划。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与观察方向相关的发射辐射度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机姿态的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何结构和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: N-terminal mutations R5L and R5H share a common mechanism in disrupting tau condensates on microtubule surfaces
items.title_zh: N端突变R5L和R5H在破坏微管表面tau凝聚物方面共享共同机制
items.abstract_en: Tau, an intrinsically disordered protein abundant in neuronal axons, forms cooperative condensates on microtubule (MT) surfaces that regulate motor proteins and protect MTs from severing enzymes. Disease-associated mutations at residue 5 in the N-terminal projection domain of tau, far from the MT-tau binding interface, have been linked to progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP) (R5L) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) (R5H). While R5L was previously shown to disrupt tau condensate formation on MT surfaces, it remained unclear whether R5H shares this phenotype. Using total internal reflection fluorescence (TIRF) microscopy, we show that both mutations reduce condensate packing density compared to WT tau under sub-saturating conditions at physiological pH (7.4), indicating impaired tau-tau cooperativity despite their distal location from the MT-tau binding interface. Single-molecule measurements further show both the dwell time and landing rate of tau within condensates are reduced while behavior on bare MTs remains unchanged, implicating weakened tau-tau cooperativity rather than disrupted binding to MTs. Strikingly, mutational analysis identifies the positive charge at residue 5 as critical for tau condensate formation: the charge-preserving R5K substitution retains WT-like behavior, whereas the charge-eliminating R5I substitution behaves like R5H/R5L. Further supporting this mechanism, R5H exhibits a pronounced pH dependence, transitioning from WT-like behavior at pH 6.4 to R5L-like behavior at pH 7.4 upon histidine deprotonation. Together, these findings establish that the positive charge at R5 is critical for tau condensate formation on MT surfaces and identify a common mechanism linking PSP and FTD.
items.abstract_zh: Tau是一种在神经元轴突中丰富存在的内在无序蛋白，它在微管（MT）表面形成协同凝聚物，调节马达蛋白并保护MT免受切割酶的作用。Tau的N端投影结构域第5位残基的疾病相关突变远离MT-tau结合界面，已被与进行性核上性麻痹（PSP）（R5L）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）（R5H）联系起来。虽然先前已表明R5L会破坏MT表面tau凝聚物的形成，但R5H是否共享这一表型仍不清楚。使用全内反射荧光（TIRF）显微镜，我们表明在生理pH（7.4）的亚饱和条件下，与WT tau相比，这两种突变均降低凝聚物堆积密度，表明尽管它们位于远离MT-tau结合界面的位置，tau-tau协同性仍受损。单分子测量进一步表明，tau在凝聚物内的驻留时间和着陆速率均降低，而在裸MT上的行为保持不变，提示tau-tau协同性减弱，而非与MT的结合被破坏。引人注目的是，突变分析确定第5位残基的正电荷对tau凝聚物形成至关重要：保留电荷的R5K替换保持类似WT的行为，而消除电荷的R5I替换表现得像R5H/R5L。进一步支持这一机制的是，R5H表现出显著的pH依赖性，在组氨酸去质子化后，从pH 6.4时的类似WT行为转变为pH 7.4时的类似R5L行为。总之，这些发现确立R5处的正电荷对MT表面tau凝聚物形成至关重要，并确定了一个连接PSP和FTD的共同机制。

items.title_en: An Inverse-Designed Multilayer Selective Emitter for High-Efficiency Thermophotovoltaics
items.title_zh: 用于高效热光伏的逆设计多层选择性发射器
items.abstract_en: High thermophotovoltaic (TPV) conversion efficiencies have typically relied on photovoltaic cells that reflect sub-bandgap radiation back toward the emitter. Here, we numerically investigate an alternative approach in which spectral selectivity is engineered primarily on the emitter side. We optimize an emitter consisting of 16-layer aperiodic MgO/Si coating on tungsten, for coupling to a GaSb cell with an antireflection coating and an Au mirror. A detailed-balance framework incorporates polarization- and angle-resolved emissivity, multiple reflections, and Auger nonradiative recombination. At an emitter temperature of 1500 K, the optimized structure suppresses 97.1% of the incident-blackbody-equivalent sub-bandgap power at the source; a further 1.9% is returned to the emitter by the cell, leaving 1.0% absorbed parasitically in the cell. The resulting modeled radiative-to-electrical conversion efficiency reaches 47.0%, compared with 30.8% for a SiC emitter paired with the same cell, while maintaining a comparable maximum electrical power density. These findings indicate that emitter-side spectral engineering could substantially relax cell-side photon-recycling requirements and provide significant improvement in TPV conversion.
items.abstract_zh: 高热光伏（TPV）转换效率通常依赖于将亚带隙辐射反射回发射器的光伏电池。在这里，我们从数值上研究一种替代方法，其中光谱选择性主要设计在发射器一侧。我们优化了一种由钨上16层非周期MgO/Si涂层组成的发射器，用于与带有抗反射涂层和Au反射镜的GaSb电池耦合。一个细致平衡框架纳入了偏振和角度分辨的发射率、多次反射以及俄歇非辐射复合。在发射器温度为1500 K时，优化结构在源处抑制了97.1%的入射黑体等效亚带隙功率；另有1.9%被电池返回给发射器，剩余1.0%寄生吸收于电池中。由此建模的辐射到电转换效率达到47.0%，而与同一电池配对的SiC发射器为30.8%，同时保持了相当的最大电功率密度。这些发现表明，发射器侧光谱工程可大幅放宽电池侧光子回收要求，并在TPV转换方面提供显著改进。

items.title_en: Classifier-Guided Latent Diffusion for Small-Molecule Generation
items.title_zh: 用于小分子生成的分类器引导潜扩散
items.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as a promising class of generative models for molecular design because of their ability to learn complex chemical distributions and support conditional or guided generation. In this work, we investigate a latent diffusion pipeline for property-guided small-molecule generation. The proposed framework represents canonicalized SMILES strings using a frozen ChemBERTa encoder, trains a Transformer-based decoder to reconstruct SELFIES strings from molecular latent embeddings, and learns an unconditional denoising diffusion model in the ChemBERTa latent space. To enable property-directed generation, a differentiable latent property predictor is used to guide the diffusion sampling process. Generated SELFIES strings are converted to SMILES, validated using RDKit, and evaluated using molecular validity, uniqueness, novelty, and predicted property scores. We study guidance toward two drug-relevant binary endpoints: blood--brain barrier permeability and inhibition of human $β$-secretase 1. The results suggest that latent diffusion over pretrained molecular embeddings can generate chemically valid and novel molecules while enabling controllable steering toward desired molecular properties.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散模型已成为分子设计中一类有前景的生成模型，因为它们能够学习复杂化学分布并支持条件或引导生成。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种用于性质引导小分子生成的潜扩散流程。所提出的框架使用冻结的ChemBERTa编码器表示规范化SMILES字符串，训练基于Transformer的解码器从分子潜在嵌入重建SELFIES字符串，并在ChemBERTa潜在空间中学习无条件去噪扩散模型。为实现性质导向生成，使用可微的潜在性质预测器来引导扩散采样过程。生成的SELFIES字符串被转换为SMILES，使用RDKit验证，并使用分子有效性、唯一性、新颖性和预测性质分数进行评估。我们研究了对两个药物相关二分类终点的引导：血脑屏障通透性和人β-分泌酶1抑制。结果表明，在预训练分子嵌入上的潜扩散可以生成化学上有效且新颖的分子，同时能够向所需分子性质进行可控引导。

items.title_en: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
items.title_zh: 预训练数据统计特性塑造语言模型中实体比较学习的阶段
items.abstract_en: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types. We begin with controlled experiments in which we train small LMs (163M parameters) on mixtures of natural text from pretraining corpora and synthetic task data. Our analysis identifies three distinct phases of learning: (1) an early phase where the LM selects entities by frequency, (2) a middle phase where the LM selects entities by position in the prompt (first vs. last mentioned entity), and (3) a late phase where the LM selects the entity that is the correct answer. We show that the emergence of these three phases is causally determined by statistical properties of the training data. With small amounts of task-specific synthetic data, we observe only the first two phases and the model fails to learn the task; with large amounts, the model jumps directly from the frequency-based heuristic to solving the task correctly. Moreover, changing the entity frequency distribution from a naturally occurring Zipfian distribution (a small number of entities are very common and the vast majority are rare) to a uniform one weakens the frequency phase and speeds up learning of the task. Lastly, we show that the three phases of training dynamics from our controlled experiments appear in the open source model OLMo-2 32B. Together, our findings demonstrate that properties of pretraining data are causal drivers of heuristic learning and show that small-scale synthetic experiments can predict training dynamics at larger scales.
items.abstract_zh: 数据如何在预训练全程塑造语言模型（LM）行为？我们通过一个关于实体比较的案例研究来研究这个问题，例如，“在法国和巴西之间，哪个国家更大？”，涵盖跨越五种实体类型的九个比较任务。我们首先进行受控实验，在来自预训练语料的自然文本和合成任务数据的混合上训练小型LM（1.63亿参数）。我们的分析识别出三个不同的学习阶段：（1）早期阶段，LM按频率选择实体；（2）中期阶段，LM按提示中的位置选择实体（最先提及与最后提及的实体）；（3）后期阶段，LM选择作为正确答案的实体。我们表明，这三个阶段的出现由训练数据的统计特性因果决定。在使用少量任务特定合成数据时，我们仅观察到前两个阶段，模型未能学习该任务；在使用大量数据时，模型直接从基于频率的启发式跳转到正确解决任务。此外，将实体频率分布从自然出现的齐夫分布（少数实体非常常见，绝大多数实体稀有）改为均匀分布，会削弱频率阶段并加速任务学习。最后，我们表明来自受控实验的三个训练动态阶段出现在开源模型OLMo-2 32B中。总之，我们的发现表明预训练数据的特性是启发式学习的因果驱动因素，并表明小规模合成实验可以预测更大规模下的训练动态。

items.title_en: Multimodal Person Concept Model for Person Identification under Varying Observation Conditions
items.title_zh: 变化观测条件下的多模态人物概念模型用于人物识别
items.abstract_en: Service robots in domestic and office environments must identify users to provide personalized services based on their preferences and previous interactions. This is challenging because only a few observations may be available for learning, while observation conditions change owing to appearance, environmental noise, and utterance content. To address this challenge, this study proposes a multimodal person concept model that learns person concepts from a small number of observations, without person labels, and enables robust identification under changing conditions. The model employs a nonparametric Bayesian generative model based on the Chinese restaurant process and integrates visual, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted using Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) and Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), followed by principal component analysis (PCA). We evaluated six participants under eight conditions in which appearance changes, additive noise, and transcription errors were introduced individually and in combination. Averaged over the eight conditions, the proposed model achieved an identification accuracy of 0.89 while inferring the number of person concepts from the observations, which is comparable to k-means clustering that was supplied with the true number of participants (0.88). We also examined PCA dimensionality, modality availability, and variation strength, and demonstrated the model on a Toyota Human Support Robot. These results show that multimodal person concept learning supports robust person identification under changing conditions, and that identification can succeed even when the number of concepts is not correctly recovered. The project page and demonstration video are available at https://okitamisan01.github.io/person_concept/.
items.abstract_zh: 家庭和办公环境中的服务机器人必须识别用户，以根据其偏好和先前交互提供个性化服务。这具有挑战性，因为可用于学习的观测可能很少，而观测条件会因外观、环境噪声和话语内容而变化。为应对这一挑战，本研究提出一种多模态人物概念模型，可从少量观测中学习人物概念，无需人物标签，并在变化条件下实现稳健识别。该模型采用基于中国餐馆过程的非参数贝叶斯生成模型，并整合使用对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）和对比语言-音频预训练（CLAP）提取、随后进行主成分分析（PCA）的视觉、声学和语言特征。我们在八种条件下评估了六名参与者，这些条件分别及组合引入了外观变化、加性噪声和转录错误。在八种条件上平均，所提出模型在从观测中推断人物概念数量的同时达到0.89的识别准确率，与提供了真实参与者数量的k-means聚类（0.88）相当。我们还考察了PCA维度、模态可用性和变化强度，并在丰田Human Support Robot上演示了该模型。这些结果表明，多模态人物概念学习支持变化条件下的稳健人物识别，并且即使概念数量未被正确恢复，识别也可以成功。项目页面和演示视频见https://okitamisan01.github.io/person_concept/。

items.title_en: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
items.title_zh: V-JEPA-LM：超越静态、文本对齐表示来读取动态的视频-语言模型
items.abstract_en: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: https://github.com/kkt94/Llama-V-JEPA-LM.
items.abstract_zh: 诸如V-JEPA的世界模型视频编码器仅从视频中学习场景如何变化（方向、速度、顺序、状态）。为回答问题，它们与在字幕和问答对上训练的语言模型连接。但每个字幕或问题只命名一个片段的少数属性，因此模型学会检索这些属性，而不是读取片段，编码器携带的动态信息未被使用：在相同项目上，线性探针从冻结的V-JEPA特征读取速度的准确率为87%，而VLM的回答处于随机水平。我们展示动态信息在冻结编码器中的位置：对于V-JEPA等预测式编码器，它位于跨视频共享的子空间中，而对于SigLIP等逐帧、文本对齐编码器，它并不是共享组件。然后，我们构建反事实监督，使语言模型读取该信息：像素变换将公开视频转为答案均衡的变体，其答案由变换设定，并且仅在变化上不同。所得V-JEPA-LM模型（1B至8B，Qwen3和Llama）在4.53M公开样本上以每帧32个视觉token进行单阶段训练，而开放视频LLM使用多个阶段、9M至172M样本以及平均每帧64至256个token；这些模型在十一个视频基准的平均分上领先每个规模类别；我们的4B模型得分为72.1，而最佳开放4B模型为61.1，最佳开放8B模型为64.8。一项受控的编码器×监督研究表明，编码器决定可读取什么，监督决定实际读取什么：在匹配预算下，反事实监督平均增加4.5分，并在自然基准的速度问题上增加38分。代码和模型：https://github.com/kkt94/Llama-V-JEPA-LM。

items.title_en: Neuroprotective Effects of the Purine-Derived Compound ITH15004 Against Nigericin- and Mitochondria-Induced Toxicity in NSC-34 Motor Neuron-like Cells
items.title_zh: 嘌呤衍生化合物ITH15004对NSC-34运动神经元样细胞中尼日利亚菌素和线粒体诱导毒性的神经保护作用
items.abstract_en: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive degeneration of motor neurons. Most patients die within 3 to 5 years of diagnosis, primarily due to respiratory failure, and effective therapeutic options remain limited. Mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, calcium dysregulation, and neuroinflammation are key contributors to ALS pathogenesis. In this study, we evaluated the potential neuroprotective effects of ITH15004, a novel compound with modulatory effects on P2X7 purinergic receptors, in an in vitro model using NSC-34 motor neuron-like cells. Cellular stress was induced using oligomycin (10 uM) and rotenone (30 uM), inhibitors of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation; nigericin (5 uM), a K+/H+ ionophore that disrupts ionic homeostasis; and extracellular ATP (1 mM), a purinergic receptor agonist. MTT-reducing activity was assessed as an indicator of cellular metabolic activity, while caspase-3/7 activity was measured to evaluate apoptotic responses. Intracellular ATP levels, cytosolic calcium responses, and cytochrome c and VDAC1 protein abundance were also analysed. ITH15004 significantly improved MTT-reducing activity following exposure to ATP, oligomycin/rotenone, and nigericin. In addition, ITH15004 partially restored intracellular ATP levels following nigericin treatment and significantly reduced nigericin-induced caspase-3/7 activation. Western blot analysis further revealed significant changes in cytochrome c and VDAC1 protein levels in response to ITH15004 treatment. These findings indicate that ITH15004 attenuates cellular damage induced by different stressors in NSC-34 cells and modulates several parameters associated with cellular energy status and apoptotic signalling. Further studies are needed to establish its mechanisms of action and assess its therapeutic potential in ALS.
items.abstract_zh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元进行性退化为特征。大多数患者在诊断后3至5年内死亡，主要死于呼吸衰竭，有效治疗选择仍然有限。线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激、钙调节异常和神经炎症是ALS发病机制的关键因素。本研究在NSC-34运动神经元样细胞的体外模型中，评估了ITH15004的潜在神经保护作用，ITH15004是一种对P2X7嘌呤能受体具有调节作用的新型化合物。使用线粒体氧化磷酸化抑制剂寡霉素（10 μM）和鱼藤酮（30 μM）、破坏离子稳态的K+/H+离子载体尼日利亚菌素（5 μM）以及嘌呤能受体激动剂细胞外ATP（1 mM）诱导细胞应激。MTT还原活性作为细胞代谢活动指标进行评估，同时测量caspase-3/7活性以评估凋亡反应。还分析了细胞内ATP水平、胞质钙反应以及细胞色素c和VDAC1蛋白丰度。在暴露于ATP、寡霉素/鱼藤酮和尼日利亚菌素后，ITH15004显著改善MTT还原活性。此外，ITH15004在尼日利亚菌素处理后部分恢复细胞内ATP水平，并显著降低尼日利亚菌素诱导的caspase-3/7激活。Western blot分析进一步显示，ITH15004处理对细胞色素c和VDAC1蛋白水平产生显著变化。这些发现表明，ITH15004减轻NSC-34细胞中不同应激源诱导的细胞损伤，并调节与细胞能量状态和凋亡信号相关的若干参数。仍需进一步研究以确定其作用机制并评估其在ALS中的治疗潜力。
authors: de Moraes Berenguel Lossavaro, P. K.

items.title_en: Resilient Transmission of Highly Structured Light via Active Convolved Illumination
items.title_zh: 通过主动卷积照明实现高度结构化光的鲁棒传输
items.abstract_en: Wave propagation through lossy and noisy systems as well as spatiotemporally dynamic random media often limits the complex information that can be reliably transmitted or retrieved. Progress in adaptive optics, wavefront shaping, machine learning, and wave propagation theories has significantly advanced physical and computational correction techniques. However, many approaches remain constrained by restrictive operating conditions, limiting their ability to meet growing application-specific demands, such as higher spatial resolution in imaging and greater data capacity in communications, particularly in highly dynamic environments. Recently, active convolved illumination (ACI) was proposed as a novel framework for preserving the spatial structure of optical modes during propagation through strongly distorting environments, such as atmospheric turbulence. ACI aims to bypass the prohibitive complexity of global distortion tracking by combining spectrally localized characterization with compensation using a correlated auxiliary source. Here, we provide a comprehensive review of ACI, detailing the formulation of correlation-injecting and auxiliary sources and the role of segmented reciprocal-space characterization and distortion compensation. We explore extensions in free-space optical communication and potential high-precision phase measurement, and numerically evaluate interferometric strategies for experimental implementation. This work highlights ACI as a potentially versatile framework for distortion-resilient light transmission, with broad interdisciplinary utility ranging from atmospheric physics and remote sensing to telecommunications, target tracking, and biomedical diagnosis, offering flexible deployment either as a standalone paradigm or hybridized with existing optical systems.
items.abstract_zh: 通过有损和含噪系统以及时空动态随机介质的波传播，常常限制可可靠传输或恢复的复杂信息。自适应光学、波前整形、机器学习和波传播理论的进展显著推进了物理和计算校正技术。然而，许多方法仍受限于苛刻的操作条件，限制了其满足日益增长的应用特定需求的能力，例如成像中更高空间分辨率和通信中更大数据容量，尤其是在高度动态环境中。最近，主动卷积照明（ACI）被提出作为一种新框架，用于在通过强畸变环境（如大气湍流）传播时保持光学模式的空间结构。ACI旨在通过将光谱局域表征与使用相关辅助源的补偿相结合，绕过全局畸变跟踪的过高复杂性。本文对ACI进行全面综述，详述相关注入源和辅助源的构建，以及分段倒空间表征和畸变补偿的作用。我们探讨自由空间光通信中的扩展和潜在高精度相位测量，并数值评估用于实验实施的干涉策略。本工作强调ACI作为畸变鲁棒光传输的潜在通用框架，具有从大气物理和遥感延伸到电信、目标跟踪和生物医学诊断的广泛跨学科实用性，可作为独立范式或与现有光学系统混合灵活部署。

items.title_en: Continuous Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Using PPG From Methods to Clinical Translation
items.title_zh: 使用PPG的连续无袖带血压估计：从方法到临床转化
items.abstract_en: Continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring could improve hypertension management by capturing changes that intermittent cuff measurements miss. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely explored for cuffless BP estimation because optical sensors are inexpensive, wearable, and already present in many consumer and clinical devices. PPG, however, does not measure arterial pressure: BP is inferred from waveform characteristics or pulse timing, which also depend on vascular tone, arterial stiffness, sensor contact, motion, and individual physiology. This survey reviews PPG-based cuffless BP estimation along the full measurement chain, covering physiological mechanisms, waveform features, pulse arrival time (PAT), pulse transit time (PTT), machine-learning methods, datasets, calibration, validation, deployment, bias, and clinical translation. Studies are assessed by the strength of evidence they provide rather than by reported error alone, with particular attention to subject and temporal leakage, dataset imbalance, calibration dependence and drift, motion artifacts, and the gap between benchmark accuracy and reliable real-world measurement. The review finds that progress depends on more than better prediction algorithms. Future work should prioritize physiologically informed models, diverse longitudinal datasets, transparent reporting of calibration requirements and failure rates, stronger evaluation protocols, and studies that demonstrate practical value in clinical care.
items.abstract_zh: 连续血压（BP）监测可通过捕捉间歇性袖带测量遗漏的变化来改善高血压管理。光电容积脉搏波（PPG）被广泛探索用于无袖带BP估计，因为光学传感器廉价、可穿戴，并且已存在于许多消费和临床设备中。然而，PPG并不测量动脉压：BP是由波形特征或脉搏时序推断的，而这些还取决于血管张力、动脉僵硬度、传感器接触、运动和个体生理。本综述沿完整测量链回顾基于PPG的无袖带BP估计，涵盖生理机制、波形特征、脉搏到达时间（PAT）、脉搏传导时间（PTT）、机器学习方法、数据集、校准、验证、部署、偏倚和临床转化。研究按其提供的证据强度而非仅按报告误差进行评估，特别关注受试者和时间泄漏、数据集不平衡、校准依赖和漂移、运动伪影，以及基准准确性与可靠真实世界测量之间的差距。综述发现，进展不仅取决于更好的预测算法。未来工作应优先考虑生理学知情模型、多样化纵向数据集、透明报告校准要求和失败率、更强的评估协议，以及证明临床护理中实用价值的研究。

items.title_en: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 强化学习后印度语任务的提升与退化
items.abstract_en: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
items.abstract_zh: 我们使用GRPO在四个环境中运行强化学习（RL），起点是一个监督微调的30B-A3B混合专家模型，覆盖英语和八种印度语。我们在一次评估活动中比较RL前后的模型，覆盖34个基准。MATH提高36.07分，大多数印度语基准也提高。然而，XQuAD-Indic F1下降19.32分，同时英语回答比例从8.7%升至91.7%；IndicQA下降8.64，而英语XQuAD提高11.71 F1。第二次RL运行从相同监督初始化开始，加入一个印度语环境以及语言奖励和重复奖励。与已发布模型相比，它提高了段落问答和指令遵循基准，同时保持MATH性能。但它在推理和编码基准上退步。若干训练选择同时改变，因此我们无法分离任一奖励项的影响。文字系统符合性仍未解决。加入语言奖励并未确保使用所要求的文字系统。因此，段落问答和文字系统符合性需要直接评估，即使其他基准分数提高。

items.title_en: Beyond Prediction Gain: LASR as a Metric for Action-Grounded Latents in World Models
items.title_zh: 超越预测增益：LASR作为世界模型中动作接地潜变量的指标
items.abstract_en: World models that support planning, control, and interpretable reasoning require latent representations that genuinely encode action. Yet the large-scale video data from which such models are learned overwhelmingly lack action annotations. Latent-action models infer action-like variables from observation sequences, enabling action-aware learning from unlabeled videos or trajectories. A fundamental concern, however, remains: a latent that improves future prediction may simply encode the current state, episode progress, task identity, or other predictive shortcuts. Existing evaluation practices---reconstruction loss, rollout fidelity, action recovery, or downstream performance---cannot isolate this distinction. We introduce the Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR), a dimensionless metric that measures, under offline evaluation on held-out data, whether a learned latent provides predictive support for action-related targets beyond the current state and non-action alternatives. LASR provides two complementary summaries: GeoLASR captures typical support, while WorstLASR identifies the weakest case. We instantiate the LASR benchmark with recorded actions and corresponding physical state changes as targets, episode-held-out splits, one predictor type for all comparisons, and positive and negative controls. Experiments on recorded robot manipulation data and a matched multi-task panel demonstrate that LASR detects known action information, rejects representative non-action shortcuts, and enables graded comparisons among imperfect latent representations. We further use LASR to train and audit a lightweight residual adapter, obtaining descriptively better point estimates whose uncertainty is assessed with paired comparisons. LASR thus provides a principled offline protocol for measuring action-related predictive support in world-model latents.
items.abstract_zh: 支持规划、控制和可解释推理的世界模型需要真正编码动作的潜表示。然而，用于学习此类模型的大规模视频数据绝大多数缺乏动作标注。潜动作模型从观测序列推断类动作变量，从而能够从无标注视频或轨迹中进行动作感知学习。然而，一个根本性担忧仍然存在：改善未来预测的潜变量可能只是编码当前状态、片段进度、任务身份或其他预测捷径。现有评估实践——重建损失、推演保真度、动作恢复或下游性能——无法隔离这种区别。我们引入潜动作支持比（LASR），一种无量纲指标，在留出数据上的离线评估下衡量学习到的潜变量是否在超越当前状态和非动作替代变量的情况下，为动作相关目标提供预测支持。LASR提供两个互补摘要：GeoLASR捕捉典型支持，WorstLASR识别最弱情况。我们以记录的动作及相应物理状态变化为目标、片段留出划分、所有比较使用一种预测器类型以及阳性和阴性对照来实例化LASR基准。在记录的机器人操作数据和匹配的多任务面板上的实验表明，LASR能检测已知动作信息，拒绝代表性的非动作捷径，并支持在不完美潜表示之间进行分级比较。我们进一步使用LASR训练和审计一个轻量残差适配器，获得描述性更好的点估计，其不确定性通过配对比较评估。因此，LASR提供了一种原则性的离线协议，用于衡量世界模型潜变量中与动作相关的预测支持。

items.title_en: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
items.title_zh: JVT：Just Video Transformer 让像素空间视频扩散变得简单
items.abstract_en: Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. We systematically examine video patch embeddings, register tokens, and adaptive layer normalization to identify design choices that balance generation quality and computational efficiency. The resulting JVT design achieves generation quality competitive with latent diffusion baselines in both class-conditioned and unconditional settings. The pixel-space formulation of JVT also naturally supports joint generation of pixel-aligned modalities. We demonstrate this capability through camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation, which improves camera following relative to RGB-only baselines and yields explicit scene geometry without an additional reconstruction model at inference. These results highlight the potential of simple DiT-style Transformers for pixel-space video diffusion, and we hope our findings offer useful insights and practical guidance for future research.
items.abstract_zh: 对高维原始视频数据进行直接扩散建模具有挑战性，现有的像素空间方法通常依赖专门架构。我们提出 JVT（Just Video Transformer），一种用于像素空间视频扩散的简单大 patch DiT 风格 Transformer，不使用预训练自编码器、辅助细节器、级联阶段或 U-Net 式跳跃连接。我们系统考察视频 patch 嵌入、寄存器 token 和自适应层归一化，以识别在生成质量与计算效率之间取得平衡的设计选择。所得的 JVT 设计在类条件与无条件设置下均达到与潜在扩散基线相当的生成质量。JVT 的像素空间形式还自然支持像素对齐模态的联合生成。我们通过相机条件 RGB-视差生成展示了这一能力，相对于仅 RGB 基线改善了相机跟随，并在推理时无需额外重建模型即可产生显式场景几何。这些结果凸显了简单 DiT 风格 Transformer 用于像素空间视频扩散的潜力，我们希望这些发现能为未来研究提供有用见解和实践指导。
