items.title_en: Long-Acting GLP-1 Receptor Agonism Ameliorates Sinoatrial Node Dysfunction by Attenuating Electrophysiological and Structural Remodeling
items.title_zh: 长效 GLP-1 受体激动作用通过减轻电生理与结构重构改善窦房结功能障碍
items.abstract_en: Background: Sinoatrial node dysfunction (SND) causes bradyarrhythmia, while pacemaker therapy does not reverse injury to the sinoatrial node (SAN). Long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) raise heart rate, but whether they can repair an injured SAN in SND remains unknown. Methods: In streptozotocin-induced SND rats, we studied an acute phase (SND, GLP-1RA treatment, glycemic control, and GLP-1R antagonist groups) and a chronic phase (SND, GLP-1RA treatment, and glycemic control groups). Endpoints included heart rate, RR interval, heart rate variability, intrinsic heart rate (IHR), corrected sinus node recovery time after adenosine injection (ADSNRT), SAN transcriptomics, histology and immunofluorescence, HL-1 cell oxidative-stress studies, and public single-cell data. Results: At the acute endpoint, the long-acting GLP-1RA efsubaglutide alfa (eSuba) increased heart rate (372.76 {+/-} 11.06 vs 312.64 {+/-} 22.28 beats/min; P < 0.0001) and IHR (349.45 {+/-} 10.49 vs 234.79 {+/-} 12.29 beats/min; P < 0.0001), and shortened ADSNRT (4.22 {+/-} 2.75 vs 20.68 {+/-} 1.60 s; P = 0.0009); improvements in heart rate (349.05 {+/-} 17.73 vs 266.02 {+/-} 13.52 beats/min; P < 0.0001) and IHR persisted in the chronic phase. SAN transcriptomics showed reversal of extracellular matrix, inflammatory/immune, redox/mitochondrial, glial, and electrical programs. The GLP-1RA reduced collagen deposition and CCR2a+ infiltration, decreased ox-CaMKII/CaMKII, increased SIRT3, restored Cav1.3, Nav1.5, SERCA2a and p-RyR2 (Ser2808), and increased p-PKA/PKA. The glycemic control comparator produced limited improvement, and the GLP-1R antagonist attenuated most effects. Conclusions: Long-acting GLP-1R agonism improves SAN function in SND via glucose-independent attenuation of electrophysiological and structural remodeling, an effect that is at least partly GLP-1R dependent.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：窦房结功能障碍（SND）会引起心动过缓性心律失常，而起搏器治疗不能逆转窦房结（SAN）损伤。长效 GLP-1 受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）可提高心率，但其能否修复 SND 中受损的 SAN 仍未知。方法：在链脲佐菌素诱导的 SND 大鼠中，我们研究了急性期（SND、GLP-1RA 治疗、血糖控制和 GLP-1R 拮抗剂组）和慢性期（SND、GLP-1RA 治疗和血糖控制组）。终点包括心率、RR 间期、心率变异性、固有心率（IHR）、注射腺苷后校正窦房结恢复时间（ADSNRT）、SAN 转录组学、组织学和免疫荧光、HL-1 细胞氧化应激研究以及公开单细胞数据。结果：在急性终点，长效 GLP-1RA efsubaglutide alfa（eSuba）提高心率（372.76 ± 11.06 对 312.64 ± 22.28 次/分；P < 0.0001）和 IHR（349.45 ± 10.49 对 234.79 ± 12.29 次/分；P < 0.0001），并缩短 ADSNRT（4.22 ± 2.75 对 20.68 ± 1.60 秒；P = 0.0009）；心率（349.05 ± 17.73 对 266.02 ± 13.52 次/分；P < 0.0001）和 IHR 的改善在慢性期持续存在。SAN 转录组学显示细胞外基质、炎症/免疫、氧化还原/线粒体、胶质和电活动程序发生逆转。GLP-1RA 减少胶原沉积和 CCR2a+ 浸润，降低 ox-CaMKII/CaMKII，增加 SIRT3，恢复 Cav1.3、Nav1.5、SERCA2a 和 p-RyR2（Ser2808），并增加 p-PKA/PKA。血糖控制对照产生有限改善，而 GLP-1R 拮抗剂减弱了大多数效应。结论：长效 GLP-1R 激动通过不依赖葡萄糖的方式减轻电生理和结构重构，从而改善 SND 中的 SAN 功能，该效应至少部分依赖 GLP-1R。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Frequency Conversion and Violation of Kirchhoff's Law of Thermal Radiation in Phased Floquet Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 相位 Floquet 超表面中的非对称频率转换与热辐射基尔霍夫定律违背
items.abstract_en: We study a system of three closely spaced conducting sheets, whose thermal emission largely violates Kirchhoff's law through nonreciprocal frequency conversion enabled by Floquet phenomena. We leverage surface mode transitions controlled by temporal modulation of one of the metasurfaces, resulting in largely asymmetric frequency conversion. Our findings broaden the capabilities of Floquet metasurfaces for wave conversion and energy manipulation, paving the way towards magnet-free nonreciprocal photonic devices with opportunities for thermal management and efficient photonic refrigeration.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个由三片紧密间隔的导电薄片组成的系统，其热发射通过 Floquet 现象实现的非互易频率转换在很大程度上违背基尔霍夫定律。我们利用由其中一个超表面的时间调制所控制的表面模式转变，实现高度非对称的频率转换。我们的发现拓宽了 Floquet 超表面在波转换和能量操控方面的能力，为无磁非互易光子器件铺平道路，并带来热管理和高效光子制冷的机会。

items.title_en: PF-Exec: Large-Scale UAV Relay Load Balancing with an Anchored Potential Direction Decider and a Per-Dimension Gain-Learning Executor
items.title_zh: PF-Exec：面向大规模无人机中继负载均衡的锚定势方向决策器与逐维增益学习执行器
items.abstract_en: Relay load balancing in large-scale UAV networks requires joint decisions on association, bandwidth, power and hovering position, while the dimension grows with the number of UAVs and each UAV sees only its local state. This paper splits the decision into two layers. An anchored potential direction decider emits a closed-form target at every instant and returns its direction only. A gain-learning executor maps a local observation into a positive gain per dimension, composes gain and target, and clips the action against the physical single-step bound; the two layers form PF-Exec. The unit gain is the default start, so the executor reduces to the pure potential policy before training. The load is first-order homogeneous in bandwidth, making the bandwidth target closed form, and the position target is the demand-weighted centroid of the served users. The system uses a two-hop access and millimetre-wave backhaul link with soft association, a 3GPP UMa-AV channel with two shadowing layers, an OU-type social-force crowd and a quadrotor physical layer. Evaluation spans all fleet sizes, two crowd scenarios, independent seeds, the published baselines in their own settings and a degraded-information line. In the highest-pressure burst setting the fixed-step comparison breaks down on part of the seeds, losing fairness and mean load at once, while PF-Exec holds fairness near one. Among the ten comparison methods only the greedy heuristic survives that setting; its load variance stays far higher. Under stale global state and position noise the fairness index stays high at both largest-scale scenarios. Flight energy is nearly identical between the learned and the fixed-step executor, and three constants are fixed once across all settings. The convergence properties of both layers, from the truncated gain iteration to the perturbed tracking bound, are proved in the companion analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模无人机网络中的中继负载均衡需要对关联、带宽、功率和悬停位置进行联合决策，而维度随无人机数量增长，且每个无人机只能看到其局部状态。本文将决策分为两层。锚定势方向决策器在每个时刻输出闭式目标，并且仅返回其方向。增益学习执行器将局部观测映射为逐维正增益，组合增益与目标，并针对物理单步界限对动作进行裁剪；这两层构成 PF-Exec。单位增益为默认起点，因此训练前执行器退化为纯势策略。负载在带宽上是一阶齐次的，使带宽目标为闭式，位置目标是所服务用户的需求加权质心。系统采用带软关联的两跳接入和毫米波回传链路、具有两层阴影的 3GPP UMa-AV 信道、OU 型社会力人群以及四旋翼物理层。评估涵盖所有机队规模、两种人群场景、独立随机种子、按各自设置运行的已发表基线以及一条退化信息线。在最高压力突发设置中，固定步长对比在部分种子上失效，同时损失公平性和平均负载，而 PF-Exec 将公平性保持在接近 1。在十种对比方法中，只有贪心启发式在该设置下仍有效；其负载方差仍远更高。在过时全局状态和位置噪声下，两个最大规模场景中的公平性指数仍保持较高。学习型执行器与固定步长执行器的飞行能耗几乎相同，并且三个常数在所有设置中一次性固定。两层从截断增益迭代到扰动跟踪界的收敛性质在配套分析中证明。

items.title_en: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
items.title_zh: G-CAST：面向需求演化下电商智能体的受治理持续自训练
items.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(http://cai.1688.com/), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.
items.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，越来越多用户转向由 LLM 驱动的智能体进行电商对话式购物。然而，随着新产品类别、采购场景和功能请求出现，用户需求持续变化。与此同时，产品的执行框架——包括其工具、技能和操作流程——持续演化，以支持日益复杂的交互。这些变化带来两个实际挑战：1）需求漂移改变用户请求的分布、意图和复杂度，导致一次训练的模型落后；2）执行框架演化要求模型正确使用新引入的能力，同时不丢失用户已经依赖的行为。定期人工重训练在此场景下过于滞后且劳动密集。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 G-CAST，一个受治理的持续自训练系统，将在不断变化的需求和能力契约下的日常生产证据转化为按奖励路由、按熵优先的训练数据和受治理的奖励演化。在累积评估下的受治理检查点转换控制每次模型更新，使智能体能够学习新引入的行为而不牺牲先前已接受的能力。在真实生产电商智能体上的实验表明，与强自主后训练基线相比，G-CAST 对新引入需求实现更强适应，同时更好地保留先前已接受的行为。消融进一步表明，按奖励路由、按熵优先的数据编排和受治理的奖励演化对这些收益都很重要。G-CAST 现已部署在 Yuancai（http://cai.1688.com/）中，这是阿里巴巴 1688 平台上的一个 B2B 采购智能体。

items.title_en: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
items.title_zh: X-Nav 技术报告：人形机器人真实世界室内到室外的长程导航
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon navigation from indoors to outdoors remains an open problem for humanoid robots: one instruction covers rooms, doors and roads, and the camera moves with the gait. Worken, AGIBOT's measure of productive robot work, depends on robots that reach their workplaces autonomously. We present X-Nav, to our knowledge the first system to take a bipedal humanoid through a language-instructed long-horizon mission from indoors to outdoors. X-Nav covers a pipeline from data to deployment. Its data engine collects navigation data in open-source scenes, in digital twins of deployment sites and on real robots. Its navigation model, MELIOR, takes only RGB images from the robot's built-in camera and comes in two versions: MELIOR-A predicts actions, and MELIOR-N predicts a navigation goal. Its agentic workflow, X-Navarch, turns a brief human instruction into sub-tasks and deploys MELIOR on the robot with explicit target navigation and obstacle avoidance. On the Lingxi X2, X-Nav completes a mission of about a hundred metres from an office lobby to a store in a neighbouring building; LiDAR and odometry are used for target approach and low-level control. The mission is completed with both versions of MELIOR: the robot follows a change of destination and walks through a door from the lobby to the road, and with X-Navarch it also passes static and dynamic obstacles on the route. During deployment, MELIOR is adapted with data collected in a digital twin of the site; the adaptation raises its closed-loop success rate in the twin, and the adapted model is then deployed on the robot at the real site. In addition, MELIOR achieves competitive results on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 从室内到室外的长程导航对人形机器人仍是开放难题：一条指令可能覆盖房间、门与道路，且相机随步态晃动。Worken 是 AGIBOT 提出的衡量机器人生产性工作的指标，它依赖机器人能自主抵达工作地点。我们提出 X-Nav，据我们所知这是首个让双足人形机器人完成语言指令下、从室内到室外的长程任务的系统。X-Nav 覆盖从数据到部署的完整流水线。其数据引擎在开源场景、部署现场的数字孪生以及真实机器人上采集导航数据。其导航模型 MELIOR 仅使用机器人自带相机的 RGB 图像，有两个版本：MELIOR-A 预测动作，MELIOR-N 预测导航目标。其智能体工作流 X-Navarch 把简短的人类指令拆解为子任务，并在机器人上部署 MELIOR，实现明确的目标导航与避障。在 Lingxi X2 上，X-Nav 完成了一次约一百米的任务：从办公楼大厅前往相邻建筑中的商店；其中 LiDAR 与里程计用于接近目标和底层控制。该任务在 MELIOR 两个版本下均能完成：机器人能跟随目的地变更，并从大厅穿过一道门走到道路上；配合 X-Navarch，它还能通过路线上的静态与动态障碍。部署期间，MELIOR 用在该现场数字孪生中采集的数据进行适配，适配提升了它在孪生环境中的闭环成功率，随后适配后的模型被部署到真实现场的机器人上。此外，MELIOR 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
items.highlight_zh: 首个双足人形从室内到室外百米的语言指令长程导航
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】让双足人形机器人按一句话的指令，从办公楼里一路走到外面、再进入另一栋建筑里的商店，是很难的：一条指令里包含房间、门、道路等多个阶段，走路时相机还随步态上下晃动，图像不稳定。而 AGIBOT 提出的"生产性工作"指标 Worken 恰恰要求机器人能自主走到工作地点，所以这项能力是实用化的前提。
【用了什么方法】作者给出 X-Nav 系统，覆盖数据到部署全链路。数据引擎在开源场景、部署现场的数字孪生和真实机器人上采集导航数据。导航模型 MELIOR 只用机器人自带相机的 RGB 图像，分两个版本：MELIOR-A 直接预测动作，MELIOR-N 预测导航目标点。上层智能体工作流 X-Navarch 把简短的人类指令拆成子任务，驱动 MELIOR 在机器人上执行目标导航与避障；接近目标与底层运动控制借助 LiDAR 和里程计。
【有什么结果】在 Lingxi X2 人形机器人上，系统完成了一次约一百米的任务：从办公楼大厅前往相邻建筑的商店。MELIOR 两个版本都能跑通任务——机器人能跟随目的地变更、从大厅穿门走上道路；加上 X-Navarch 后，还能绕开途中的静态与动态障碍。部署时先用现场数字孪生里采的数据适配 MELIOR，孪生环境中的闭环成功率随之提升，再把适配后的模型放到真实现场使用。此外 MELIOR 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 两个导航基准上也取得有竞争力的成绩。
【为何重要】据作者所知，这是首个让双足人形机器人完成语言指令下室内到室外长程任务的系统，说明"数字孪生采数据、真机部署、纯 RGB 导航"这条路可行，为人形机器人真正上岗干活迈出一步。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: VLAN: Vision-Language Accessible Navigation
items.title_zh: VLAN：视觉-语言无障碍导航
items.abstract_en: Accessible mobility is user-conditioned rather than scene-intrinsic, as walkable paths for one embodiment are inaccessible to another. Yet, existing benchmarks evaluate traversability under a fixed and limited embodiment. We present Vision-Language Accessible Navigation (VLAN), containing 1,000 scenes, 20K navigation trajectories, and 160K keyframes across diverse lighting, environmental conditions, scene semantics, and path geometries. For each trajectory, VLAN provides embodiment-specific actions and accessibility features for legged and wheeled agents, including humanoid and quadruped robots and people with visual or mobility impairments, while everyday obstacles and accessibility labels are categorized as Passable, Bypass, HighRisk, and Blocked. Unlike goal-only evaluation, our benchmark measures physical safety and alignment with user-specific constraints via goal-reaching, collision-aware, and accessibility-aligned metrics. We benchmark modern vision-language models and find they often fail to consistently adapt obstacle relevance, path selection, and safety criteria across user profiles, suggesting accessibility-aware navigation requires dedicated datasets, tasks, and metrics beyond conventional embodied navigation evaluation. All data and code open-source at https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/VLAN.
items.abstract_zh: 可通行移动性取决于用户而非场景固有属性，因为对一种具身形态可行的路径对另一种可能不可通行。然而，现有基准在固定且有限的具身形态下评估可通行性。我们提出视觉-语言无障碍导航（VLAN），包含1,000个场景、20K条导航轨迹和160K个关键帧，覆盖多样光照、环境条件、场景语义和路径几何。对于每条轨迹，VLAN为腿式和轮式智能体提供特定于具身形态的动作与无障碍特征，包括人形和四足机器人以及有视觉或行动障碍的人，同时将日常障碍物和无障碍标签分为可通行（Passable）、绕行（Bypass）、高风险（HighRisk）和阻塞（Blocked）。与仅评估目标不同，我们的基准通过到达目标、碰撞感知和无障碍对齐指标衡量物理安全性和对用户特定约束的符合程度。我们对现代视觉-语言模型进行基准测试，发现它们往往无法在不同用户画像间一致地调整障碍物相关性、路径选择和安全标准，这表明无障碍感知导航需要超越传统具身导航评估的专用数据集、任务和指标。所有数据和代码开源于 https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/VLAN。

items.title_en: Harnessing Circadian Resilience for Demand-Flexible Controlled Environment Agriculture
items.title_zh: 利用昼夜节律韧性实现需求灵活型可控环境农业
items.abstract_en: The increasing penetration of renewable electricity generation creates opportunities for flexible demand-side energy management in Total Controlled Environment Agriculture (TCEA), where artificial lighting represents a major operational cost. However, the biological consequences of demand-responsive lighting strategies remain poorly understood. Here, we investigated whether photoperiods can be dynamically adjusted to minimise economic costs or maximise renewable energy utilisation while maintaining crop productivity. Using historical electricity market and wind-generation data, we evaluated three demand-flexing strategies: short-term demand-side response (DSR) events, cost-optimised photoperiods aligned with low electricity prices, and wind-optimised photoperiods aligned with periods of high renewable generation. Despite substantial variation in photoperiod length, plants maintained robust circadian rhythms under both cost- and wind-optimised regimes, demonstrating considerable resilience of the circadian system to irregular environmental timing. Commercial-scale trials involving basil, lettuce, mustard greens and rocket revealed that demand-flexed lighting regimes had minimal effects on harvested fresh or dry weight. Our findings demonstrate that TCEA can provide meaningful demand-side flexibility and support renewable energy integration without substantial reductions in crop productivity. Circadian resilience appears to buffer plants against fluctuating photoperiods, providing a biological foundation for the deployment of demand-flexible lighting strategies in future low-carbon agricultural systems.
items.abstract_zh: 可再生能源发电渗透率不断提高，为全可控环境农业（TCEA）中的需求侧灵活能源管理创造了机会，其中人工照明是主要运营成本。然而，需求响应型照明策略的生物学后果仍知之甚少。本文研究光周期能否动态调整以最小化经济成本或最大化可再生能源利用，同时维持作物生产力。利用历史电力市场和风力发电数据，我们评估了三种需求灵活策略：短期需求侧响应（DSR）事件、与低电价对齐的成本优化光周期，以及与高可再生发电时段对齐的风电优化光周期。尽管光周期长度变化很大，植物在成本优化和风电优化两种模式下都维持了稳健的昼夜节律，表明昼夜节律系统对环境时间不规则具有相当大的韧性。涉及罗勒、生菜、芥菜和芝麻菜的商业规模试验显示，需求灵活照明模式对收获鲜重或干重影响极小。我们的发现表明，TCEA可提供有意义的需求侧灵活性并支持可再生能源整合，而不会大幅降低作物生产力。昼夜节律韧性似乎能缓冲植物免受光周期波动影响，为未来低碳农业系统中部署需求灵活照明策略提供了生物学基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Complex fluid flow dynamics by bright scattershot boson sampling
items.title_zh: 利用明亮散弹式玻色子采样研究复杂流体流动动力学
items.abstract_en: Boson sampling machines have become a fruitful tool for establishing new concepts, which connect fundamental physics with computer science applications. Here, we exploit the intrinsically high-dimensional correlations generated by the measurement outcomes of a multiphoton boson sampling machine and demonstrate how a reconfigurable architecture can be programmed to autonomously model the time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems that describe complex fluid flows. By extending on the original scattershot boson sampling (SBS) scheme to include higher photon number components -- a scheme which we label bright scattershot boson sampling (BSBS) --- this scheme overcomes scaling issues inherent to SBS-based schemes by utilizing all randomly generated input photon number distributions. We illustrate the capability of this scheme for two complex fluid-flow models: an eight-dimensional Lorenz-type model of two-dimensional thermally driven convection and a 16-dimensional model of global atmospheric circulation. Using a digital twin of the BSBS architecture based on multiphoton statistics, we show that the photonic approach accurately reproduces the temporal dynamics of both systems while being resilient to photon losses of up to 50 per cent. We also verified that the BSBS case outperforms a comparable run with coherent light. Moreover, its prediction horizon exceeds that of a classical reservoir-computing model with the same query complexity. These results highlight the potential of near-term photonic quantum computing for addressing relevant real-world tasks on noisy intermediate-scale devices.
items.abstract_zh: 玻色子采样机已成为建立新概念的有效工具，这些概念将基础物理与计算机科学应用联系起来。本文利用多光子玻色子采样机测量结果产生的内在高维关联，展示可重构架构如何被编程以自主建模描述复杂流体流动的非线性动力系统的时间演化。通过将原始散弹式玻色子采样（SBS）方案扩展至包含更高光子数成分——我们称之为明亮散弹式玻色子采样（BSBS）的方案——该方案利用所有随机生成的输入光子数分布，克服了基于SBS的方案固有的扩展性问题。我们针对两个复杂流体流动模型展示该方案的能力：二维热驱动对流的八维洛伦兹型模型和全球大气环流的16维模型。使用基于多光子统计的BSBS架构数字孪生，我们表明该光子方法能准确重现两个系统的时间动力学，同时对高达50%的光子损失具有韧性。我们还验证了BSBS情形优于使用相干光的可比运行。此外，其预测时域超过具有相同查询复杂度的经典储备池计算模型。这些结果凸显了近期光子量子计算在含噪中等规模设备上解决相关现实任务的潜力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对波长、器件、光路、噪声与实验条件；数值仿真不等于已制备器件或可直接部署。

items.title_en: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
items.title_zh: 使用能量像素方法估计训练高分辨率结合模型所需的第二代DEL规模
items.abstract_en: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity such a library must have to supply that dense sampling and those tight binders. The method does two useful things. It turns the number of tight binders a model needs into the number of compounds a library must contain. And it estimates the expected yield of a randomly designed second-generation DEL, so the gain from designing the library with machine learning or active learning can be measured against a baseline, without the expense of a control library as large as the experiment itself.
items.abstract_zh: DNA编码库（DEL）常用于寻找靶标蛋白的小分子结合物。但难点已不再是找到命中物，而是构建足够好的机器学习模型来指导后续药物化学，该模型能分辨化学家改变单个原子时的亲和力变化。此类模型需要其训练数据具备两点：对命中物周围小块化学空间的密集采样，以及其中足够数量的真正强结合物。多样化的朴素DEL两者都无法提供。它采样巨大空间，因此任一邻域覆盖都过于稀疏，且最强结合物稀少。在朴素DEL数据上训练的模型必须外推到比其所见更紧的结合物，这正是模型可能失败之处。获得同时具备两种属性的训练数据的一种方法是围绕命中物构建第二代DEL。我们探究该库必须有多复杂。我们将结合视为小的独立相互作用之和，称为靶标上的像素和配体上的反像素。根据朴素库中测得的亲和力分布，在无结构信息且尚未合成任何化合物的情况下，我们估计此类库必须具备的复杂度，以提供这种密集采样和强结合物。该方法有两个有用之处。它将模型所需的强结合物数量转化为库必须包含的化合物数量。它还估计随机设计的第二代DEL的预期产率，从而可以在没有与实验本身同样大的对照库开销的情况下，将使用机器学习或主动学习设计库的收益与基线进行比较。

items.title_en: EvenVLM: A Text and Multimodal Dataset for the Even Language with Vision-Language Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: EvenVLM：用于埃文语的文本与多模态数据集及视觉-语言微调
items.abstract_en: We present EvenVLM, the first text and multimodal (VQA) dataset for Even (Lamut), an endangered Northern Tungusic language spoken by approximately 6,800 people in Siberia. Our dataset comprises 50,521 structured Even-Russian entries extracted from dictionary and phrasebook sources via GPT-4o Mini-based parsing, from which we synthetically generate 107,543 training examples spanning translation, grammar, reading comprehension, and semantic classification. To address tokenization inefficiency on Even's agglutinative morphology, we propose a three-step tokenizer expansion algorithm that adds Even-specific graphemes (eng, oe, o-umlaut), whitelisted vocabulary, and BPE merges, reducing average tokens per word by 27% (4.99 to 3.64). Using LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-4B, we adapt the model for text tasks (0.53% trainable parameters, rank 32) and separately for visual question answering (rank 64, frozen vision encoder). Our best configuration achieves 11.4% exact match and a 13.6 weighted score on text benchmarks, 0.1283 chrF for sentence translation, and 65% accuracy on VQA (up from 0% for the base model and text-only fine-tuning). We release our datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and training pipeline to support further research on Even and other low-resource languages.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出EvenVLM，这是首个面向埃文语（Lamut）的文本与多模态（VQA）数据集；埃文语是一种濒危的北通古斯语，约6,800人使用，分布在西伯利亚。我们的数据集包含50,521条结构化埃文语-俄语条目，这些条目通过基于GPT-4o Mini的解析从词典和短语手册来源提取，并由此合成生成107,543个训练示例，涵盖翻译、语法、阅读理解和语义分类。针对埃文语黏着形态导致的词元化效率低下，我们提出三步分词器扩展算法，添加埃文语特定字素（eng、oe、o-umlaut）、白名单词汇和BPE合并，将每词平均词元数减少27%（从4.99降至3.64）。使用Qwen3-VL-4B的LoRA微调，我们使模型适配文本任务（0.53%可训练参数，秩32），并单独适配视觉问答（秩64，冻结视觉编码器）。我们的最佳配置在文本基准上达到11.4%精确匹配和13.6加权分数，句子翻译chrF为0.1283，VQA准确率为65%（基础模型和仅文本微调均为0%）。我们发布数据集、评估基准和训练流程，以支持对埃文语及其他低资源语言的进一步研究。

items.title_en: Agentic-Teacher: An Agentic Data Engine for Failure-Driven VLA Post-Training
items.title_zh: Agentic-Teacher：一种用于失败驱动VLA后训练的智能体数据引擎
items.abstract_en: Improving a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model requires demonstrations that address its weaknesses and provide effective supervision for learning. Coding agents can autonomously generate demonstrations through environment interaction, yet successful execution alone does not ensure effective supervision for VLA learning. We introduce Agentic-Teacher, an autonomous data engine for failure-driven VLA post-training. Given a VLA checkpoint, a task specification, and configured environment tools, the engine analyzes failed rollouts, selects intervention states, and iteratively develops closed-loop code policies through execution feedback. Validated policies become reusable demonstration generators that collect successful continuations from states where the VLA struggles. To make these demonstrations suitable for learning, Agentic-Teacher introduces temporally correlated action noise to broaden state-action coverage, removes idle frames while preserving gripper transitions, and filters trajectories using the frozen base model's flow-matching loss. The resulting demonstrations are combined with successful VLA rollouts for post-training, yielding an updated policy that operates without coding-agent assistance. Agentic-Teacher thus connects the weaknesses of a target VLA to both the generation and curation of its training data. In simulation, it improves $π_0$ success rates from 79.4% to 87.8% on LIBERO-10, from 80.4% to 90.6% on MetaWorld-10, and from 0% to 30.0% across three RoboCasa tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 改进预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要针对其弱点并提供有效学习监督的演示。编码智能体可通过环境交互自主生成演示，但仅成功执行并不能确保对VLA学习的有效监督。我们提出Agentic-Teacher，一种用于失败驱动VLA后训练的自主数据引擎。给定VLA检查点、任务规范和配置的环境工具，该引擎分析失败执行轨迹，选择干预状态，并通过执行反馈迭代开发闭环代码策略。经过验证的策略成为可复用的演示生成器，从VLA表现困难的状态收集成功后续片段。为使这些演示适合学习，Agentic-Teacher引入时间相关动作噪声以扩大状态-动作覆盖，移除空闲帧同时保留夹爪过渡，并使用冻结基础模型的流匹配损失过滤轨迹。所得演示与成功的VLA轨迹结合用于后训练，产生无需编码智能体辅助即可运行的更新策略。因此，Agentic-Teacher将目标VLA的弱点与其训练数据的生成和策展连接起来。在仿真中，它将π0在LIBERO-10上的成功率从79.4%提高到87.8%，在MetaWorld-10上从80.4%提高到90.6%，在三个RoboCasa任务上从0%提高到30.0%。

items.title_en: Real-Time Diffusion Relighting as a Neural Sensor: Closing the Low-Light Domain Gap for Robotic Perception
items.title_zh: 实时扩散重光照作为神经传感器：弥合机器人感知的低光域差距
items.abstract_en: Low-light conditions severely degrade robotic perception: object detectors trained on daylight imagery are prone to failure under dark and adverse weather conditions that fall outside of their training distribution. Furthermore, from an efficiency standpoint, existing Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) methods are designed for offline processing and are therefore impractical to integrate into live control loops. To address these issues, we propose to embed a Generative Neural Sensor within the control loop that treats illumination as a generative prior rather than a signal processing problem, enabling task-relevant semantic recovery. We further propose an Real-Time Perceptual Architecture that decouples high-latency semantic recovery from low-latency robotic control. Rather than blocking the control loop, our system runs a large-scale image-to-image diffusion model in a background thread, and is activated only when a drop in detection confidence signals a perceptual uncertainty event, significantly reducing computational overhead. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance on the ExDark low-light benchmark with 87.1% mAP, and under adverse weather conditions, significantly boosts detection rates over competing methods. On a navigation task in a closed-loop autonomous driving simulator (CARLA), we achieve a 100% lap completion rate, establishing a simulation-based proof-of-concept for integrating high-latency generative models with standard robotic control autonomy stacks.
items.abstract_zh: 低光条件会严重降低机器人感知性能：在日光图像上训练的目标检测器，在落在其训练分布之外的黑暗和恶劣天气条件下容易失效。此外，从效率角度看，现有的低光图像增强（LLIE）方法是为离线处理设计的，因此难以集成到实时控制回路中。为解决这些问题，我们提出在控制回路中嵌入一个生成式神经传感器，将光照视为生成式先验而非信号处理问题，从而实现任务相关的语义恢复。我们进一步提出一种实时感知架构，将高延迟的语义恢复与低延迟的机器人控制解耦。我们的系统不会阻塞控制回路，而是在后台线程中运行大规模图像到图像扩散模型，并且仅在检测置信度下降发出感知不确定性事件信号时激活，从而显著降低计算开销。我们的方法在 ExDark 低光基准上以 87.1% mAP 创下新的最先进性能，并且在恶劣天气条件下，相比竞争方法显著提升检测率。在闭环自动驾驶模拟器（CARLA）中的导航任务上，我们实现了 100% 的圈完成率，为将高延迟生成模型与标准机器人控制自主栈集成建立了基于仿真的概念验证。

items.title_en: Tracking single neurons across days reveals acute and persistent effects of psilocybin in the mouse brain
items.title_zh: 跨天追踪单个神经元揭示裸盖菇素在小鼠脑中的急性与持续效应
items.abstract_en: The psychedelic psilocybin offers a novel approach to treat depression and other psychiatric disorders. A single dose of psilocybin induces rapid neuroplastic effects that persist for many weeks to months. However, psilocybin's effect on neural firing beyond its systemic presence, and the neural mechanisms linking these acute and sustained effects remain unknown. Using chronically implanted Neuropixels probes, we tracked 1,692 neurons spanning prefrontal and hippocampal regions following saline and psilocybin injections and 24 h later. Psilocybin bidirectionally modulated firing acutely in a cell-type and region-specific manner. Persistent firing (24 h post-injection) is net suppressed relative to saline, including in acutely activated neurons. The late acute response, but not early peak response, predicted a neuron's firing 24 h later. To our knowledge, this is the first evidence that directly reveals psilocybin's sustained impacts on neuronal firing, providing key insight into the circuitry accompanying its lasting cognitive and behavioral alterations.
items.abstract_zh: 迷幻剂裸盖菇素为治疗抑郁症和其他精神疾病提供了一种新方法。单剂量的裸盖菇素可诱导快速的神经可塑性效应，并持续数周至数月。然而，裸盖菇素在其全身存在之外对神经放电的影响，以及连接这些急性效应和持续效应的神经机制，仍然未知。使用慢性植入的 Neuropixels 探针，我们在注射生理盐水和裸盖菇素后以及 24 小时后，追踪了跨越前额叶和海马区域的 1,692 个神经元。裸盖菇素以细胞类型和区域特异性的方式对放电进行急性双向调节。持久放电（注射后 24 小时）相对于生理盐水总体上受到抑制，包括在急性激活的神经元中。晚期急性反应，而非早期峰值反应，预测了神经元 24 小时后的放电。据我们所知，这是首次直接揭示裸盖菇素对神经元放电持续影响的证据，为伴随其持久认知和行为改变的回路提供了关键见解。

items.title_en: Dissipation as a Resource for Entanglement via High-Spin Mediator Purification
items.title_zh: 耗散作为纠缠资源：通过高自旋中介体纯化
items.abstract_en: We study entanglement generation between two spin qubits mediated by a single, thermally mixed, high-spin ($S=5/2$) magnetic impurity, using the Lindblad master equation to compare coherent and dissipative control of the mediator. We show that no coherent drive, however strong or resonant, can purify the mediator beyond its thermal value --- a direct consequence of unitary evolution exactly preserving state purity --- while a dissipative channel purifies it up to the limit set by the optical pumping cycle itself, $\mathrm{Tr}[ρ_M^2]\approx0.8$. Modeling this channel with rates fixed by the measured optical pumping of a single Mn spin, we find that the entanglement it enables is not monotonic in the pump strength: it peaks at a finite rate and then decreases, since the same channel leaks decoherence to the qubits through the coupling that mediates their entanglement. At the experimental pumping rate, a single $80$ns pulse purifies the mediator, the resulting polarization persists for a timescale three orders of magnitude longer than the entangling dynamics, and the first-recurrence negativity rises from $0.18$ to $0.64$ at $12$K, remaining above $0.6$ up to $30$K. These results establish dissipation, not as noise to be suppressed, but as the very resource that makes robust entanglement generation possible.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究由单个热混合的高自旋（$S=5/2$）磁性杂质介导的两个自旋量子比特之间的纠缠产生，并使用 Lindblad 主方程比较对中介体的相干控制与耗散控制。我们表明，任何相干驱动，无论多强或共振，都无法将中介体纯化到超过其热值——这是酉演化精确保持态纯度的直接结果——而耗散通道可将其纯化到由光泵浦循环本身设定的极限，$\mathrm{Tr}[ρ_M^2]\approx0.8$。用以单个 Mn 自旋的实测光泵浦固定速率的通道进行建模，我们发现其实现的纠缠对泵浦强度并非单调：它在一个有限速率处达到峰值，然后下降，因为同一通道通过介导其纠缠的耦合向量子比特泄漏退相干。在实验泵浦速率下，单个 $80$ns 脉冲即可纯化中介体，所产生的极化持续时间比纠缠动力学长三个数量级，并且在 $12$K 时首次复现负度从 $0.18$ 升至 $0.64$，在高达 $30$K 时仍高于 $0.6$。这些结果确立：耗散不是应被抑制的噪声，而是使稳健纠缠产生成为可能的资源本身。

items.title_en: Why Finite Intelligence Works in an Infinite World: A Mathematical Theory
items.title_zh: 为什么有限智能在无限世界中有效：一个数学理论
items.abstract_en: An information system often has to learn before it knows what it will be asked. A finite representation can succeed without recording an infinite environment in full when those asks share collective structure, rather than demand unrelated facts scattered arbitrarily across it. We formalize this phenomenon through future-task information, the minimum retained information needed to preserve decision value relative to the available evidence. A joint decision-regret state records posterior comparisons among actions for every permitted task. Under compactness assumptions, every retained representation admits a calibrated replacement based on this state, preserving all task regrets without increasing information; the resulting information-regret curve equals an operational coding rate. Two exact boundaries govern finite preservation: weak-star closure for a fixed action count, and the singular mass of the source-evidence law when all finite action menus are admitted. Collective structure determines information requirements beyond individual-question difficulty. Families with identical source laws, pairwise task metrics, and individual-task rates can have different high-resolution exponents. Covariance-identical coordinate and parity families have different exact rate-distortion curves, with optimal parity retention characterized by a sharp Fourier-entropy inequality. For balanced nested task families, refinement sizes and weighted reach determine the rate within an additive constant, attained by prefix coding under explicit decay conditions. Nonlinear learning and computational separations distinguish preservation from efficient discovery and use. The proposed mathematical theory identifies which shared decision requirements allow finite information to remain useful for infinitely many possible purposes.
items.abstract_zh: 信息系统常常必须在知道自己将被问什么之前进行学习。当这些提问共享集体结构，而不是要求分散在其任意位置的不相关事实时，有限表示可以在不完整记录无限环境的情况下成功。我们通过未来任务信息来形式化这一现象，即相对于可用证据保持决策价值所需的最小保留信息。联合决策遗憾状态记录了每个允许任务下动作之间的后验比较。在紧性假设下，每个保留表示都允许基于该状态的校准替换，在不增加信息的情况下保持所有任务遗憾；由此得到的信息-遗憾曲线等于一个操作编码速率。两个精确边界支配有限保持：固定动作数量下的弱星闭包，以及当允许所有有限动作菜单时源-证据律的奇异质量。集体结构决定了超越单个问题难度的信息需求。具有相同源律、成对任务度量和单任务速率的族可以具有不同的高分辨率指数。协方差相同的坐标族和奇偶族具有不同的精确率失真曲线，其中最优奇偶保留由尖锐的傅里叶熵不等式刻画。对于平衡嵌套任务族，细化规模和加权可达性在加性常数内决定速率，并在显式衰减条件下由前缀编码达到。非线性学习和计算分离将保持与高效发现和使用区分开来。所提出的数学理论识别了哪些共享决策需求使有限信息能够对无限多种可能用途保持有用。

items.title_en: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
items.title_zh: AI 审稿意见偏向附录
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. This behavior holds across the API, coding-agent, and web access methods for using LLMs to review a paper. In contrast, we find that humans draw only 8.4% of their weaknesses from the appendix, and these weaknesses primarily revolve around a paper's presentation and content related to its core idea. Meanwhile, LLMs draw weaknesses from deep in the appendix that concern fine-grained technical details not central to the paper's contributions. We anticipate that our analysis will contribute to the scholarly discourse on AI reviews. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/cincynlp/review_appendix.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被审稿人用于在审稿过程中指出弱点，其输出常常影响人类提交的审稿意见。先前工作研究了 LLM 审稿意见与人类审稿意见的一致性，但我们对这些模型实际上批评论文的哪些部分知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们调查了来自 ACL、EMNLP、COLM 和 ICLR 的 2,000 篇论文，并表明最新的 GPT 和 Claude 模型约 50% 或更多的审稿弱点来自附录。这种行为在使用 LLM 审稿的 API、编码智能体和网页访问方法中均存在。相比之下，我们发现人类只有 8.4% 的弱点来自附录，并且这些弱点主要围绕论文的表述以及与其核心思想相关的内容。同时，LLM 从附录深处提取弱点，涉及与论文贡献并不核心的细粒度技术细节。我们预计我们的分析将有助于关于 AI 审稿的学术讨论。我们的代码公开在：https://github.com/cincynlp/review_appendix。

items.title_en: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
items.title_zh: ESI：面向 LLM-VLA 智能体的具身自我改进飞轮
items.abstract_en: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.
items.abstract_zh: 独立预训练的语言模型和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为具身智能体提供了互补的构建模块，但将它们连接起来并不会自动产生协调行为。VLA 可能生成偏离 LLM 预期子任务的动作，并且在一次纠正后重新获得控制时，撤销 LLM 恢复的有希望状态。我们提出 ESI（具身自我改进，Embodied Self-Improvement），一个利用环境交互来对齐推理与动作的自动飞轮。ESI 将模块化智能体作为后训练单元，反复细化引导 LLM 的提示、表达其意图的共享技能接口以及实现该意图的 VLA 参数，然后将这些组件一起重新部署。我们的关键见解是，协作本身可以为改进该接口提供监督。LLM 的子任务决策为策略应执行什么提供语义监督，而其有效纠正和后续学生延续为恢复与交接提供动作级监督。学生也从自身的有效执行中学习，使得即使整个回合失败，局部有用的经验也能有所贡献。在十个选定的 RoboDojo 任务上，ESI 在不生成任务特定控制代码的情况下，使用 LLM-VLA 智能体取得了 62.03 的平均 Score 和 49.41% 的平均成功率。在这两项指标上，它优于所有混合具身智能体的已发表参考结果，包括 Agent+WAM 系统 GO-3 Nano Preview（47.27 Score 和 36.60% 成功率），以及所有比较的基于代码的方法。

items.title_en: Transmission-Mode Multispectral Imaging for Estimation of Microcystis spp. Cell Concentration and ELISA-Equivalent Microcystin Concentration in Water
items.title_zh: 透射模式多光谱成像用于估计水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量微囊藻毒素浓度
items.abstract_en: Harmful algal blooms dominated by Microcystis spp. threaten freshwater systems through proliferation and microcystin (MC) production. Conventional measurements of cyanobacterial abundance and MC concentration commonly require laboratory processing, specialized instrumentation, or assay reagents. Because MC concentration cannot always be reliably inferred from cell abundance, complementary optical approaches for estimating both quantities are of interest. This study proposes and evaluates a transmission mode multispectral imaging (MSI) framework for estimating Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration from culture derived dilution samples. A custom built MSI system acquiring twelve spectral bands from near-ultraviolet to near-infrared wavelengths measured transmitted light spectral responses. Following principal component analysis based dimensionality reduction, spectral variation was quantified using an aggregated Wasserstein distance descriptor for regression based prediction. Cell concentration estimation yielded $R^2=0.9819$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9754$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels, while ELISA-equivalent MC estimation yielded $R^2=0.9788$ for calibration and $R^2=0.9786$ on held-out intermediate dilution levels. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transmission-mode MSI as a dual output optical calibration framework for estimation of Microcystis spp. cell concentration and ELISA-equivalent MC concentration in water.
items.abstract_zh: 以微囊藻属（Microcystis spp.）为主导的有害藻华通过增殖和微囊藻毒素（MC）产生威胁淡水系统。常规的蓝细菌丰度和MC浓度测量通常需要实验室处理、专用仪器或检测试剂。由于并非总能由细胞丰度可靠推断MC浓度，因此用于估计这两种量的互补光学方法受到关注。本研究提出并评估一种透射模式多光谱成像（MSI）框架，用于从培养来源的稀释样品中估计微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量MC浓度。一套定制构建的MSI系统采集从近紫外到近红外波长的12个光谱波段，测量透射光光谱响应。在基于主成分分析（PCA）的降维之后，使用聚合Wasserstein距离描述符量化光谱变化，用于基于回归的预测。细胞浓度估计在校准中R^2=0.9819，在留出的中间稀释水平上R^2=0.9754；ELISA当量MC估计在校准中R^2=0.9788，在留出的中间稀释水平上R^2=0.9786。这些结果证明透射模式MSI作为一种双输出光学校准框架用于估计水中微囊藻属细胞浓度和ELISA当量MC浓度的可行性。
authors: K. A. D. S. A. Perera

items.title_en: A four-dimensional single-cell and spatial atlas of cAMP-driven repair after rat spinal cord injury
items.title_zh: 大鼠脊髓损伤后cAMP驱动修复的四维单细胞和空间图谱
items.abstract_en: Cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) induction through photoactivatable adenylate cyclase (bPAC) in corticospinal neurons enhances locomotion after spinal cord injury (SCI); however, the molecular and cellular mechanisms that underlie this improvement are unknown. Here we perform single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics (ST) of spinal cord sections at the injury site of dorsal hemisected rats, to identify the pathways through which bPAC stimulation exerts its regenerative cues after SCI, along with the changes in cellular populations that occur in different parts of the spinal cord.
items.abstract_zh: 通过光可激活腺苷酸环化酶（bPAC）在皮质脊髓神经元中诱导环磷酸腺苷（cAMP）可增强脊髓损伤（SCI）后的运动；然而，这种改善背后的分子和细胞机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们对背侧半切大鼠损伤部位的脊髓切片进行单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）和空间转录组学（ST），以识别bPAC刺激在SCI后发挥再生线索所经由的通路，以及脊髓不同部位发生的细胞群体变化。

items.title_en: Topological phase diagram of an extended Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with negative coupling
items.title_zh: 具有负耦合的扩展Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型的拓扑相图
items.abstract_en: Recently, an extended Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with three atoms per unit cell has been experimentally realized in perovskite exciton-polariton micropillars. A distinctive feature of this system is that the second and third bands undergo a topological transition through a band crossing at the wave vector $k=0$, associated with a negative coupling. In this work, we analytically determine the phase diagram of the model as a function of the on-site energy splitting and the ratio of intercell to intracell hopping amplitudes. We identify seven regions in this lane, with four distinct topological phases, characterized by different Zak phases of the three bands. Our results provide a useful theoretical framework for interpreting existing experiments and serve as a guide for future experimental investigations of this system.
items.abstract_zh: 最近，每个晶胞含三个原子的扩展Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型已在钙钛矿激子-极化子微柱中实验实现。该体系的一个显著特征是，第二和第三能带通过波矢k=0处的能带交叉发生拓扑转变，这与负耦合相关。在这项工作中，我们解析地确定该模型作为格点能劈裂和胞间与胞内跃迁振幅之比的函数的相图。我们在该相图中识别出七个区域，包含四个不同的拓扑相，由三个能带的不同Zak相刻画。我们的结果为解释现有实验提供了有用的理论框架，并为该体系未来的实验研究提供指导。

items.title_en: How Robust are Pinching-Antenna Systems to Practical Deployment Imperfections?
items.title_zh: 夹持天线系统对实际部署不完美因素的鲁棒性如何？
items.abstract_en: This paper investigates the robustness of pinching-antenna systems (PASSs) to three practical deployment imperfections: pinching-antenna (PA) positioning errors, imperfect channel state information (CSI), and line-of-sight (LoS) blockages. We develop analytical frameworks to quantify the performance degradation caused by each imperfection. For PA positioning errors, we employ a Brownian meander model to characterize the distribution and mean of the resulting signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) loss. The results show that positioning errors can diminish the gains from long-term position selection, with the loss becoming more pronounced under stronger shadow fading. For imperfect CSI, we characterize the distribution and moments of the true scattered channel power at the position selected using noisy channel estimates. The resulting selection penalty is governed by the ratio of noise variance to the number of channel measurements, while the upper tail of the selected channel power retains the same behavior as under perfect CSI. Finally, we develop a spatially consistent blockage model and derive the distribution of the optimum long-term SNR for arbitrary blockage configurations, together with a numerically tractable expression for a single blockage. Simulation results validate the analyses and highlight a fundamental property of PASSs: although positioning errors and imperfect CSI can reduce the gains from position selection, good performance can still be achieved provided that an LoS link is available. In particular, even when a large proportion of the waveguide is blocked, PA repositioning can establish LoS links and enable performance close to that of a fully unblocked system for the considered configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究夹持天线系统（PASSs）对三种实际部署不完美因素的鲁棒性：夹持天线（PA）定位误差、不完美信道状态信息（CSI）和视距（LoS）阻塞。我们建立分析框架来量化每种不完美因素造成的性能退化。对于PA定位误差，我们采用布朗蜿蜒（Brownian meander）模型刻画由此产生的信噪比（SNR）损失的分布和均值。结果表明，定位误差会削弱长期位置选择带来的增益，且这种损失在更强阴影衰落条件下更明显。对于不完美CSI，我们刻画在利用含噪信道估计所选位置上真实散射信道功率的分布和矩。由此产生的选择惩罚由噪声方差与信道测量次数之比决定，而所选信道功率的上尾仍保持与完美CSI情况下相同的行为。最后，我们建立空间一致的阻塞模型，推导任意阻塞配置下最优长期SNR的分布，并给出单个阻塞下数值可处理的表达式。仿真结果验证了分析，并凸显了PASSs的一个基本特性：尽管定位误差和不完美CSI会降低位置选择带来的增益，但只要存在LoS链路，仍可实现良好性能。特别地，即使在波导很大一部分被阻塞时，对于所考虑的配置，PA重新定位仍可建立LoS链路并使性能接近完全未阻塞系统。

items.title_en: Learning Word-Level Explanations of Text Reuse in Latin Literature with Little Annotation
items.title_zh: 少标注学习拉丁文学中文本复用的词级解释
items.abstract_en: Detecting an intertextual reference is only the first step; philologists also need to know how a later author reworked the source. We explain a reuse pair word by word: each word of the reusing passage is first aligned to its source word, then labeled with the operation that transformed it, such as a copy, a change of inflection, or a substitution. Such word-level operations are expensive to annotate, and only a few corpora annotated at this level exist for text reuse in Latin literature. We describe a procedure that needs only a limited number of annotations: synthetic pairs, built by applying known operations to Latin text, train a first model, and active learning chooses the pairs an annotator corrects. Among several architectures, a model that links and labels together performs best: a pointer network that, for every reuse word, chooses a source word and names the operation in the same step. We show that with active learning, 200 pairs chosen by uncertainty are enough for the model to match one trained on every annotated pair of the 1,490 references of the Loci Similes benchmark. We release our code, word-level predictions for all references, and an interactive demo.
items.abstract_zh: 检测互文引用只是第一步；语文学家还需要知道后来的作者如何改写来源。我们逐词解释一个复用对：复用段落中的每个词首先与来源词对齐，然后标注对其进行转换的操作，例如复制、词形变化改变或替换。这种词级操作的标注成本很高，针对拉丁文学中的文本复用，仅有少数按此级别标注的语料库。我们描述一种仅需有限标注的流程：通过对拉丁文本施加已知操作构建合成对，用于训练初始模型，并由主动学习选择供标注者纠正的对。在若干架构中，将链接和标注结合在一起的模型表现最佳：一种指针网络，对于每个复用词，在同一步中选择一个来源词并命名该操作。我们表明，借助主动学习，按不确定性选择的200个对足以使模型匹配在Loci Similes基准的1,490条引用的每个标注对上训练的模型。我们发布代码、所有引用的词级预测以及交互式演示。

items.title_en: CT-SGAL-LIO: Causal Continuous Time Refinement of Discrete LiDAR Inertial Odometry
items.title_zh: CT-SGAL-LIO：离散LiDAR惯性里程计的因果连续时间细化
items.abstract_en: State-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry methods, including those on richer state manifolds, achieve strong global accuracy, yet their pose stream alternates between propagation and correction and can oscillate over short horizons even when globally accurate. Most existing methods follow these approaches: they either modify the filter to enable faster updates or estimate a continuous-time trajectory from raw LiDAR and inertial data. The latter involves extra optimization, delaying state updates and becoming less robust during rapid rotations or accelerations. We propose CT-SGAL-LIO, a continuous-time refinement module that smooths the posterior pose stream of a discrete SGal(3) estimator without modifying the estimator itself. The key novelty is to perform continuous-time trajectory refinement directly on the projected SGal(3) posterior: we fit a cubic trajectory over a bounded window of recent poses and evaluate it at a small fixed lag. This places the query time within the observed interval, so the refined pose is obtained by interpolation rather than extrapolation, while preserving causal operation. CT-SGAL-LIO improves relative trajectory accuracy on 17 sequences from three public benchmarks. Across 17 sequences from GRAND-TOUR, MCD, and GEODE, CT-SGAL-LIO improves short-term motion accuracy while largely preserving global accuracy. RTE improves by up to 70% on GRAND-TOUR and on all seven GEODE sequences, with 9.9-51.1% reductions. A 19.5-min R-Campus run also reduces posterior jumps by 85.4% with only a 4.7 mm change in the end-to-start gap. We plan to release our source code and results to support community validation and reproducibility.
items.abstract_zh: 最先进的LiDAR惯性里程计方法，包括在更丰富状态流形上的方法，实现了较强的全局精度，但其位姿流在传播和校正之间交替，并且即使全局准确，也可能在短时域内振荡。大多数现有方法采用以下途径：要么修改滤波器以实现更快更新，要么从原始LiDAR和惯性数据估计连续时间轨迹。后者涉及额外优化，延迟状态更新，并在快速旋转或加速期间变得较不鲁棒。我们提出CT-SGAL-LIO，一种连续时间细化模块，在不修改估计器本身的情况下平滑离散SGal(3)估计器的后验位姿流。关键新颖之处在于直接在投影后的SGal(3)后验上执行连续时间轨迹细化：在最近位姿的有界窗口上拟合三次轨迹，并在小的固定延迟处求值。这将查询时间置于观测区间内，因此细化位姿通过插值而非外推获得，同时保持因果运行。CT-SGAL-LIO在来自三个公开基准的17个序列上提高了相对轨迹精度。在来自GRAND-TOUR、MCD和GEODE的17个序列上，CT-SGAL-LIO提高了短期运动精度，同时基本保持全局精度。RTE在GRAND-TOUR上最高改善70%，并在所有七个GEODE序列上取得9.9–51.1%的降低。一次19.5分钟的R-Campus运行还将后验跳变减少85.4%，而端到起始间隙仅变化4.7 mm。我们计划发布源代码和结果，以支持社区验证和可复现性。

items.title_en: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
items.title_zh: Kosmo-GFM：一个面向生产环境的几何基础模型
items.abstract_en: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Kosmo-GFM，一个场景重建系统，集成了几何基础模型（GFM）、位姿优化引擎（PoseEngine）以及来自 KosmoWorld 的重建衍生监督。GFM 从图像和视频预测相机参数、深度、跨视图对应关系和动态 3D 点。PoseEngine 将这些预测与几何优化相结合，为下游 3D 和 4D 高斯泼溅恢复场景级相机位姿和几何。KosmoWorld 从重建的真实世界场景生成图像和几何监督，以改进 GFM 的几何预测。在 SpatialBench 的 Sparse 和 Medium 子集上，GFM 在对比方法中取得最低的绝对相对深度误差和最高的 5 度相对位姿 AUC。在五个评估数据集上，它还在动态点和场景流方面取得最低的平均端点误差。在所有对比重建系统完成的 34 个场景中，PoseEngine 在 1、3 和 5 度阈值下取得最高的场景平均位姿 AUC，累计运行时间为 14.07 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 的 69.67 小时的 20%。PoseEngine Flash 提供了进一步的精度-效率权衡，实测混合精度运行时间为 2.62 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 运行时间的 4%。单独的规模扩展实验显示，随着数据、模型计算和训练预算增加，总体呈现有利趋势。这些结果支持在场景级重建流程中使用学习到的几何先验。

items.title_en: An isogenic human stem cell model reveals NGLY1-dependent control of microglial development
items.title_zh: 一个同基因人类干细胞模型揭示 NGLY1 依赖的小胶质细胞发育控制
items.abstract_en: NGLY1 is a cytosolic N-glycanase involved in glycoprotein quality control and proteasome-mediated protein degradation and is critical for normal brain development and function. Although neuronal alterations caused by NGLY1 deficiency have been extensively characterized in animal and human cell models, how NGLY1 deficiency affects human glial cells, particularly microglia, the brain-resident innate immune cells, remains largely unknown. Using patient-derived NGLY1-deficient human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) lines and their corresponding CRISPR-mediated gene-corrected isogenic lines, we found that NGLY1-deficient primitive macrophage progenitors (PMPs) exhibited increased GlcNAc-Asn (GNA) accumulation and elevated expression of RUNX1, a key transcription factor regulating myeloid lineage development, accompanied by abnormal proliferation. Following further differentiation, NGLY1-deficient human microglia exhibited reduced morphological complexity and impaired phagocytic capacity. In addition, NGLY1-deficient microglia showed increased expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1{beta}, IL-6, and TNF, under both basal and stimulated conditions, indicative of a heightened inflammatory state. Mechanistically, our data showed that RUNX1 upregulation induced by NGLY1 deficiency partially mediated impaired PMP proliferation and subsequent microglial abnormalities, implicating RUNX1 dysregulation in NGLY1-associated microglial dysfunction and identifying RUNX1 as a potential therapeutic target. Together, using patient-derived and gene-corrected isogenic hiPSCs, our study establishes a human stem cell platform for modeling NGLY1 deficiency and reveals that impaired deglycosylation alters human microglial developmental trajectories and ultimately compromises microglial homeostasis and function. These microglial abnormalities may contribute to the neurological deficits observed in patients carrying loss-of-function variants in NGLY1.
items.abstract_zh: NGLY1 是一种胞质 N-聚糖酶，参与糖蛋白质量控制和蛋白酶体介导的蛋白质降解，对正常大脑发育和功能至关重要。尽管 NGLY1 缺陷引起的神经元改变已在动物和人类细胞模型中得到广泛表征，但 NGLY1 缺陷如何影响人类胶质细胞，尤其是脑内驻留的先天免疫细胞小胶质细胞，仍很大程度上未知。利用患者来源的 NGLY1 缺陷人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）系及其相应的 CRISPR 介导基因校正同基因系，我们发现 NGLY1 缺陷的原始巨噬细胞祖细胞（PMP）表现出 GlcNAc-Asn（GNA）积累增加，以及调节髓系发育的关键转录因子 RUNX1 表达升高，并伴有异常增殖。进一步分化后，NGLY1 缺陷的人类小胶质细胞表现出形态复杂性降低和吞噬能力受损。此外，NGLY1 缺陷小胶质细胞在基础和刺激条件下均显示促炎细胞因子（包括 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF）表达增加，表明炎症状态增强。机制上，我们的数据表明，NGLY1 缺陷诱导的 RUNX1 上调部分介导了 PMP 增殖受损及随后的小胶质细胞异常，提示 RUNX1 失调参与 NGLY1 相关小胶质细胞功能障碍，并确定 RUNX1 为潜在治疗靶点。总之，利用患者来源和基因校正的同基因 hiPSC，我们的研究建立了一个用于模拟 NGLY1 缺陷的人类干细胞平台，并揭示去糖基化受损改变人类小胶质细胞发育轨迹，最终损害小胶质细胞稳态和功能。这些小胶质细胞异常可能促成了携带 NGLY1 功能丧失变异患者中观察到的神经功能缺陷。

items.title_en: Tessa: Encoding Classical Data Across an Entire Quantum Processor
items.title_zh: Tessa：在整个量子处理器上编码经典数据
items.abstract_en: We present Tessa, a hardware-aware, device-wide scheme to encode classical data on quantum computers. We use it to experimentally encode and decode up to $1568$ real values using IBM's Phoenix and Fez quantum computers on a variety of data. Tessa's construction is an extension of QPIXL and QCrank. However, it checkerboards address and data qubits across a coupling graph with neighbouring data qubits sharing only a subset of address qubits. When using the device's coupling graph no SWAP gates or routing is required, but the construction works for any bipartite coupling graph. The shots required for readout are determined by the local coupling degree. As examples, we have used cat states (pixel art of cats), various pixel art, audio, MIDI, DNA sequences and protein amino acid sequences.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Tessa，一种硬件感知、器件范围的方案，用于在量子计算机上编码经典数据。我们使用它在 IBM 的 Phoenix 和 Fez 量子计算机上，针对多种数据实验性地编码和解码最多 1568 个实数值。Tessa 的构造是 QPIXL 和 QCrank 的扩展。然而，它在耦合图上以棋盘格方式布置地址量子比特和数据量子比特，相邻数据量子比特仅共享地址量子比特的一个子集。使用器件的耦合图时，不需要 SWAP 门或路由，但该构造适用于任何二分耦合图。读出所需的测量次数由局部耦合度决定。作为示例，我们使用了猫态（猫的像素艺术）、各种像素艺术、音频、MIDI、DNA 序列和蛋白质氨基酸序列。

items.title_en: On the Limits of Sufficient Explanations
items.title_zh: 论充分解释的局限
items.abstract_en: We formally characterize the conditions under which sufficient explanations exist for classifiers on structured data such as graphs and strings. We focus on post-hoc explainers that select parts of the input as sufficient explanations. An explanation is sufficient if the selected part alone ensures the predicted label. Sufficient explanations have been widely adopted across data modalities, including graphs, strings, and images. However, a unified formal analysis of sufficient explanations remains missing. We bridge this gap with four main contributions: (i) We define a general explanation formalism consisting of an instance space, a classifier, and a select relation. The select relation specifies which potential sub-instances or feature subsets can be selected as explanations from each instance; (ii) We show that the existence of sufficient explainers is fully characterized by the interplay between the classifier and the select relation; (iii) We extend this analysis to practically relevant variants of sufficiency, including probabilistic sufficiency and deletion sufficiency; (iv) Based on the formal analysis, we devise statistics that bound the maximum achievable sufficiency for a given task. We evaluate these statistics on language, protein, and molecular classification datasets and find that full sufficiency is unattainable on most of them. Since these bounds hold for every explainer, they provide a task-level reference against which any explainer's sufficiency can be judged in absolute terms.
items.abstract_zh: 我们正式刻画了在图和字符串等结构化数据上分类器的充分解释存在的条件。我们关注将输入部分选为充分解释的事后解释器。如果仅所选部分就能确保预测标签，则该解释是充分的。充分解释已被广泛采用于包括图、字符串和图像在内的多种数据模态。然而，仍缺乏对充分解释的统一形式分析。我们以四项主要贡献填补这一空白：(i) 我们定义了一个通用解释形式体系，由实例空间、分类器和选择关系组成。选择关系规定从每个实例中可以选择哪些潜在子实例或特征子集作为解释；(ii) 我们表明充分解释器的存在性完全由分类器与选择关系之间的相互作用所刻画；(iii) 我们将这一分析扩展到实际相关的充分性变体，包括概率充分性和删除充分性；(iv) 基于形式分析，我们设计了统计量来界定给定任务可达到的最大充分性。我们在语言、蛋白质和分子分类数据集上评估这些统计量，发现其中大多数无法达到完全充分性。由于这些界对每个解释器都成立，它们提供了一个任务级参考，可用于绝对地评判任何解释器的充分性。

items.title_en: NER-D: A cross-domain benchmark for German NER
items.title_zh: NER-D：一个德语 NER 的跨域基准
items.abstract_en: We present NER-D, a cross-domain benchmark for German NER comprising 13 datasets spanning 9 domains, including General/Politics, Wikipedia, Legal, Medical, Historical, Financial, Agriculture and Archaeology. We examine the performance of both proprietary LLMs and state-of-the-art small open-source models using normal prompting and further examine the performance gains achievable via in-context learning and LoRA fine-tuning. Our results show that without any sort of optimization a proprietary model (GPT-5.4 mini) outperforms the smaller open-source models on 6 out of 13 datasets, but LoRA fine-tuning enables the smaller models to substantially outperform the proprietary baseline. We further analyze the influence of the domain and the tagset used in each task on the performance achieved in the different evaluation settings. Our benchmark will be available as a resource for the development of future German NER methods on both general and specialized domains.\footnote{We make our code, data, and models publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 NER-D，一个德语 NER 的跨域基准，包含跨越 9 个领域的 13 个数据集，包括通用/政治、维基百科、法律、医学、历史、金融、农业和考古学。我们使用常规提示考察专有 LLM 和最先进的小型开源模型的性能，并进一步考察通过上下文学习和 LoRA 微调可获得的性能提升。我们的结果表明，在没有任何优化的情况下，一个专有模型（GPT-5.4 mini）在 13 个数据集中的 6 个上优于较小的开源模型，但 LoRA 微调使较小模型能够大幅优于专有基线。我们进一步分析领域和每个任务所用标签集对不同评估设置下所获性能的影响。我们的基准将作为资源提供，用于未来通用和专门领域德语 NER 方法的开发。\footnote{我们将在论文被接收后公开代码、数据和模型。

items.title_en: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
items.title_zh: VLA 能从调用它的智能体中学到什么？面向具身导航的任务级经验蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.
items.abstract_zh: 导航智能体使用大语言模型（LLM）规划器来调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要 LLM，增加了成本和延迟。我们将成功的智能体经验蒸馏到 VLA 中，而不是蒸馏规划器。于是 VLA 在测试时单独导航。智能体会话不是 VLA 演示。它们包含由规划器工具和子指令驱动的运动，以及绕行。我们提出 H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转换为 VLA 训练数据。每个运动都在原始任务指令下成为 VLA 动作，并以结果位姿作为目标。H2E 屏蔽远离目标步骤上的损失。它将目标 1 米范围内每个访问状态标记为停止。然后我们使用低秩适配更新 VLA。VLA 学会在目标处停止，并找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在所有 3,189 个 REVERIE-CE val-unseen 回合上，H2E 将 8B VLA 的成功率从 35.0% 提高到 44.9%。

items.title_en: Learning the Missing Derivative: Neural Multiple-Scattering Operators for Inverse Volume Rendering
items.title_zh: 学习缺失的导数：用于逆体积渲染的神经多重散射算子
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing optically thick media from photographs requires modeling multiple scattering and its response to changes in extinction. Frozen-source tomography discards this derivative; differentiable path tracing estimates it through expensive, noisy sampling. We instead predict the multiple-scattering field with a neural operator and differentiate through it during inverse rendering, while computing transmittance and single scattering directly. A further challenge arises during optimization: an operator that predicts the field accurately on held-out media can still produce poor derivatives at the density states visited by the optimizer. We address this by fine-tuning on states generated during inversions driven by the operator, using Monte Carlo scattering-field supervision. On held-out optically thick clouds, our method improves relighting over frozen-source tomography at equal time and outperforms differentiable path tracing given substantially more time. Training on inversion trajectories also improves derivative alignment at visited states and reduces optimization drift.
items.abstract_zh: 从照片重建光学厚介质需要建模多重散射及其对消光变化的响应。冻结源层析丢弃了这一导数；可微路径追踪通过昂贵且有噪声的采样来估计它。我们改用神经算子预测多重散射场，并在逆渲染过程中通过该算子进行微分，同时直接计算透射率和单次散射。优化过程中还会出现进一步挑战：一个在留出介质上能准确预测场的算子，在优化器访问的密度状态下仍可能产生较差的导数。我们通过在由该算子驱动的反演过程中生成的状态上进行微调来解决这一问题，并使用蒙特卡洛散射场监督。在留出的光学厚云上，我们的方法在同等时间下相比冻结源层析改善了重光照，并在给出显著更多时间时优于可微路径追踪。在反演轨迹上训练还改善了访问状态处的导数对齐，并减少了优化漂移。

items.title_en: Age-dependent changes in the putamen transcriptome and proteome of a transgenic minipig model of Huntington's disease
items.title_zh: 亨廷顿病转基因小型猪模型壳核转录组和蛋白质组的年龄依赖性变化
items.abstract_en: Huntington's disease is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder with no disease-modifying treatment available. Preclinical trials of gene therapies rely on large animal models and the transgenic Huntington's disease (TgHD) minipig is one of them. Minipigs live more than a decade, so the effect of a single dose of gene therapy can be followed for years. The TgHD transgene carries a mixed CAG/CAA repeat that is not expected to expand somatically. However, its putamen, part of the striatum that degenerates first in patients, had not been examined by genome-wide methods, nor beyond 4 years of age. We compared the putamen of transgenic and wild-type minipigs at 4 and 8 years by RNA sequencing and label-free mass spectrometry proteomics, and measured mutant huntingtin by immunoassay. Seven genes were differentially expressed at 4 years and 3,324 at 8 years, and the pathway changes of the transcriptome and the proteome were concordant at that age. The D2 medium spiny neuron marker gene set was reduced at 8 years in both the transcriptome and the proteome. Mitochondrial and oxidative phosphorylation pathways were positively enriched at 4 years and negatively enriched at 8 years. Immune and complement pathways were positively enriched at 8 years, and the number of altered splicing events increased almost fivefold between 4 and 8 years. We detected no age-dependent accumulation of soluble mutant huntingtin. Since the repeat does not expand, these changes developed without somatic expansion, a major driver of progression in human Huntington's disease. We propose that the reduced neuronal markers reflect a loss of neuronal identity rather than neuronal death. The TgHD minipig would then recapitulate the slow early phase of the disease, when treatment is arguably most likely to help.
items.abstract_zh: 亨廷顿病是一种遗传性神经退行性疾病，目前尚无疾病修饰治疗。基因治疗的临床前试验依赖大型动物模型，转基因亨廷顿病（TgHD）小型猪是其中之一。小型猪寿命超过十年，因此单次剂量基因治疗的效果可以随访多年。TgHD转基因携带混合CAG/CAA重复，预计不会在体细胞中扩增。然而，其壳核——患者中最先退变的纹状体的一部分——尚未用全基因组方法检查，也未检查4岁以上。我们通过RNA测序和无标记质谱蛋白质组学比较了4岁和8岁转基因与野生型小型猪的壳核，并通过免疫分析测量了突变型亨廷顿蛋白。4岁时有7个基因差异表达，8岁时有3,324个，且在该年龄转录组和蛋白质组的通路变化一致。D2型中型多棘神经元标志基因集在8岁时在转录组和蛋白质组中均减少。线粒体和氧化磷酸化通路在4岁时正向富集，8岁时负向富集。免疫和补体通路在8岁时正向富集，4至8岁间改变的剪接事件数量增加近五倍。我们未检测到可溶性突变型亨廷顿蛋白的年龄依赖性积累。由于重复不发生扩增，这些变化是在没有体细胞扩增的情况下发生的，而体细胞扩增是人类亨廷顿病进展的主要驱动因素。我们提出，神经元标志物减少反映的是神经元身份丧失而非神经元死亡。TgHD小型猪因此可能重现该疾病的缓慢早期阶段，而该阶段可以说最有可能从治疗中获益。

items.title_en: Tunable Hybridization of Whispering Gallery Modes in High-Index Photonic Molecules
items.title_zh: 高折射率光子分子中回音壁模式的可调谐杂化
items.abstract_en: Photonic molecules formed by coupled dielectric microresonators provide a platform for controlling collective optical modes, yet the interplay between molecular topology, resonator detuning, and dielectric environment in determining their spectral response remains insufficiently quantified. Here, we systematically quantify the evolution of Whispering Gallery Mode (WGM) hybridization in high-index TiO$_2$ and perovskite coated TiO$_2$ microresonators with molecular topology, and establish the corresponding effective inter-cavity coupling using a combined numerical and analytical analysis. We further show that perovskite-shell incorporation provides a diameter and thickness-dependent modification of the effective coupling, producing a non-monotonic response rather than a uniform suppression of coupling. Despite the resulting closely spaced hybridized resonances in the high-index perovskite environment, the supermodes remain spectrally resolvable, with $Q$-factor of order \(10^3\) for representative modes. The observed spectral splitting is quantitatively related to the effective inter-cavity coupling strengths, revealing a non-monotonic coupling response to perovskite-shell incorporation that depends on resonator size and shell thickness. These results establish molecular topology and dielectric environment as distinct parameters for controlling WGM hybridization, inter-cavity coupling, and spectral response, providing a basis for the design of coupled resonator systems for applications in optical sensing, filtering, switching, and other resonant photonic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 由耦合介质微谐振器形成的光子分子为控制集体光学模式提供了平台，但分子拓扑、谐振器失谐和介电环境在决定其光谱响应方面的相互作用仍未得到充分量化。在此，我们系统量化了高折射率TiO₂和钙钛矿包覆TiO₂微谐振器中回音壁模式（WGM）杂化随分子拓扑的演化，并通过数值与解析相结合的分析建立了相应的有效腔间耦合。我们进一步表明，钙钛矿壳层的引入会产生依赖直径和厚度的有效耦合改变，产生非单调响应，而非对耦合的均匀抑制。尽管在高折射率钙钛矿环境中由此产生间距很近的杂化共振，超模在光谱上仍可分辨，代表性模式的Q因子为10³量级。观测到的光谱分裂与有效腔间耦合强度定量相关，揭示了对钙钛矿壳层引入的非单调耦合响应，其取决于谐振器尺寸和壳层厚度。这些结果确立了分子拓扑和介电环境作为控制WGM杂化、腔间耦合和光谱响应的不同参数，为设计用于光学传感、滤波、开关及其他共振光子器件的耦合谐振器系统提供了基础。

items.title_en: When Copying Is Hard to Beat: A Negative Result in Clinical Assessment Forecasting
items.title_zh: 当复制难以被超越：临床评估预测中的一项阴性结果
items.abstract_en: We report a negative result in next-day clinical assessment forecasting: the evaluated models show no consistent advantage over strong persistence-based baselines. Clinicians can view the previous day's questionnaire answers, a plausible source of documentation persistence. Predicting 45 items on 29,715 ICU day-pairs with patient-disjoint splits, a physiology-informed gated model improves item-macro-F1 over a one-line clinical rule by +0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031], while losing accuracy. No macro-F1 advantage is established when the physiology window ends at the previous form's reference time (+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]), or when scoring excludes the 68.5% of cells derived from parent answers; combining both changes yields a small disadvantage. Four checkpoints across three families underperform persistence, and a fine-tuned one differs from it on only two cells. A categorical read-out raises changed-cell accuracy eightfold, but a state-only read-out scores higher overall than forecast-only decoding and matches a transition matrix. This negative result highlights how the documentation process, input cutoff, observation mask and decoding rule shape conclusions about forecasting recorded assessments.
items.abstract_zh: 我们报告次日临床评估预测中的一项阴性结果：所评估的模型相对于强持续性基线没有表现出一致优势。临床医生可以查看前一天的问卷答案，这是文档持续性的一种可能来源。在29,715个ICU日对上预测45个项目，采用患者不重叠划分，一个生理信息引导的门控模型相对于单行临床规则将项目宏F1提高了+0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031]，但准确率下降。当生理窗口结束于前一份表单的参考时间时（+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]），或当评分排除由父答案衍生的68.5%单元格时，未建立宏F1优势；将这两种改动结合则产生小幅劣势。三个模型家族的四个检查点表现不如持续性基线，一个微调检查点仅在两个单元格上与其不同。分类读出将变化单元格准确率提高八倍，但仅状态读出总体得分高于仅预测解码，并与转移矩阵相当。这一阴性结果凸显了文档过程、输入截断、观测掩码和解码规则如何塑造关于预测已记录评估的结论。

items.title_en: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
items.title_zh: 你能信任你的金融智能体吗？对一个已交付金融研究智能体的漂移、诊断与可审计干预
items.abstract_en: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data. Can that diagnosis be trusted? Four blind readers from three model families, given only the traces, name the same fault as our LLM analyzer in 94% of cases, the rate at which they agree with one another (93%). Can a change be trusted? An optimization loop reads the traces, makes one targeted change per round and keeps it only if it clears a fixed threshold. Under a cost objective its final configuration costs 0.34x the baseline on the held-out questions (95% CI [0.22, 0.58]) at accuracy within noise. Under an accuracy objective it gains 14 points on the development questions and 1.5 on the held-out ones (CI [-5.3, +7.2]). Judged against the measured run-to-run noise, under a rule written before the test was opened, the first is a real saving and the second is not. This is a case study of one agent and nine test questions, not a general result.
items.abstract_zh: 你能信任一个不是你构建的金融智能体吗？我们采用随Vals金融智能体基准v2发布的参考智能体，保持其未经调优，并提出排行榜分数无法回答的四个问题。分数稳定吗？在18个问题上的七次相同运行中，149条评分标准通过105至123条，费用变化最高达17%。当智能体失败时，谁负责修复？我们根据预先冻结的分类体系，按应由哪一层负责修复对20条失败轨迹进行分类，这些轨迹来自九道留出问题的三次运行：13条属于智能体指令，3条属于其工具，4条属于模型，没有属于其数据的。该诊断可信吗？来自三个模型家族的四名盲读者仅获得轨迹，在94%的案例中指出了与我们的LLM分析器相同的故障，而他们彼此一致的比例为93%。改动可信吗？一个优化循环读取轨迹，每轮做一次针对性改动，并且仅当超过固定阈值时才保留。在成本目标下，其最终配置在留出问题上的成本为基线的0.34倍（95% CI [0.22, 0.58]），准确率在噪声范围内。在准确率目标下，它在开发问题上提升14个百分点，在留出问题上提升1.5个百分点（CI [-5.3, +7.2]）。对照测得的运行间噪声，在测试开始前写定的规则下判断，前者是真实节省，后者不是。这是一个关于一个智能体和九道测试题的案例研究，并非一般性结果。

items.title_en: In Situ Monitoring and Predictive Modeling of Harmful Algal Blooms with Autonomous Surface Vehicles
items.title_zh: 利用自主水面航行器对有害藻华进行原位监测与预测建模
items.abstract_en: Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs) pose significant environmental, economic, and public-health challenges in coastal and inland water bodies, creating a need for scalable methods to collect spatially distributed water-quality data. This paper presents an autonomous surface vessel-based sensing system for in-situ water-quality monitoring related to harmful algal bloom detection. The system integrates a BlueBoat Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV), a motorized winch for depth-controlled sonde deployment, a multiparameter water-quality sonde, side-scan sonar, and an event-camera payload. Autonomous waypoint missions were used to collect measurements across selected sampling regions and multiple depths, enabling both horizontal and vertical characterization of environmental conditions. Field deployments were conducted in Lake Pontchartrain, Louisiana, with additional measurements collected in False River, Louisiana to increase dataset diversity. The collected measurements included algal pigment indicators, nutrient concentration, turbidity, temperature, and other water-quality parameters relevant to bloom formation. In addition, complementary sonar and event-camera data were collected during vehicle operation to provide contextual environmental information. A machine-learning classification approach was also evaluated using the collected water-quality measurements to support HAB and non-HAB classification. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using a modular ASV platform for repeatable, multi-modal water-quality data collection and support future development of autonomous monitoring systems.
items.abstract_zh: 有害藻华（HABs）在沿海和内陆水体中构成重大的环境、经济和公共卫生挑战，因此需要可扩展的方法来采集空间分布的水质数据。本文介绍一种基于自主水面航行器的传感系统，用于与有害藻华检测相关的原位水质监测。该系统集成了BlueBoat自主水面航行器（ASV）、用于深度控制探头部署的电动绞车、多参数水质探头、侧扫声呐和事件相机载荷。使用自主航点任务在选定采样区域和多个深度采集测量，从而能够对环境条件进行水平和垂直表征。现场部署在路易斯安那州庞恰特雷恩湖进行，并在路易斯安那州False River采集额外测量以增加数据集多样性。采集的测量包括藻类色素指标、营养盐浓度、浊度、温度以及与藻华形成相关的其他水质参数。此外，在航行器运行期间采集了补充的声呐和事件相机数据，以提供环境背景信息。还评估了一种机器学习分类方法，使用采集的水质测量来支持有害藻华与非有害藻华分类。结果表明，使用模块化ASV平台进行可重复、多模态水质数据采集的可行性，并支持自主监测系统的未来发展。

items.title_en: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
items.title_zh: BrickFlow：连通性引导的积木重建
items.abstract_en: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
items.abstract_zh: 给定一组 LEGO 零件和一张组装物体的图像，我们的任务是推断每个零件的位姿以组装该物体。与传统三维重建不同，这样做需要满足离散的物理约束，这些约束提供了结构，但使问题具有组合性且对微小的位姿误差高度敏感。为了学习零件如何组合在一起的先验，我们在程序生成的组装体上训练一个以集合为条件的 SE(3) 流模型。然后，我们使用仅 1% 的数据量对该模型进行微调，以注入图像条件。然而，学习到的流虽然捕获了全局结构，但并不强制连通性。为解决这一点，我们引入一种解析连通性场引导，在测试时将预测拉向连通的组装体。通过这种方式，我们展示了随着模型规模、预训练和引导而提升的搭建质量。我们以研究目的在 https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/ 提供模型和数据。

items.title_en: An In-Silico Audit of Topographic Organization in a Multimodal Brain-Response Model
items.title_zh: 多模态脑响应模型中拓扑组织的计算机模拟审计
items.abstract_en: TRIBE v2 (d'Ascoli et al., 2026) predicts fMRI responses across the cortical surface from video, audio and text. Its authors validated it with category-selective localizers (faces, places, bodies, words) and language contrasts, but not with the classic topographic organization of sensory cortex: retinotopy, tonotopy, and motion selectivity in area MT+. There is a clear architectural reason to expect retinotopy to fail: TRIBE's video features are averaged over space before the response head, which should discard visual-field position. I present mapping stimuli, a fitting pipeline adapted from standard fMRI mapping analyses, and a stand-in model with known ground truth that serves as a positive and negative control, and apply them to TRIBE v2's predictions, comparing the fitted maps with human atlases using spin tests. TRIBE v2 shows a sharp split. There is no contralateral hemifield response and no polar-angle map, robustly across stimulus controls. There is no tonotopic gradient in primary auditory cortex: best frequencies span an interquartile range of only 0.14 octaves across core and belt, and the null persists with loudness-equalized tones. An eccentricity-like gradient appears only when the ring geometry changes, consistent with global image statistics rather than a positional code. In contrast, motion selectivity is strong and precisely localized: 22% of the 1% most motion-selective vertices fall in MT+, which covers 0.42% of cortex. In-silico experiments that depend on feature identity appear viable with TRIBE v2, while those that depend on visual-field or frequency position are not supported by the current model.
items.abstract_zh: TRIBE v2（d'Ascoli 等，2026）从视频、音频和文本预测整个皮层表面的 fMRI 响应。其作者使用类别选择性定位器（面孔、场景、身体、词语）和语言对比对其进行了验证，但没有用感觉皮层的经典拓扑组织进行验证：视网膜拓扑、音调拓扑以及 MT+ 区的运动选择性。有一个明确的架构原因预期视网膜拓扑会失败：TRIBE 的视频特征在响应头之前已在空间上平均，这应当丢弃视野位置。我提出了映射刺激、一套改编自标准 fMRI 映射分析的拟合流程，以及一个具有已知真实值的替代模型作为阳性和阴性对照，并将它们应用于 TRIBE v2 的预测，使用旋转检验将拟合图谱与人类图谱进行比较。TRIBE v2 显示出明显的分裂。没有对侧半视野响应，也没有极角图，且在刺激控制下稳健成立。初级听觉皮层中没有音调拓扑梯度：在核心区和带状区，最佳频率的四分位距仅为 0.14 个八度，并且在使用等响度音调时零结果仍然存在。类离心率梯度仅在环形几何改变时出现，这与全局图像统计而非位置编码一致。相比之下，运动选择性强且定位精确：在运动选择性最强的 1% 顶点中，有 22% 落在 MT+ 内，而 MT+ 仅覆盖皮层的 0.42%。依赖特征身份的计算机模拟实验在 TRIBE v2 上似乎可行，而依赖视野位置或频率位置的实验则不受当前模型支持。

items.title_en: Number fluctuations and particle loss in Dicke superradiance
items.title_zh: Dicke 超辐射中的粒子数涨落与粒子损失
items.abstract_en: Dicke superradiance, the collective spontaneous emission of identical quantum emitters into a common reservoir, produces a burst with a characteristic delay $t_{\mathrm{SR}}$ and a peak intensity that scales quadratically with the emitter number $N$. This strong dependence makes the burst sensitive to how many emitters actually participate. In experiments, however, this number is rarely fixed: it fluctuates between preparations and decreases during emission through atom loss. Here we extend the analytical treatment of superradiance to variable emitter numbers using the Schwinger-boson mapping of the collective spin onto two bosonic modes. In this formulation, collective decay annihilates an atom in the excited-state mode and creates one in the ground-state mode. We find that number fluctuations enhance emission and that the ensemble-averaged emission trace encodes the initial number distribution. We show how to reconstruct second-order correlations from photon counting with finite detection efficiency and temporal resolution, even when the full distribution cannot be resolved. For atom loss at rate $r$, we derive exact results for the population dynamics and show that the peak intensity scaling is governed by the single scaling variable $g_{\mathrm{r}}=r t_{\mathrm{SR}}$. The peak remains quadratic in $N$ for $g_{\mathrm{r}} 1$, and crosses over to linear scaling under strong loss with $g_{\mathrm{r}}\gg1$.
items.abstract_zh: Dicke 超辐射是相同量子发射体向共同库的集体自发辐射，会产生具有特征延迟 t_SR 和峰值强度随发射体数 N 二次缩放的爆发。这种强依赖性使爆发对实际参与发射的发射体数量敏感。然而在实验中，这一数量很少固定：它在不同制备之间波动，并在发射过程中因原子损失而减少。这里我们使用将集体自旋映射到两个玻色模式的 Schwinger 玻色子映射，将超辐射的解析处理扩展到可变的发射体数。在该表述中，集体衰减在激发态模式中湮灭一个原子，并在基态模式中产生一个原子。我们发现粒子数涨落增强发射，并且系综平均发射轨迹编码初始粒子数分布。我们展示了如何在有限探测效率和时间分辨率下从光子计数重建二阶关联，即使无法分辨完整分布。对于速率为 r 的原子损失，我们推导了布居动力学的精确结果，并表明峰值强度标度由单一标度变量 g_r = r t_SR 支配。对于 g_r 1，峰值仍随 N 呈二次缩放，并在强损耗 g_r ≫ 1 下过渡为线性缩放。
