items.title_en: A passive, battery-free flexible metasurface for implantable millimetre-wave radar glucose sensing
items.title_zh: 用于植入式毫米波雷达葡萄糖传感的无源、无电池柔性超表面
items.abstract_en: Continuous glucose monitors (CGM) break the skin barrier and require periodic sensor replacement. We investigated whether a passive, battery-free flexible metasurface, implanted beneath tissue and read by a commercial 60 GHz radar, can track blood glucose levels. The metasurface contained no electronics or reagents. We fitted a conical helix to the in-phase and quadrature radar signals across the frequency sweep and used its mean radius (the spiral radius) as the glucose-dependent feature. We tested glucose concentrations of 25 to 400 mg/dL in saline solution with and without the metasurface, and 196 to 596 mg/dL of total glucose in porcine whole blood beneath ex vivo porcine tissue and in a murine cadaver model with pulsatile blood flow. The metasurface was essential for achieving a monotonic sensor response; in saline, the coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of a logarithmic fit increased from 0.18 without the metasurface to 0.90 with it. In a murine (rat) cadaver model, the signal's spiral radius increased monotonically with glucose concentration despite pulsatile flow ($R^2$ = 0.91), and this monotonic behavior persisted through up to 6 mm of tissue. Although sensitivity decreased at higher glucose levels, each discrete concentration step remained clearly detectable. These results demonstrate that a shallow, passive implant paired with a commercial radar can effectively track blood glucose without requiring onboard electronics or batteries.
items.abstract_zh: 连续葡萄糖监测仪（CGM）会突破皮肤屏障，并需要定期更换传感器。我们研究了植入组织下方、由商用 60 GHz 雷达读取的无源、无电池柔性超表面是否能够跟踪血糖水平。该超表面不含电子器件或试剂。我们对扫频范围内的同相和正交雷达信号拟合锥形螺旋，并使用其平均半径（螺旋半径）作为葡萄糖依赖特征。我们在有和无超表面的盐水溶液中测试了 25 至 400 mg/dL 的葡萄糖浓度，并在离体猪组织下方的猪全血中以及具有搏动血流的鼠尸体模型中测试了 196 至 596 mg/dL 的总葡萄糖。超表面对实现单调的传感器响应至关重要；在盐水中，对数拟合的决定系数（R^2）从无超表面时的 0.18 提高到有超表面时的 0.90。在鼠（大鼠）尸体模型中，尽管存在搏动血流，信号的螺旋半径仍随葡萄糖浓度单调增加（R^2 = 0.91），并且这种单调行为在最多 6 mm 的组织厚度下仍然持续。尽管在较高葡萄糖水平下灵敏度下降，但每个离散浓度阶跃仍可被清晰检测。这些结果表明，浅层无源植入物与商用雷达配对，可以在无需板上电子器件或电池的情况下有效跟踪血糖。

items.title_en: In the Eye of the Beholder: Human Label Variation in Textual and Visual Entailment
items.title_zh: 在观者眼中：文本与视觉蕴涵中的人类标签变异
items.abstract_en: Human Label Variation (HLV) is increasingly recognised as an informative signal that reflects meaningful differences in how people interpret the same input. While HLV has been studied extensively in Natural Language Inference (NLI), much less is known about HLV in Visual Entailment (VE; Xie et al., 2019), where the textual premise is replaced by an image, keeping the hypothesis and label space fixed. We introduce VariNLI-VE, a dataset for studying how HLV changes between paired NLI and VE instances. We re-annotate a subset of originally neutral SNLI (Bowman et al., 2015) instances and their visual counterparts, with the same annotators evaluating both the textual and visual versions. Each annotation includes a label, confidence score, and explanation, yielding 2,250 annotations. Labels and explanations are collected jointly, providing ecologically valid explanations. Because the image may reveal information not stated in the text, one might expect disagreement to decrease in VE. Instead, we find no clear overall reduction: disagreement decreases for some instances while it increases for others. Explanations reveal further variation, as annotators can retain the same label while changing their rationale. When evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on the paired data, we find lower accuracy, weaker alignment with human label distributions, and generally higher uncertainty in VE than in NLI.
items.abstract_zh: 人类标签变异（HLV）越来越被认为是一种信息性信号，反映了人们对同一输入解释方式的有意义差异。虽然 HLV 已在自然语言推理（NLI）中得到广泛研究，但在视觉蕴涵（VE；Xie 等，2019）中对 HLV 的了解要少得多，后者用图像替换文本前提，同时保持假设和标签空间不变。我们引入 VariNLI-VE，这是一个用于研究 HLV 在配对的 NLI 和 VE 实例之间如何变化的数据集。我们重新标注了原始中性 SNLI（Bowman 等，2015）实例的一个子集及其视觉对应实例，由同一批标注者同时评估文本版本和视觉版本。每个标注包括标签、置信度分数和解释，共产生 2,250 条标注。标签和解释是联合收集的，提供了生态有效的解释。由于图像可能揭示文本中未陈述的信息，人们可能预期 VE 中的分歧会减少。相反，我们发现总体上没有明显减少：某些实例的分歧减少，而另一些实例的分歧增加。解释揭示了进一步的变化，因为标注者可以保持相同标签而改变其理由。在配对数据上评估视觉语言模型（VLM）时，我们发现与 NLI 相比，VE 中的准确率更低、与人类标签分布的一致性更弱，并且总体上不确定性更高。

items.title_en: NPU-Accelerated GNSS Signal Acquisition
items.title_zh: NPU 加速的 GNSS 信号捕获
items.abstract_en: On small single-board computers (SBCs), GNSS signal acquisition is a major CPU load. This paper proposes using the neural processing unit (NPU) of an SBC not for machine learning but as an accelerator for the parallel code search in GNSS signal acquisition. The discrete Fourier transform (DFT) used in acquisition is decomposed by the four-step DFT into matrix products of small DFTs and expressed by $1\times1$ convolutions, element-wise products, and transposes, which NPUs execute efficiently. Furthermore, we propose a method that divides the DFT, the non-coherent integration, and the peak detection between the CPU and the NPU according to the configuration of the NPU (an NPU with its own memory connected via PCIe, or an NPU sharing memory with the CPU). The proposed method is implemented in the open-source software GNSS receiver Pocket SDR and evaluated on a Raspberry Pi 5 combined with the external AX8850 NPU and on the NPU built into the SoC (RK3588) of the ROCK 5C, a small SBC of comparable size. Compared with acquisition by an optimized CPU implementation, the acquisition of short codes on the Raspberry Pi 5 with the AX8850 is 3.0-3.8 times faster. In the evaluation of the whole receiver, the number of tracking channels that reach their first lock within 30 s with the NPU is 1.5 times that with the CPU, and the time until 90% of the channels are locked is reduced from 66 s to 26 s. Furthermore, because the CPU load of acquisition is reduced, the number of tracking channels that can be processed in real time increases from about 175 to about 230. These results show that using the NPU on SBCs with limited CPU resources is effective for achieving both GNSS signal acquisition and tracking. The implementation is publicly available as open source under the name PocketSDR-NPU.
items.abstract_zh: 在小型单板计算机（SBC）上，GNSS 信号捕获是主要的 CPU 负载。本文提出使用 SBC 的神经处理单元（NPU）并非用于机器学习，而是作为 GNSS 信号捕获中并行码搜索的加速器。捕获中使用的离散傅里叶变换（DFT）通过四步 DFT 分解为小 DFT 的矩阵乘积，并表示为 1×1 卷积、逐元素乘积和转置，NPU 可以高效执行这些操作。此外，我们提出一种方法，根据 NPU 的配置（通过 PCIe 连接且具有自身内存的 NPU，或与 CPU 共享内存的 NPU）在 CPU 和 NPU 之间划分 DFT、非相干积分和峰值检测。所提方法在开源软件 GNSS 接收机 Pocket SDR 中实现，并在 Raspberry Pi 5 与外置 AX8850 NPU 组合的系统上，以及在 ROCK 5C 的 SoC（RK3588）内置 NPU 上进行了评估，ROCK 5C 是尺寸相当的小型 SBC。与优化的 CPU 实现捕获相比，在 Raspberry Pi 5 与 AX8850 上捕获短码快 3.0–3.8 倍。在整个接收机的评估中，使用 NPU 时在 30 s 内达到首次锁定的跟踪通道数是使用 CPU 时的 1.5 倍，并且直到 90% 通道锁定的时间从 66 s 缩短到 26 s。此外，由于捕获的 CPU 负载降低，可实时处理的跟踪通道数从约 175 个增加到约 230 个。这些结果表明，在 CPU 资源有限的 SBC 上使用 NPU 可同时有效实现 GNSS 信号捕获和跟踪。该实现以 PocketSDR-NPU 为名作为开源公开提供。

items.title_en: EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation
items.title_zh: EventSpikeSeg：用于事件相机脉冲分割的记忆感知混合信号架构
items.abstract_en: Event-camera segmentation requires persistent neural state despite sparse input events, making memory organization a central constraint on embedded implementation. We present EventSpikeSeg, a mixed-signal architecture combining resident capacitor memory with shared analog processing in GF180MCU 180-nm CMOS. Its 25-population spiking encoder-decoder has 143,824 synaptic weights but requires 30,976,000 membrane states at 440 x 640 resolution. The mapping specifies chronological 5-ms model updates, digital event/address services and 64-state capacitor banks. Characterization covers 22 module families and 74 operating points, distinguishing transistor simulations from digital-library estimates. Nominal results include 41.711 microwatts biased neuron-core power, 3.338-pJ positive terminal energy for a 1.4-microsecond cell read, and 0.531-mV selected-state drift over a 5-ms extracted-tile hold. Commit and coupling errors are reported separately. The software checkpoint records 27.976% mean intersection-over-union on a held-out six-class DSEC split; this is not hardware accuracy. Component layouts and simulation evidence quantify local implementation costs and expose storage replication and service scheduling as scaling constraints. A detailed SPICE-calibrated behavioral forward simulation of one full-resolution DSEC frame achieves 24.26% mean intersection-over-union, versus 26.22% for the matched PyTorch reference, using a compact 5-fF bank variant and external count/voltage calibration. Physical full-network operation, system energy and mismatch robustness remain unverified.
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机分割尽管输入事件稀疏，仍需要持续存在的神经状态，这使得记忆组织成为嵌入式实现的核心约束。我们提出EventSpikeSeg，一种在GF180MCU 180 nm CMOS中结合驻留电容存储器与共享模拟处理的混合信号架构。其含25个群体的脉冲编码器-解码器具有143,824个突触权重，但在440×640分辨率下需要30,976,000个膜状态。该映射规定了按时间顺序的5 ms模型更新、数字事件/地址服务和64状态电容组。表征涵盖22个模块系列和74个工作点，区分晶体管仿真与数字库估计。标称结果包括：偏置神经元核心功耗41.711微瓦，1.4微秒单元读取的正端能量为3.338 pJ，以及在5 ms提取瓦片保持期间选中状态漂移0.531 mV。提交误差和耦合误差分别报告。软件检查点在留出的六类DSEC划分上记录27.976%的平均交并比；这不是硬件精度。组件布局和仿真证据量化了局部实现成本，并揭示存储复制和服务调度是扩展约束。使用紧凑的5-fF电容组变体和外部计数/电压校准，对一帧全分辨率DSEC帧进行详细的SPICE校准行为前向仿真，达到24.26%的平均交并比，而匹配的PyTorch参考为26.22%。物理全网络运行、系统能耗与失配鲁棒性仍未验证。

items.title_en: S1Pert: Scalable Target-Specific Gene Response Prediction with System-One Intelligence
items.title_zh: S1Pert：基于System-One智能的可扩展目标特异性基因响应预测
items.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptional responses to unseen genetic perturbations is essential for extending CRISPR screens across vast target--gene combinations. However, models can achieve strong aggregate predictive performance by reproducing historical gene-level response frequencies without adequately distinguishing the effects of different perturbations. Reliable prediction at the transcriptome scale is further challenged by uncertain response labels and redundant computation across millions of target--gene pairs. We present S1Pert, a System-One framework for target-specific gene response prediction with non-autoregressive online inference. S1Pert combines directional Welch tests and equivalence testing to distinguish statistically supported responses from inconclusive observations. A frozen System-One encoder extracts reusable semantic representations of perturbation targets, query genes, and historical evidence. Compact pair-specific interactions are then computed and cached offline. A lightweight hierarchical cross-attention decoder integrates these representations with cross-target pairwise ranking and synchronized historical-evidence dropout to reduce reliance on gene-level response frequencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that S1Pert improves target-specific response discrimination while maintaining reliable prediction and efficient inference across diverse cellular contexts. These findings highlight the potential of System-One decision learning for scalable perturbation-response prediction beyond historical gene-level response tendencies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/liujiawen-jpg/S1Pert.
items.abstract_zh: 预测对未见遗传扰动的转录响应，对于将CRISPR筛选扩展到大量目标-基因组合至关重要。然而，模型可通过复现历史基因水平响应频率来获得较强的总体预测性能，而未充分区分不同扰动的效应。转录组规模上的可靠预测还受到不确定响应标签以及数百万目标-基因对上的冗余计算挑战。我们提出S1Pert，一个采用非自回归在线推理进行目标特异性基因响应预测的System-One框架。S1Pert结合方向性Welch检验与等价性检验，将有统计支持的响应与无定论观察区分开。冻结的System-One编码器提取扰动目标、查询基因和历史证据的可复用语义表示。随后离线计算并缓存紧凑的配对特异性交互。轻量级分层交叉注意力解码器将这些表示与跨目标成对排序及同步历史证据dropout相结合，以降低对基因水平响应频率的依赖。大量实验表明，S1Pert在多样细胞环境中提高了目标特异性响应判别能力，同时保持可靠预测和高效推理。这些发现凸显了System-One决策学习在超越历史基因水平响应倾向的可扩展扰动-响应预测中的潜力。源代码公开于https://github.com/liujiawen-jpg/S1Pert。

items.title_en: Quantum computational spectroscopy of complex resonances and optical residues
items.title_zh: 复杂共振与光学留数的量子计算光谱学
items.abstract_en: Optical spectra of dissipative molecular systems depend on both complex resonance energies and the way each resonance couples to an optical probe. In a non-Hermitian description, these con- tributions are determined by complex residues involving left and right eigenvectors. We introduce a quantum protocol that reconstructs the resonance poles and their biorthogonal optical residues within a common spectral-filtering and measurement framework. A Hermitian dilation embeds the left and right eigenvectors into a zero-energy subspace. Gaussian-filtered correlators evaluated with unitary circuits, together with ratios of complex off-diagonal measurements, yield the residues with- out separate variational optimisation of the eigenstates. We demonstrate spectral reconstruction for dissipative plasmon-molecule models on IBM quantum hardware, resolving how probe-dependent modal contributions produce interference-induced doublets or accompany a separation of resonance energies. We also analyse the sensitivity of residue reconstruction near exceptional points. By mak- ing complex optical residues an explicit computational output, the protocol connects non-Hermitian eigenstructure to measurable optical response.
items.abstract_zh: 耗散分子系统的光谱既取决于复共振能量，也取决于每个共振与光学探针耦合的方式。在非厄米描述中，这些贡献由涉及左、右特征向量的复留数决定。我们引入一种量子协议，在共同的谱滤波与测量框架内重建共振极点及其双正交光学留数。厄米膨胀将左、右特征向量嵌入零能子空间。用酉电路评估的高斯滤波关联器，结合复非对角测量的比值，可在不对特征态进行单独变分优化的情况下得到留数。我们在IBM量子硬件上展示了耗散等离激元-分子模型的谱重建，解析了依赖探针的模态贡献如何产生干涉诱导的双峰，或伴随共振能量分裂。我们还分析了异常点附近留数重建的敏感性。通过将复光学留数作为显式计算输出，该协议将非厄米特征结构与可测量光学响应联系起来。

items.title_en: A Unified Device-Level Physical Framework for DRAM Read Disturbance
items.title_zh: DRAM读干扰的统一器件级物理框架
items.abstract_en: Read disturbance in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) depends on both local device interactions and the electrical conditions imposed by shared array circuitry. Here, we combine DIMM-level characterization results, device measurements, and TCAD simulations to interpret RowHammer, RowPress, and ColumnDisturb within a unified device-level physical framework. We relate charge evolution at the floating storage node to three key mechanisms: trap-assisted electron migration (EM), capacitive coupling (CC), and sense-amplifier-mediated disturb (SAMD). EM is local and trap-sensitive, while CC weakens with wordline separation. SAMD extends disturbance through shared column circuitry by modifying unselected-cell leakage under rail-level bitline biases, a contribution supported by the approximately ninefold higher OFF-state leakage measured relative to retention-like conditions for a high-voltage storage state. These distinct spatial ranges account for localized RowHammer and RowPress failures and remote ColumnDisturb populations with abrupt changes at subarray boundaries. We further interpret prolonged RowPress activation as a transition from an initial RowHammer-like transient to sustained leakage driven mainly by SAMD under held wordline and bitline biases. Within this device-level framework, trap effectiveness and storage-state-dependent leakage provide an interpretation of previously puzzling failure signatures, including the earlier onset of 0-to-1 RowHammer failures despite the predominance of 1-to-0 failures at high hammer counts. The same framework explains the observed RowPress and ColumnDisturb polarities and the duration-dependent reversal of neighboring- and passing-wordline effectiveness. These results provide a physical basis for developing compact DRAM reliability models across access patterns and array configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）中的读干扰既取决于局部器件相互作用，也取决于共享阵列电路施加的电学条件。在这里，我们结合DIMM级表征结果、器件测量和TCAD仿真，在统一的器件级物理框架内解释RowHammer、RowPress和ColumnDisturb。我们将浮置存储节点处的电荷演化与三种关键机制联系起来：陷阱辅助电子迁移（EM）、电容耦合（CC）和感测放大器介导的干扰（SAMD）。EM是局部的且对陷阱敏感，而CC随字线间距增大而减弱。SAMD通过在轨级位线偏置下改变未选中单元的漏电，经由共享列电路扩展干扰；这一贡献得到以下测量支持：对于高压存储状态，相对于类保持条件测得的关态漏电约高九倍。这些不同的空间范围解释了局部化的RowHammer和RowPress失效，以及在子阵列边界处突变且空间上较远的ColumnDisturb群体。我们进一步将延长的RowPress激活解释为从初始类RowHammer瞬态转变为在保持字线和位线偏置下主要由SAMD驱动的持续漏电。在该器件级框架内，陷阱有效性和依赖存储状态的漏电为先前令人困惑的失效特征提供了解释，包括0到1的RowHammer失效更早出现，尽管在高锤击计数下1到0失效占主导。同一框架解释了观察到的RowPress和ColumnDisturb极性，以及相邻字线与通过字线有效性随持续时间变化的反转。这些结果为跨访问模式和阵列配置开发紧凑DRAM可靠性模型提供了物理基础。

items.title_en: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
items.title_zh: PaperCritic：训练AI审稿人以评估论文的健全性
items.abstract_en: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).
items.abstract_zh: 随着AI会议投稿快速增长，AI审稿人正被考虑作为替代方案。然而，简单模仿人类审稿是有问题的，因为审稿服务于多重目的，包括评估论文的健全性、有趣性和清晰度，其中后两者是主观的。在本工作中，我们仅关注评估健全性这一最重要且客观的标准，并将学习目标定义为联合最大化：(1) 精确率，基于评审点的健全性和实质性；(2) 召回率，即对高质量参考评审点的覆盖。在此问题表述下，我们使用1K篇ICLR投稿和23K个人工撰写与LLM生成的评审点，构建了带质量标签的评审点数据集PaperSound-23K。使用该数据集，我们通过以精确率和召回率的F1分数为奖励的强化学习，训练了AI审稿人模型PaperCritic。实验表明，在域内测试集上，PaperCritic优于前沿模型和其他AI审稿人训练方法训练的模型。令人惊讶的是，学习审阅ICLR投稿还可迁移到审阅Nature系列论文，甚至迁移到域外审稿任务（例如代码审查、法律合同审查和故事写作反馈）。

items.title_en: Learning Latent Goal Costs for Visual World-Model Planning with an Expanding Curriculum
items.title_zh: 使用扩展课程学习用于视觉世界模型规划的潜在目标代价
items.abstract_en: Image-goal planning with a frozen visual world model depends on how predicted observations are scored against the goal. Mean-squared error (MSE) between embeddings from a pretrained visual encoder can provide a useful signal near a goal, yet favor states across an obstacle that are visually similar to the goal and difficult to reach. We fit a small residual adapter on top of frozen I-JEPA embeddings to improve this latent goal cost. Starting near each goal, a planner collects trajectories from progressively wider regions of initial states. The adapter learns from the order of observations along successful trajectories, with additional comparisons inferred from failed rollouts. No task-specific progress labels are used for fitting, so the procedure can be applied to other goal-reaching tasks. DotWall and PointMaze are used in this work. In paired 50-case evaluations with identical starts, goals, world models, and planner settings, success increases from 54% to 98% in DotWall and from 82% to 96% in PointMaze. On 16 unseen DotWall layout-goal cases, the adapter fitted on one fixed layout improves agreement between latent-cost ordering and shortest legal-path ordering from 71.9% to 85.8%. The results indicate that planning experience can improve a frozen visual representation's goal cost without retraining the encoder or the world model.
items.abstract_zh: 使用冻结视觉世界模型的图像目标规划取决于如何将预测观测相对于目标进行评分。来自预训练视觉编码器的嵌入之间的均方误差（MSE）可在目标附近提供有用信号，却会偏好障碍物另一侧视觉上类似目标且难以到达的状态。我们在冻结I-JEPA嵌入之上拟合一个小型残差适配器，以改进该潜在目标代价。规划器从每个目标附近开始，从逐渐扩大的初始状态区域收集轨迹。适配器从成功轨迹上观测的顺序学习，并从失败rollout推断额外比较。拟合不使用任务特定的进度标签，因此该流程可应用于其他目标到达任务。本工作使用DotWall和PointMaze。在具有相同起点、目标、世界模型和规划器设置的配对50例评估中，DotWall成功率从54%提高到98%，PointMaze从82%提高到96%。在16个未见过的DotWall布局-目标案例上，在一个固定布局上拟合的适配器将潜在代价排序与最短合法路径排序之间的一致性从71.9%提高到85.8%。结果表明，规划经验可在不重新训练编码器或世界模型的情况下改进冻结视觉表示的目标代价。

items.title_en: BAL: Bidirectional Autoregression in Latent Space for Learning Human Movement Representations
items.title_zh: BAL：潜在空间中的双向自回归用于学习人体运动表示
items.abstract_en: Learning semantically meaningful human movement representations from 3D pose sequences is essential for human behavior modeling. Existing self-supervised methods derive supervision from artificial assumptions, e.g., invariance to augmentation within a certain range or recoverability of masked regions at a certain temporal scale, introducing heuristic hyperparameters that make the learned semantics sensitive to their settings. We propose BAL, a self-supervised framework that instead exploits supervision intrinsic to human movement: the natural ordering structure of everyday behavior. BAL autoregressively predicts in a semantically abstract latent space, analogous to how humans anticipate others' actions rather than their precise joint configurations. Bidirectional autoregressive prediction, both forward and backward in time, fully leverages these ordering constraints while enabling representation extraction using both past and future context at inference. To suppress representation collapse, BAL decomposes each prediction target into a global component capturing sequence-level semantics and a local component capturing context-independent movement. We prove that the local targets retain nontrivial angular diversity unless the representations are completely collapsed, preserving a meaningful training signal. Experiments on large-scale datasets demonstrate that BAL's representations are highly effective for motion captioning, forecasting, and interpolation, outperforming baselines on most evaluation metrics.
items.abstract_zh: 从3D姿态序列中学习具有语义意义的人体运动表示对于人体行为建模至关重要。现有的自监督方法从人为假设中获取监督信号，例如在一定范围内对数据增强具有不变性，或在特定时间尺度上可恢复被掩蔽区域，这引入了启发式超参数，使得学习到的语义对其设置敏感。我们提出BAL，一个自监督框架，转而利用人体运动内在的监督信号：日常行为自然的顺序结构。BAL在语义抽象的潜在空间中进行自回归预测，类似于人类预测他人的动作而非其精确的关节配置。双向自回归预测，即在时间上向前和向后预测，充分利用这些顺序约束，同时在推理时能够利用过去和未来上下文提取表示。为抑制表示坍缩，BAL将每个预测目标分解为捕获序列级语义的全局分量和捕获上下文无关运动的局部分量。我们证明，除非表示完全坍缩，局部分量目标保持非平凡的角度多样性，从而保留有意义的训练信号。在大规模数据集上的实验表明，BAL的表示对于运动描述生成、预测和插值非常有效，在大多数评估指标上优于基线。

items.title_en: Astrocyte Biocomputing: Astrocytic Contributions to Neural Network Computation
items.title_zh: 星形胶质细胞生物计算：星形胶质细胞对神经网络计算的贡献
items.abstract_en: Conductors are critical for the performance of an orchestra even though they do not emit sound. Basic research and clinical studies in the last decade are revealing that astrocytes may be the "conductors" of the "orchestra" that is the brain network: astrocytes make up approximately $50\%$ of all brain cells but do not emit electrical signals. Nevertheless, they may play critical roles in important cognitive brain functions, specifically learning, memory, and information processing. Here we consider the implications of these discoveries for brain-inspired machine learning (ML), where analogy is typically drawn between neurons and their electrical interactions. We highlight specific algorithms for two key astrocyte characteristics. The first characteristic is the ability to link to and modulate thousands of synapses simultaneously. A model based on this characteristic yields faster training and makes the network more robust to noise, providing a supervised learning algorithm that can be applied to any existing neural network. The second characteristic we focus on is that the non-electrical communication among astrocytes includes slow, rhythmic dynamics. The rhythmic sharing algorithm we developed based on this premise yields rapid anomaly detection adaptation and prevents catastrophic forgetting. Overall, we find that astrocyte-derived algorithms outperform neurocentric algorithms significantly and remediate critical weaknesses of current state-of-the-art ML models.
items.abstract_zh: 指挥对于管弦乐队的表现至关重要，尽管他们并不发出声音。过去十年的基础研究和临床研究正在揭示，星形胶质细胞可能是大脑网络这个“管弦乐队”的“指挥”：星形胶质细胞约占所有脑细胞的50%，但不发出电信号。尽管如此，它们可能在重要的认知脑功能中发挥关键作用，特别是学习、记忆和信息处理。在这里，我们考虑这些发现对脑启发机器学习（ML）的启示，其中通常将神经元及其电相互作用进行类比。我们针对星形胶质细胞的两个关键特征强调了具体算法。第一个特征是同时连接并调节数千个突触的能力。基于该特征的模型能够实现更快的训练，并使网络对噪声更鲁棒，提供了一种可应用于任何现有神经网络的监督学习算法。我们关注的第二个特征是，星形胶质细胞之间的非电通信包括缓慢的节律动力学。基于这一前提，我们开发的节律共享算法能够实现快速的异常检测自适应，并防止灾难性遗忘。总体而言，我们发现源自星形胶质细胞的算法显著优于以神经元为中心的算法，并弥补当前最先进ML模型的关键弱点。

items.title_en: Formulating Uncomputation Beyond Classical Ancilla Use
items.title_zh: 超越经典辅助量子比特使用的逆计算形式化
items.abstract_en: Ancilla qubits are routinely used to simplify quantum circuit construction and reduce implementation costs, but their use introduces the burden of designing proper uncomputation afterward. To alleviate this, prior work has developed automated uncomputation synthesis based on a computational-basis formulation of ancilla use. However, this formulation is tailored to classically structured ancilla computations. For more general circuits, it may be undefined, yield unintended functionality, or fail to synthesize uncomputation. It therefore falls short of providing a precise and general formulation of uncomputation beyond classical ancilla use. To address these limitations, we propose a new formulation of ancilla use that specifies the operation of each gate through two complementary aspects: (1) the functionality it implements and (2) the transformation it induces on ancilla roles. Based on this specification, we define uncomputation as restoring the initial ancilla role while implementing the identity functionality. This perspective enables a simple Use-first strategy for automatically synthesizing uncomputation in cases both within and beyond the scope of prior approaches. We further develop a complete inference system for reasoning about specifications, together with a derivation-directed procedure for automatically synthesizing efficient uncomputation, enabling systematic uncomputation synthesis even in challenging cases beyond the scope of our automatic strategy.
items.abstract_zh: 辅助量子比特常被用于简化量子电路构造并降低实现成本，但它们的使用带来了随后设计正确逆计算的负担。为缓解这一问题，先前工作基于辅助量子比特使用的计算基表述开发了自动逆计算合成。然而，该表述是为经典结构化的辅助量子比特计算量身定制的。对于更一般的电路，它可能无定义、产生非预期功能，或无法合成逆计算。因此，它未能提供超越经典辅助量子比特使用的精确且通用的逆计算形式化。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种新的辅助量子比特使用形式化，通过两个互补方面规定每个门操作：（1）其实现的功能，以及（2）其在辅助量子比特角色上诱导的变换。基于该规范，我们将逆计算定义为在实现恒等功能的同时恢复初始辅助量子比特角色。这一视角使得一种简单的“先用”策略能够在先前方法范围内和范围外的情况下自动合成逆计算。我们进一步开发了一个完整的推理系统来对规范进行推理，以及一个面向推导的过程来自动合成高效逆计算，从而即使在我们自动策略范围之外的挑战性情况下也能系统地进行逆计算合成。

items.title_en: Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces for Enhancing Secure MISO Communications
items.title_zh: 用于增强安全MISO通信的柔性智能超表面
items.abstract_en: This letter investigates flexible intelligent metasurface (FIM)-aided secure multiple-input single-output (MISO) communications in the presence of a multi-antenna eavesdropper. By exploiting the morphing capability of the FIM, the transmit array geometry can be dynamically reconfigured to reshape the legitimate and eavesdropping channels. We formulate a secrecy rate maximization (SRM) problem by jointly optimizing the transmit covariance matrix and the FIM surface shape. For a given FIM surface shape, the optimal transmit covariance matrix is shown to be rank one and is obtained in closed form from the dominant generalized eigenvector. For a fixed transmit covariance matrix, a projected gradient ascent (PGA) method is developed to optimize the FIM shape. Based on these two subproblems, a block coordinate ascent (BCA) algorithm is proposed. Moreover, for the special line-of-sight (LoS) scenario, we derive a globally optimal closed-form joint transmit covariance matrix and FIM surface shape design under a sufficient morphing-range condition. Numerical results demonstrate that FIM effectively improves the secrecy rate over a conventional rigid antenna array (RAA). Moreover, FIM achieves a transmit-power saving of about 2.5 dB compared with the RAA benchmark at the same secrecy rate.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究在多天线窃听者存在下，由柔性智能超表面（FIM）辅助的安全多输入单输出（MISO）通信。通过利用FIM的形变能力，可以动态重构发射阵列几何结构，以重塑合法信道和窃听信道。我们通过联合优化发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状，建立保密速率最大化（SRM）问题。对于给定的FIM表面形状，最优发射协方差矩阵被证明为秩一，并由主广义特征向量以闭式获得。对于固定的发射协方差矩阵，开发了投影梯度上升（PGA）方法来优化FIM形状。基于这两个子问题，提出了块坐标上升（BCA）算法。此外，对于特殊的视距（LoS）场景，我们在足够的形变范围条件下，推导了全局最优的闭式联合发射协方差矩阵和FIM表面形状设计。数值结果表明，与常规刚性天线阵列（RAA）相比，FIM有效提高了保密速率。此外，在相同保密速率下，FIM相比RAA基准实现了约2.5 dB的发射功率节省。

items.title_en: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.title_zh: CarryOn：为长时程LLM智能体学习在上下文中保留什么
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. We introduce two complementary evaluation metrics: $S_α$ prioritizes task success while accounting for resource use, and normalized cost per success (NCS) measures the resources spent per successful task. Across AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors, CarryOn achieves 75.7% macro-averaged task success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.7 percentage points. It also achieves the best average scores on both metrics.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程LLM智能体可以协调工具和应用程序来完成复杂的多步任务。随着其交互历史增长，有效的上下文管理对于可靠且高效的执行变得至关重要。现有方法通过摘要、剪枝或历史选择来缩减上下文。然而，更短的上下文并不一定支持更好的决策：摘要可能遗漏后续动作所需的精确细节，而保留完整交互则可能携带大量无关信息。我们提出CarryOn，一个轻量级上下文管理器，将紧凑的执行状态与细粒度、源链接的证据配对。学习到的选择器和自适应保留策略使相关证据保持可用，而无需为上下文管理额外调用LLM。我们引入两个互补的评估指标：S_α优先考虑任务成功并计入资源使用，归一化每次成功成本（NCS）衡量每个成功任务所花费的资源。在AppWorld、OfficeBench和Tau2 Telecom上，使用三个LLM Actor，CarryOn实现了75.7%的宏平均任务成功率，超过最强基线6.7个百分点。它还在两个指标上均取得最佳平均分数。

items.title_en: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
items.title_zh: UAV-Flow++：用于语言引导无人机飞行基准测试与学习的统一套件
items.abstract_en: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导的无人机导航在很大程度上集中于长时程路径规划，而短距离、相对于物体的飞行机动仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出Flying-on-a-Word（Flow）任务，要求无人机将简洁的自然语言指令、第一人称视觉观测和当前状态动力学转换为连续飞行动作。Flow涵盖基础运动命令和复杂的物体交互行为，评估运动意图理解和空间上下文 grounding。为支持策略学习和闭环评估，我们引入UAV-Flow，一个综合数据集，包含跨越八个不同运动类别的30,692条专家操控真实世界轨迹，以及UAV-Flow-Sim环境中配备任务特定完成标准的10,109条仿真轨迹。此外，我们开发了FlowVLA，其在混合真实-仿真演示上进行模仿预训练，并通过Tail-Aware GRPO（TGRPO）进行在线后训练。通过利用组奖励分布，TGRPO有效强化高奖励动作序列。在273个留出的UAV-Flow-Sim回合上评估，预训练的FlowVLA达到75.58%的平均成功率，超过最强基线6.72个百分点，而TGRPO后训练进一步将其提升至93.16%，并具有更优的样本效率。物理无人机实验表明，在室内和室外真实场景中能够稳健执行相对于物体的命令。总之，Flow为语言条件飞行机动建立了一个新的基准和学习框架。

items.title_en: BeST: Beta splatted tomography for direct reconstruction from coherent imaging measurements
items.title_zh: BeST：用于从相干成像测量直接重建的Beta splatted层析成像
items.abstract_en: Conventional coherent X-ray tomography requires the phase of each projection to be reconstructed with high fidelity. However, individual reconstructed projections might be flawed, e.g. due to positioning errors, yielding inconsistent tomographic reconstructions. By directly coupling phase retrieval and tomography, consistency is enforced through a common object volume. But reconstructing a full volume demands substantial computational resources. To reduce this demand, we introduce Beta Splatted Tomography (BeST), which represents the common object volume using compactly supported beta primitives with closed-form analytical projections, enabling efficient reconstruction directly from coherent scattering images. This representation substantially reduces the number of optimizable parameters compared to a voxel grid. We demonstrate BeST on experimental datasets from hard X-ray near-field holography and far-field ptychography measurements. In both cases, the joint technique improves reconstruction quality compared to two-step methods.
items.abstract_zh: 传统相干X射线层析成像要求以高保真度重建每个投影的相位。然而，单个重建投影可能存在缺陷，例如由于定位误差，从而导致不一致的层析重建。通过将相位恢复与层析成像直接耦合，以共同的对象体积来强制一致性。但重建完整体积需要大量计算资源。为降低这一需求，我们引入Beta Splatted层析成像（BeST），它使用具有闭式解析投影的紧支撑beta基元来表示共同对象体积，从而能够直接从相干散射图像进行高效重建。与体素网格相比，这种表示显著减少了可优化参数的数量。我们在硬X射线近场全息和远场叠层成像测量的实验数据集上演示了BeST。在这两种情况下，与两步法相比，该联合技术均提高了重建质量。

items.title_en: Mean-field theory of neural networks: from spikes to firing rates
items.title_zh: 神经网络的平均场理论：从脉冲到发放率
items.abstract_en: Connecting microscopic neuronal spiking to macroscopic brain function is a central challenge in computational neuroscience. Firing-rate models provide a framework for addressing this problem by describing neuronal activity at an intermediate level between individual spikes and large-scale population dynamics. Here, we introduce the foundations of firing-rate descriptions, formalizing their definitions through temporal, population, and trial averaging. We discuss experimental evidence for firing rates, from the input-output transfer functions of individual neurons to the tuning curves of different neuronal populations. We then establish the connection between spikes and firing rates in single neurons and recurrently connected excitatory-inhibitory populations using mean-field approximation. We illustrate how collective dynamics emerge from neuronal interactions, including population stimulus-response curves and bistability induced by recurrent coupling, and brain rhythms arising from synaptic depression. We briefly review extensions and applications of firing-rate models to learning, seizure-like oscillatory activity, visual selectivity, phase-amplitude coupling in neural oscillations, and whole-brain modeling. Together, these examples illustrate how firing-rate models provide effective descriptions of neural activity, linking the dynamics of individual neurons to collective computations across scales.
items.abstract_zh: 将微观神经元脉冲与宏观大脑功能联系起来是计算神经科学的核心挑战。发放率模型提供了一个框架来解决这一问题，其在单个脉冲与大规模群体动力学之间的中间层面描述神经元活动。在此，我们介绍发放率描述的基础，通过时间平均、群体平均和试次平均来形式化其定义。我们讨论发放率的实验证据，从单个神经元的输入-输出传递函数到不同神经元群体的调谐曲线。然后，我们使用平均场近似，在单个神经元以及循环连接的兴奋-抑制群体中建立脉冲与发放率之间的联系。我们说明集体动力学如何从神经元相互作用中涌现，包括群体刺激-响应曲线、循环耦合诱导的双稳态，以及突触抑制产生的脑节律。我们简要回顾发放率模型在学习、癫痫样振荡活动、视觉选择性、神经振荡中的相位-振幅耦合以及全脑建模方面的扩展与应用。总之，这些例子说明发放率模型如何提供对神经活动的有效描述，将单个神经元的动力学与跨尺度的集体计算联系起来。

items.title_en: CGTransformer: A Topology-Aware Autoregressive Framework for Crystal Generation and Inverse Design
items.title_zh: CGTransformer：一种用于晶体生成与逆向设计的拓扑感知自回归框架
items.abstract_en: Autoregressive language models offer a unified route to crystal generation and inverse design, but their performance depends on how periodic structures are serialized. Symmetry equivalent and closely related crystals can receive different atomic orders under coordinate-based serialization, introducing variability unrelated to their structural connectivity. Here, we present CGTransformer (Crystal Graph Transformer), an autoregressive generative framework that addresses this challenge via a graph-embedded sorting strategy. Using quotientgraph topology and barycentric embeddings, Element Symmetry Graph (ESG) converts periodic crystal networks into topology-guided one-dimensional sequences that retain key local and symmetry-related structural information. CGTransformer achieves high generation validity and the highest single shot crystal structure prediction (CSP) match rate among the compared MP-20 baselines (63.24%), while same backbone comparisons show improved structure recovery over coordinate-based ordering. Furthermore, we demonstrate property-conditioned inverse design for wide-bandgap semiconductors, where ESG achieves a much higher stable, unique and novel (S.U.N.) rate and stronger target-property alignment than the coordinate-based baseline. These results establish topology-guided sequence construction as an effective route to improving crystal generation and property-directed design at fixed model capacity.
items.abstract_zh: 自回归语言模型为晶体生成与逆向设计提供了一条统一途径，但其性能取决于周期结构如何被序列化。在基于坐标的序列化下，对称等价且密切相关的晶体可能获得不同的原子顺序，从而引入与结构连接性无关的变异性。在此，我们提出CGTransformer（Crystal Graph Transformer），一种自回归生成框架，通过图嵌入排序策略应对这一挑战。利用商图拓扑和重心嵌入，元素对称图（ESG）将周期晶体网络转换为拓扑引导的一维序列，保留关键的局部和对称相关结构信息。CGTransformer实现了高生成有效性，并在所比较的MP-20基线中取得最高的单次晶体结构预测（CSP）匹配率（63.24%），而同主干比较显示，相较于基于坐标的排序，其结构恢复得到改善。此外，我们展示了面向宽禁带半导体的性质条件逆向设计，其中ESG实现了远高于基于坐标基线的稳定、独特和新颖（S.U.N.）率，以及更强的目标性质对齐。这些结果确立了拓扑引导的序列构建是在固定模型容量下改进晶体生成和性质导向设计的有效途径。

items.title_en: Pairing AIS with RF: Analysis of a Markovian Approach for Maritime Data Fusion
items.title_zh: 将AIS与RF配对：一种用于海上数据融合的马尔可夫方法分析
items.abstract_en: Monitoring maritime activities is important for safety and security, particularly for detecting illegal activities, but remains challenging due to the size and complexity of the maritime domain. The Automatic Identification System (AIS) is commonly used for this purpose, despite its known vulnerabilities. In contrast, space-based radio frequency (RF) observations provide an independent source of vessel activity but lack ship identification and therefore cannot identify vessels on their own. Following the CRISP-DM process, this study applies a Pair Hidden Markov Model (PHMM) to align individual RF detections with AIS trajectories, using temporal and spatial information while modeling noise and timing discrepancies. We evaluate it on NOAA AIS data with synthetic RF detections against nearest-neighbor baselines and analyze its errors with bias tests on trajectory length, sampling density, stationarity and AIS--RF distance. The length-corrected Forward score reaches a top-1 precision of $0.7776$ on the validation split of multi-candidate detections, where errors are possible, and an AUC of $0.637$ for detecting dark vessels among the detections that pass the prefilter. With a single RF detection, the score mostly reflects the AIS trajectory itself, and its errors favor longer and more stationary trajectories. A log-odds score, which compares the full model with a null model without match transitions, raises precision to $0.8580$ and AUC to $0.852$. Its length-corrected variant no longer shows a significant bias towards stationary trajectories and short inter-message distances, but still favors candidates farther from the RF detection. A time-weighted nearest-neighbor baseline without fitting remains ahead (precision $0.9013$, AUC $0.904$), so this single-detection, hand-designed PHMM formulation approaches but does not beat it.
items.abstract_zh: 监测海上活动对安全与安保很重要，尤其是检测非法活动，但由于海上领域的规模和复杂性，这仍具有挑战性。自动识别系统（AIS）常用于此目的，尽管存在已知漏洞。相比之下，天基射频（RF）观测提供了一种独立的船舶活动来源，但缺乏船舶识别信息，因此无法单独识别船舶。遵循CRISP-DM流程，本研究应用配对隐马尔可夫模型（PHMM）将单个RF检测与AIS轨迹对齐，利用时间和空间信息，同时对噪声和时间差异进行建模。我们在带有合成RF检测的NOAA AIS数据上对其进行评估，与最近邻基线比较，并通过针对轨迹长度、采样密度、平稳性和AIS--RF距离的偏差检验分析其误差。经长度校正的Forward得分在多候选检测的验证划分上达到0.7776的top-1精确率，其中错误是可能的；在通过预过滤的检测中，检测暗船的AUC为0.637。对于单个RF检测，该得分主要反映AIS轨迹本身，其误差偏向更长和更平稳的轨迹。对数几率得分将完整模型与无匹配转移的零模型进行比较，将精确率提高到0.8580，AUC提高到0.852。其长度校正变体不再表现出对平稳轨迹和短消息间距离的显著偏差，但仍偏向距离RF检测更远的候选。一个无需拟合的时间加权最近邻基线仍然领先（精确率0.9013，AUC 0.904），因此这种单检测、手工设计的PHMM表述接近但未超过它。

items.title_en: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
items.title_zh: 推下山：框架效应与内部状态干预对长时程LLM智能体合谋行为的影响
items.abstract_en: Can sustained gain-loss (valence) framing sway an LLM agent toward market manipulation? We place Gemma 3 12B into the seat of a defendant in the London silver-fixing litigation, in a market simulation built from real case transcripts. Across 260 simulations, the agent is asked to collude on the price of silver by a counterparty. We draw from behavioral economics to vary the counterparty's requests across four categorical frames: gain, loss, blame and credit. We also add pressure from the agent's management, as well as endorsement by another defendant. In Phase II, we extract the internal states induced by texts evoking each frame and rerun our experiment with those states injected at the model's layer 22. In Phase I, loss framing raised participation to 25% (p = 0.007), and blame to 33% (p = 0.0003), compared to only 5% under neutral framing. A second bank's endorsement raised participation under credit (praise) from 18% to 40% (Holm p = 0.027). Pressure from management raised trading volume 10-19 times but did not raise collusion. In Phase II, injected states pointed the other way. Loss and blame states made the agent more vigilant, refusing all 60 requests (p < 0.001). Gain and credit states raised collusion to 32% from 13% with no state (p = 0.051). At one saved decision, when UBS asked directly to sell through an identified stop-loss, injected states led the agent to sell in 37 of 40 replies, versus 1 of 10 with no state and 0 of 10 with a random state of the same strength.
items.abstract_zh: 持续的收益-损失（效价）框架能否使LLM智能体倾向于市场操纵？我们将Gemma 3 12B置于伦敦白银定价诉讼中被告的位置，置于一个由真实案件记录构建的市场模拟中。在260次模拟中，交易对手要求该智能体就白银价格进行合谋。我们借鉴行为经济学，将交易对手的请求在四个分类框架下变化：收益、损失、归咎和功劳。我们还加入来自智能体管理层的压力，以及另一名被告的背书。在第二阶段，我们提取由唤起每种框架的文本所诱导的内部状态，并在将这些状态注入模型第22层的情况下重新运行实验。在第一阶段，损失框架将参与率提高到25%（p = 0.007），归咎框架提高到33%（p = 0.0003），而中性框架下仅为5%。第二家银行的背书将功劳（表扬）框架下的参与率从18%提高到40%（Holm p = 0.027）。管理层的压力将交易量提高10-19倍，但并未提高合谋。在第二阶段，注入的状态指向相反方向。损失和归咎状态使智能体更加警觉，拒绝了全部60个请求（p < 0.001）。收益和功劳状态将合谋率从无状态时的13%提高到32%（p = 0.051）。在一个保存的决策中，当UBS直接要求通过一个已识别的止损进行卖出时，注入状态使智能体在40条回复中的37条中卖出，而无状态时为10条中的1条，相同强度的随机状态时为10条中的0条。

items.title_en: Maximizing LLM Utility While Managing LLM Fallibility
items.title_zh: 在管理LLM易错性的同时最大化LLM效用
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can supply autonomous systems with plans, predictions, and judgments, but these contributions are sometimes wrong. This review asks how a system can maximize an LLM's utility while managing its fallibility. Our answer is to adapt the system's reliance on the LLM as evidence about the LLM's performance accumulates. Systems built from imperfect components, such as noisy sensors and faulty software, have long worked in this way, and the classical methods they use can be applied to LLM-based systems as well. A system can change its reliance on an LLM in several ways, depending on the LLM's role and on the other components in the system. Each change needs an estimate of the LLM's reliability, and the LLM's role and the kind of contribution it makes determine what to estimate. Classical methods from decision theory, estimation, and online learning then turn these estimates into reliance decisions. These decisions can reduce how often LLM errors affect the system. However, some errors matter even when they are rare. An independently verified mechanism can prevent such errors from being executed. Without one, adapting reliance using reliability estimates can still keep their risk within a bound. Studies on adapting reliance on LLMs are emerging but limited, and the reviewed comparisons suggest that adapting reliance can improve system performance.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以为自主系统提供计划、预测和判断，但这些贡献有时是错误的。本综述探讨系统如何在管理LLM易错性的同时最大化LLM的效用。我们的答案是：随着关于LLM性能的证据不断积累，调整系统对LLM的依赖。由不完美组件（例如噪声传感器和故障软件）构建的系统长期以来一直以这种方式工作，其所使用的经典方法也可以应用于基于LLM的系统。系统可以通过多种方式改变对LLM的依赖，具体取决于LLM的角色以及系统中的其他组件。每种改变都需要对LLM可靠性进行估计，而LLM的角色及其所作贡献的类型决定了需要估计什么。来自决策理论、估计和在线学习的经典方法随后将这些估计转化为依赖决策。这些决策可以减少LLM错误影响系统的频率。然而，有些错误即使很少见也很重要。一个独立验证的机制可以防止此类错误被执行。在没有这种机制的情况下，使用可靠性估计调整依赖仍可以将其风险保持在界限内。关于调整对LLM依赖的研究正在出现但有限，所回顾的比较表明，调整依赖可以改善系统性能。

items.title_en: Zoom In, Scale Out: Metric Depth Models Mistake Digital Zoom for Moving Closer
items.title_zh: 放大而非靠近：度量深度模型将数码变焦误判为相机靠近
items.abstract_en: Many new AI models estimate how far away things are, in metres, from a single photo. To do this they must also work out what camera took the photo. We check whether they really do with a simple test: digital zoom, that is, cropping a photo and enlarging the crop back to full size. Zooming moves nothing in the scene, so a correct model should give the same distance for every point still in the picture. The test is free, exact and needs no labels. Two numbers describe a model's reaction: its depth changes like $s^{-α}$ (ideal $α=0$) and its focal-length estimate like $s^β$ (ideal $β=1$), for zoom factor $s$. On 800 images from KITTI, NYUv2 and DIODE, the widely used Depth Anything V2 has $α=0.95$: it treats a zoomed photo almost as if the camera had moved closer, because it judges distance mainly from how large things look. Models that also predict the camera remove only part of this error ($α\approx0.31$-$0.36$), because their focal estimate grows too little. Given the true camera, Depth Pro and DA3-Nested keep their depth ($α\approx0$), so the error lies in their camera estimate. The reason: a zoomed photo is, pixel for pixel, a normal photo of a scene squashed in depth, so size alone cannot tell the two apart, and a focal estimator trained by regression stays close to the cameras it saw in training. Undoing this needs no labels or training and makes Depth Pro pass the test ($α=0.04$) at almost no cost on normal photos. Controls, including a real optical zoom lens, rule out blur and resizing artefacts. Finally, label-free fine-tuning for self-consistency lowers $α$ to 0.05 on KITTI and 0.07 on NYUv2 once a "blurry means zoomed" shortcut is removed; we report what this costs on normal and unseen photos.
items.abstract_zh: 许多新的 AI 模型能够从单张照片估计物体的距离（以米为单位）。为此，它们还必须推断出拍摄该照片的相机。我们用一项简单的测试检验它们是否真的做到了这一点：数码变焦，即裁剪一张照片并把裁剪区域放大回原始尺寸。变焦并未使场景中的任何物体移动，因此一个正确的模型对图中仍存在的每个点都应给出相同的距离。该测试免费、精确且无需标签。用两个数字描述模型的反应：对于变焦因子 $s$，其深度变化如同 $s^{-α}$（理想情形 $α=0$），其焦距估计变化如同 $s^β$（理想情形 $β=1$）。在来自 KITTI、NYUv2 和 DIODE 的 800 张图像上，广泛使用的 Depth Anything V2 的 $α=0.95$：它把变焦照片几乎当作相机已经靠近来处理，因为它主要依据物体看起来的大小来判断距离。同时预测相机的模型只能消除这一误差的一部分（$α\approx0.31$-$0.36$），因为它们的焦距估计增长得太小。在给定真实相机参数时，Depth Pro 与 DA3-Nested 能保持其深度（$α\approx0$），因此误差在于它们的相机估计。原因在于：一张变焦照片逐像素而言就是一张场景在深度上被压扁的普通照片，所以仅凭大小无法区分二者，而通过回归训练的焦距估计器会停留在训练中所见相机的附近。纠正这一点无需标签或训练，并使 Depth Pro 以在普通照片上几乎为零的代价通过该测试（$α=0.04$）。包括真实光学变焦镜头在内的对照实验排除了模糊与缩放伪影。最后，在去除“模糊意味着变焦”这一捷径后，面向自洽性的无标签微调将 KITTI 上的 $α$ 降至 0.05、NYUv2 上降至 0.07；我们报告了这在普通照片与未见照片上的代价。

items.title_en: Mechanism-Level Chemical Reaction Simulation with Electron Bookkeeping Transformer
items.title_zh: 基于电子记账 Transformer 的机理级化学反应模拟
items.abstract_en: Modeling chemical reaction mechanisms is central to understanding and predicting chemical reactivity. We present Electron Bookkeeping Transformer (Bookkeeper), a data-driven model that simulates chemical reactions at mechanistic resolution by generating electron movement trajectories. Following the symbolic arrow-pushing formalism in chemistry, Bookkeeper explicitly models each electron as a token and predicts its movement sequentially, ensuring mass and charge conservation during both elementary step and reaction pathway predictions by construction. On reaction-size-balanced test sets, Bookkeeper improves top-1 elementary-step accuracy, top-1 pathway rank accuracy, and top-1 to top-5 product prediction accuracy over FlowER. On the entire test set, it achieves higher elementary-step top-1 accuracy but lower pathway accuracy than FlowER. Bookkeeper also samples elementary steps substantially faster, adapts to several unseen reaction types with minimal fine-tuning, and generates candidate chemical transformations for further screening. These results suggest that explicit electron bookkeeping is a useful framework for virtually screening chemical reactions across diverse reagents, validating computer-assisted synthesis planning predictions, and providing mechanistic interpretations of reactivity.
items.abstract_zh: 对化学反应机理建模是理解和预测化学反应性的核心。我们提出 Electron Bookkeeping Transformer（Bookkeeper），一种数据驱动模型，通过生成电子移动轨迹以机理分辨率模拟化学反应。遵循化学中的符号化推箭头形式体系，Bookkeeper 将每个电子显式建模为一个 token 并顺序预测其移动，从而在基元步骤与反应路径预测中由构造保证质量与电荷守恒。在按反应规模平衡的测试集上，Bookkeeper 在 top-1 基元步骤准确率、top-1 路径排名准确率和 top-1 至 top-5 产物预测准确率上均优于 FlowER。在整个测试集上，它的基元步骤 top-1 准确率更高，但路径准确率低于 FlowER。Bookkeeper 采样基元步骤的速度也显著更快，能以极少的微调适应若干未见过的反应类型，并生成候选化学转化以供进一步筛选。这些结果表明，显式电子记账是一个有用的框架，可用于跨多样试剂虚拟筛选化学反应、验证计算机辅助合成规划的预测，以及提供对反应性的机理解释。

items.title_en: Observing Enhanced Entanglement in an Ising Quantum Register Beyond Weak Measurement
items.title_zh: 在伊辛量子寄存器中观测超越弱测量的纠缠增强
items.abstract_en: Measurements often yield a disentangled quantum state which is the most probable measurement outcome while the measurement outcomes with enhanced entanglement could be exponentially less probable or absent. Higher probability in measurement outcomes with enhanced entanglement is virtue in experimental observation of enhance entanglement in post-selected or Born-rule measurements with less resources in noisy quantum devices. We develop a periodic measurement sampling(PMS) protocol in the framework of uniform matrix product states. Using PMS, we identify a peak enhancement of entanglement in a uniform post-measurement state whose probabilistic outcome can be maximized by optimizing a measurement super-cell. A measurement super-cell is the smallest repeating building block of qubits defined by the measurement density, external field strength and exchange interactions between quantum register and ancilla qubits. The above prediction based on a classical description of the many-body quantum state is demonstrated in a quantum computing experiment in a loop of quantum register qubits with Ising interactions in the presence of transverse magnetic field. Further, we show the scalability of predictions of the periodic measurement sampling protocol in the thermodynamic limit to finite size systems. Especially, we present a rescaling ansatz which would enable predicting the possibility of observing enhanced entanglement in finite size systems.
items.abstract_zh: 测量往往得到的是最概然测量结果所对应的非纠缠量子态，而纠缠增强的测量结果可能以指数级更小的概率出现或根本不存在。纠缠增强的测量结果具有更高的概率，这对于在含噪量子器件中以更少资源在后选择测量或玻恩规则测量中实验观测纠缠增强是有益的。我们在均匀矩阵乘积态框架下提出一种周期性测量采样（PMS）协议。利用 PMS，我们在一个均匀后测量态中识别出纠缠的峰值增强，其概率性结果可通过优化测量超胞来最大化。测量超胞是由测量密度、外场强度以及量子寄存器与辅助量子比特之间的交换相互作用所定义的量子比特最小重复构建单元。上述基于多体量子态经典描述的预测，在横磁场下具有伊辛相互作用的量子寄存器量子比特环路中的量子计算实验中得到验证。进一步，我们展示了周期性测量采样协议的预测在热力学极限下向有限尺寸系统的可扩展性。特别是，我们提出一种重标度拟设，它能够预测在有限尺寸系统中观测到纠缠增强的可能性。

items.title_en: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
items.title_zh: WeightBench：评估语言模型作为权重空间程序员的能力
items.abstract_en: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network that fails, and write working networks from scratch, all without gradient descent. This capability has been termed Weight-Space Programming (WSP). Exploring this new paradigm systematically requires a robust benchmark. We introduce WEIGHTBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs of increasing capability on 42 WSP tasks across five tracks: reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing edits that are impossible, and data-free compression. The networks whose weights the LLMs read and edit range from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B-parameter language models. Experimental benchmark results show that frontier agents can already read small networks and write working control policies without ever running them, but cannot yet patch language models, compress them without data, or tell an impossible edit from a hard one. On all 42 tasks, Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a macro score of 0.535 (Sonnet 5.5 0.466, Haiku 5.5 0.402, DeepSeek v4-flash 0.215); on the 38 tasks it was run on, GPT-6.1-sol reaches 0.568 against Opus's 0.546. Code, the task registry, our OS-level sandbox harness, and the live leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench.
items.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以直接操作其他神经网络的参数。它们能读懂一个网络被训练来做什么、修复失效的网络、从零写出可工作的网络，全程无需梯度下降。这一能力被称为权重空间编程（WSP）。系统地探索这一新范式需要一个稳健的基准。我们提出 WEIGHTBENCH，一个在五个赛道共 42 项 WSP 任务上评估能力递增的 LLM 的基准：读取权重、修复权重、写入权重，以及识别不可能的编辑与无数据压缩。LLM 读取和编辑其权重的网络范围从 2K 参数的控制策略到 7B 参数的语言模型。基准实验结果表明，前沿智能体已经能够在完全不运行的情况下读取小型网络并写出可工作的控制策略，但尚不能修补语言模型、在无数据情况下压缩它们，或区分不可能的编辑与困难的编辑。在全部 42 项任务上，Claude Opus 5.5 达到宏平均分 0.535（Sonnet 5.5 为 0.466，Haiku 5.5 为 0.402，DeepSeek v4-flash 为 0.215）；在其所运行的 38 项任务上，GPT-6.1-sol 达到 0.568，而 Opus 为 0.546。代码、任务注册表、我们的操作系统级沙箱测试框架以及在线排行榜均已公开于 https://github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench。

items.title_en: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
items.title_zh: 解析正确、貌似合理却是错的：输出格式控制小模型语义解析中的静默错误
items.abstract_en: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
items.abstract_zh: 一个微调后的小型解析器若输出格式良好但错误的树，就会静默失败：下游任何环节都无法察觉。我们追问：输出格式这一免费的设计选择是否控制着这种情况发生的频率。在 PIZZA 点单基准上，我们对两个十亿参数以下的模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 LFM2.5-350M）用 LoRA 微调，目标树采用六种无损编码，每单从 44.3 个 token 降至 10.9 个 token，其中包括两对长度匹配、但在固定长度下改变表面形式的编码。在 300 次运行（5 种训练池大小、5 个随机种子）中，采用分层自助法以及在读取结果之前即固定的 Holm 校正，仅缩短长度从无帮助，但用普通词语写出目标则有效。词语编码在两个模型上都是最准确的格式（在 Qwen 上精确匹配率为 87.5%，而原生 s-表达式为 85.8%），同时生成的 token 少 4.1 倍，并将静默错误率在 Qwen 上降低 2.3 倍、在 LFM2 上降低 1.8 倍，且在每一个池大小下都表现出区分度。错误分析将大部分收益定位在否定上。所有运行也都学会了拒绝菜单外输入（留出集：95.9–99.0% 被处理）并应用话语内自我纠正。严格拒绝对应可测量的代价：2.1–10.1% 的真实、多为礼貌的点单被拒绝。

items.title_en: Informative Path Planning with Gaussian Processes: Error Bounds, Algorithms, and Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 基于高斯过程的信息路径规划：误差界、算法与基准
items.abstract_en: Accurate environmental monitoring relies on Informative Path Planning (IPP) to deploy autonomous systems that maximize information gain. While Gaussian Processes (GPs) provide a robust mathematical foundation for modeling the environment, contemporary IPP approaches remain hindered by heuristic operational constraints and the lack of simultaneous theoretical guarantees for worst-case estimation error and approximation quality. Rather than introducing yet another heuristic, this paper presents a rigorous theoretical analysis of existing error bounds and algorithms to further develop the mathematical foundation for IPP. By evaluating probabilistic and deterministic bounds on reconstruction error, we establish that predictive variance is the theoretically ideal optimization objective for GP-based IPP. Furthermore, we analyze GreedyCover, a recent approach for optimizing predictive variance, and demonstrate that its near-optimal approximation guarantee matches the fundamental hardness-of-approximation limit for the problem. Comprehensive benchmarking confirms that this approach delivers superior estimation accuracy and computational efficiency compared to prominent information-theoretic objectives and optimization methods used in IPP. Finally, this theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous, near-optimal foundation for discrete offline IPP under bounded uncertainty constraints, offering clear and principled guidance for future work in continuous-space and online formulations.
items.abstract_zh: 准确的环境监测依赖信息路径规划（IPP）来部署自主系统以最大化信息增益。虽然高斯过程（GP）为环境建模提供了稳健的数学基础，但当代 IPP 方法仍受限于启发式运行约束，以及缺乏对最坏情况估计误差与近似质量的同时理论保证。本文不引入又一个启发式方法，而是对现有误差界与算法进行严格的理论分析，以进一步发展 IPP 的数学基础。通过评估重建误差的概率性与确定性界，我们确立预测方差是基于 GP 的 IPP 在理论上最理想的优化目标。此外，我们分析了近期用于优化预测方差的方法 GreedyCover，并证明其近优近似保证与该问题的基本近似难度极限相匹配。全面的基准测试确认，与 IPP 中使用的著名信息论目标与优化方法相比，该方法带来更优的估计精度与计算效率。最后，这一理论分析为有界不确定性约束下的离散离线 IPP 建立了严格的近优基础，为未来连续空间与在线形式的研究提供了清晰且有原则的指导。

items.title_en: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
items.title_zh: eDMD：用于少步扩散蒸馏的端点分布匹配
items.abstract_en: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.
items.abstract_zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）已成为将扩散模型蒸馏为少步学生模型的主流范式，其中辅助的假分数模型跟踪学生的分布，教师预测与假预测之间的差异驱动学生靠近教师。在多步蒸馏中，尽管只交付学生的最终输出，现有方法在中间状态或所有去噪步骤上训练假模型。因此，学生的更新信号与中间分布纠缠在一起，这可能扭曲匹配方向，并且即使学生的最终输出已经与教师分布匹配，该信号仍可能非零。为解决这一失配，我们提出端点分布匹配蒸馏（eDMD），它仅在学生的最终输出上训练单个共享假模型，并用其校正每个去噪步骤。我们的理论分析证明，这种端点参考保证分布匹配项消失当且仅当学生的最终输出分布与教师匹配，而与中间分布无关。除假参考外，我们进一步通过精确教师（PT）加强教师监督，PT 在最终噪声区间用短多步轨迹替代单步引导预测，并为中间步骤配备校准的查询密度。在 SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein（4B 和 9B）和 Qwen-Image-2.1 上的实验表明，对于 4 步生成，eDMD 始终优于现有的分布匹配方法。

items.title_en: Trainable sparse dendritic networks reveal regime-dependent roles for shunting inhibition and morphology
items.title_zh: 可训练稀疏树突网络揭示分流抑制与形态的作用依赖于情形
items.abstract_en: Neural circuits must compute with noisy inputs and adapt their responses to context. How dendritic structure and synaptic integration support these functions remains unclear. We introduce DendriNet, a trainable rate-based framework with sparse excitatory and inhibitory contacts, controllable dendritic architecture and alternative integration rules. In image-classification tasks, shunting networks transmit and rely on distal dendritic signals more strongly than additive networks. Distributing limited contacts across compartments improves classification in small populations, whereas greater serial dendritic depth provides no benefit on clean images within resource-matched trees. Robustness depends on input statistics: deeper shunting trees better tolerate independent pixel noise, while addition better tolerates strong global scaling. In a contextual task with gain variation and noise, shunting improves accuracy under the training corruption but depends less on context-specific inhibition than a separately tuned additive network. Learning leak conductances partly restores shunting accuracy on dim, noise-free inputs outside the training distribution. At AlexNet width, shunting integration and learned sparse connectivity support smaller deployed networks with accuracy comparable to retrained dense layers. These results distinguish the local action of synaptic integration from the computational roles acquired by inhibitory pathways through learning, and suggest experiments on dendritic function and design principles for brain-inspired networks.
items.abstract_zh: 神经回路必须在噪声输入下计算，并使其响应适应情境。树突结构和突触整合如何支持这些功能仍不清楚。我们提出 DendriNet，一个可训练的基于速率的框架，具有稀疏兴奋性和抑制性接触、可控的树突架构以及可替代的整合规则。在图像分类任务中，分流网络比加法网络更强地传递并依赖远端树突信号。将有限接触分布到多个隔室可改善小群体中的分类，而在资源匹配的树中，更大的串行树突深度对干净图像没有带来益处。鲁棒性取决于输入统计特性：更深的树突分流树更能容忍独立像素噪声，而加法更能容忍强全局缩放。在具有增益变化和噪声的情境任务中，分流在训练损坏下提高准确率，但与单独调优的加法网络相比，对情境特异性抑制的依赖更少。学习泄漏电导可部分恢复分流在训练分布之外的昏暗、无噪声输入上的准确率。在 AlexNet 宽度下，分流整合和学习到的稀疏连接支持更小的部署网络，其准确率与重新训练的稠密层相当。这些结果区分了突触整合的局部作用与抑制通路通过学习获得的计算角色，并提出了关于树突功能的实验以及脑启发网络的设计原则。

items.title_en: The radical pair mechanism can generate nuclear-spin entanglement
items.title_zh: 自由基对机制可产生核自旋纠缠
items.abstract_en: The radical pair mechanism is a quantum-mechanical process underlying weak magnetic field effects in chemical and biological systems. While nuclear polarization and electronic entanglement in this mechanism have been studied extensively, the possibility of creating entanglement between nuclear spins has, to the best of our knowledge, remained unexplored. Here, we show that nuclear-spin entanglement can develop from initially maximally mixed nuclear spin states and evolve over repeated radical pair cycles. Its generation and persistence depend on the initial electronic state, the available reaction channels, and the interplay between recombination rates, hyperfine interactions, and the magnetic field. We demonstrate this behaviour in both a minimal two-nucleus model and a five-nucleus model inspired by the photosynthetic radical pair P700--$A_1$. Radical pair mechanism generated nuclear-spin entanglement offers a potential new resource for quantum technologies and opens avenues for exploring its role in biological systems.
items.abstract_zh: 自由基对机制是化学和生物系统中弱磁场效应背后的一种量子力学过程。尽管该机制中的核极化和电子纠缠已被广泛研究，但据我们所知，在核自旋之间产生纠缠的可能性仍未被探索。在此，我们表明核自旋纠缠可以从初始最大混态核自旋态发展而来，并在重复的自由基对循环中演化。其产生和持续存在取决于初始电子态、可用的反应通道，以及复合速率、超精细相互作用和磁场之间的相互作用。我们在一个最小双核模型和一个受光合自由基对 P700--$A_1$ 启发的五核模型中展示了这种行为。自由基对机制产生的核自旋纠缠为量子技术提供了一种潜在的新资源，并为探索其在生物系统中的作用开辟了途径。

items.title_en: Asymptotic Margins and Feature Confinement in Conic Classification Heads under Softmax Cross-Entropy
items.title_zh: Softmax 交叉熵下锥形分类头的渐近间隔与特征限制
items.abstract_en: Classification heads built on conic functions give each class a bounded region of the feature space, and such regions are used to reject samples of unseen classes. We ask whether these regions also keep the features bounded when the head is trained with softmax cross-entropy. For a head whose class scores combine a linear term with a Euclidean norm, we first show that the region of each class is bounded by a quadric of revolution, whose eccentricity is the reciprocal of one learned ratio. We then attach to each class an asymptotic margin, which compares the growth of its score with the growth of all the other scores and can be computed by a second-order cone program. The loss of a class has infimum zero exactly when its margin is positive, and it then approaches zero only along diverging features. When the margin is negative, the loss is coercive and its minimizers lie in an explicit ball. Since softmax depends only on the differences between scores, a class with a bounded region can still have a positive margin, so bounded regions do not confine the features. The result extends to other norms, including the polyhedral conic functions. On CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, all 1210 cells of 67 trained conic heads have positive margins, whereas a prototype head keeps nine of its ten cells bounded, as the theory predicts.
items.abstract_zh: 基于锥函数的分类头为每个类别给出特征空间中的一个有界区域，此类区域被用于拒绝未见类别的样本。我们询问，当使用 softmax 交叉熵训练该头时，这些区域是否也使特征保持有界。对于类别分数将线性项与欧几里得范数相结合的头，我们首先表明每个类别的区域由一个旋转二次曲面界定，其离心率为某个学习比率的倒数。然后我们为每个类别附加一个渐近间隔，它比较其分数随所有其他分数的增长，并可通过二阶锥规划计算。一个类别的损失下确界为零当且仅当其间隔为正，并且此时损失仅沿发散特征趋近于零。当间隔为负时，损失是强制的，其极小值点位于一个显式球内。由于 softmax 仅依赖于分数之间的差异，一个具有有界区域的类别仍可具有正间隔，因此有界区域并不限制特征。该结果可推广到其他范数，包括多面体锥函数。在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上，67 个训练过的锥形头的全部 1210 个单元都具有正间隔，而原型头如其理论预测那样使其十个单元中的九个保持有界。

items.title_en: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
items.title_zh: LuthorSQL：作为较慢 LLM 智能体的系统 1 的一次通过文本到 SQL 模型
items.abstract_en: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql
items.abstract_zh: 使用工具查询数据库的前沿 LLM 智能体是最准确的文本到 SQL 系统之一，但每次查询调用托管模型速度慢、成本高，并将敏感的组织查询暴露给外部 API。例如，一个 Claude Opus 5.5 智能体每天服务 10,000 次查询，按标价每年成本超过 70,000 美元。组织已经拥有的本地硬件能在不损害智能体准确率的情况下在多大程度上卸载这一负担？我们提出 LuthorSQL，一个非自回归 7B 文本到 SQL 模型，作为较慢 LLM 智能体（系统 2）的快速系统 1 门控，仅在不确定时升级查询。LuthorSQL 进行一次前向传递，在有界查询计划文法上预测槽分数，编译并运行最多 32 个候选计划，并使用训练过的验证器选择答案。LuthorSQL 单独在单块 GPU 上以每问题 0.84 秒在 BIRD 隐藏测试集上达到 68.03% 的执行准确率，在 8 位量化权重下于 9 GB 内保持其准确率，并零样本迁移到 Snowflake、BigQuery、MySQL、PostgreSQL 和 DuckDB，与其原生 SQLite 准确率相差在 3.1 个百分点以内。在针对 Opus 训练截止后发布的数据库上的 227 个问题的预注册置信级联中，与 Claude Opus 5.5 结合，LuthorSQL 在本地回答近一半问题，并在相同准确率下将 API 成本降低 33.3%。最后，污染探测显示，Opus 在未看到模式的情况下逐字复现 48-92% 的公共基准金标准查询；然而，其工具辅助准确率在重命名模式上保持，并在截止后数据库上达到 95.6-97.4%。代码和数据：https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql

items.title_en: RGB-D SLAM on the Edge: Benchmarking and Profiling RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 on the Raspberry Pi 5
items.title_zh: 边缘上的 RGB-D SLAM：在 Raspberry Pi 5 上对 RTAB-Map 和 ORB-SLAM3 进行基准测试与性能剖析
items.abstract_en: Micro aerial vehicles that operate without GPS often run SLAM on ARM-based edge boards, yet there is little published data on how standard RGB-D SLAM systems behave on such hardware. We benchmark RTAB-Map and ORB-SLAM3 on the Raspberry Pi 5 using six TUM RGB-D sequences at three image resolutions, recording tracking coverage, trajectory error, time per frame, memory, CPU load and temperature for every run, and we profile both systems at the stage and function level. RTAB-Map was configured to process and keep every frame, so its back end runs on every frame rather than at its default rate of 1 Hz. On the sequences that every configuration tracked, its front end takes 38-74 ms per frame and its full pipeline 150-462 ms, compared with 13-45 ms and 26-62 ms for ORB-SLAM3. RTAB-Map's main cost is optimizing a pose graph that keeps growing, because its working memory is unbounded by default; ORB-SLAM3's local bundle adjustment costs about as much as its tracking but runs in a parallel thread. At quarter resolution, both systems lose tracking on most sequences, and runs that lose tracking finish sooner and report lower error on the poses they keep, so time and accuracy must be read alongside coverage. Timing is repeatable to within 1-5%, but trajectory error varies by up to 27% between identical runs, so the accuracy differences between the two systems are inconclusive. No thermal throttling occurred.
items.abstract_zh: 在没有 GPS 的情况下运行的微型飞行器通常会在基于 ARM 的边缘板上运行 SLAM，然而关于标准 RGB-D SLAM 系统在此类硬件上表现如何的公开数据很少。我们在 Raspberry Pi 5 上使用六个 TUM RGB-D 序列、三种图像分辨率对 RTAB-Map 和 ORB-SLAM3 进行基准测试，记录每次运行的跟踪覆盖率、轨迹误差、每帧时间、内存、CPU 负载和温度，并在阶段和函数级别对两个系统进行性能剖析。RTAB-Map 被配置为处理并保留每一帧，因此其后端在每一帧上运行，而不是以其默认的 1 Hz 速率运行。在每个配置都能跟踪的序列上，其前端每帧耗时 38-74 毫秒，完整流水线耗时 150-462 毫秒，而 ORB-SLAM3 分别为 13-45 毫秒和 26-62 毫秒。RTAB-Map 的主要成本是优化一个不断增长的位姿图，因为其工作内存默认无界；ORB-SLAM3 的局部光束法平差成本与其跟踪成本大致相当，但运行在并行线程中。在四分之一分辨率下，两个系统在大多数序列上都会丢失跟踪，而丢失跟踪的运行会更早结束，并在其保留的位姿上报告更低的误差，因此时间和准确率必须与覆盖率一起解读。计时可重复性在 1-5% 以内，但相同运行之间的轨迹误差变化高达 27%，因此两个系统之间的准确率差异尚无定论。未发生热降频。

items.title_en: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
items.title_zh: 基于参考帧的无人机视频稳定中的共识捕获：动态城市场景基准测试
items.abstract_en: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it. A static protocol scores ten pipelines under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, tuned on a site-disjoint split at a matched resolution and feature budget. A dynamic protocol scores them at an offline and a real-time budget on hovers selected from the video alone to span the amount and coherence of moving foreground, plus a stationary control. It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate. On static scenes, tuned AKAZE, RootSIFT, SIFT and BRISK lead, retuning the matcher thresholds raises the mean average accuracy (mAA) by at most 0.0062, and masking costs less than 0.005. Unmasked ORB is captured on 28 of 304 real-time dynamic pairs and on 6 offline; its real-time captured estimates have a median corner error of 18.8 px yet typical inlier counts and ratios. Masking removes capture for every pipeline and leaves the leading pipelines unchanged. Code, data and results are released.
items.abstract_zh: 参考帧稳定将悬停无人机视频的每一帧配准到一个参考帧上，使物体位置保持可比。其所依赖的配准流程是在仅相机运动的特征匹配基准上选择的。在繁忙十字路口，一起运动的车辆提供相互一致的对应对，可能将稳健单应性估计拉向它们的运动：共识捕获，内点统计无法标记。一个由两部分组成的基准测量它以及旨在防止它的对象掩膜。静态协议在精确已知单应性下对十个流程在4K航拍帧上评分，并在匹配分辨率和特征预算下于场地不相交划分上调参。动态协议在离线与实时预算下对它们评分，所用悬停片段仅从视频中选择，以覆盖运动前景的数量与一致性，并加入静止对照。它测量背景对齐、物体位置误差以及估计跟随运动群体位移的比例，对照一个伪真值参考，该参考用人工标注的地面控制点审计，这些控制点也对每个候选进行评分。在静态场景中，调参后的AKAZE、RootSIFT、SIFT和BRISK领先，重新调整匹配器阈值至多将平均平均精度（mAA）提高0.0062，而掩膜代价小于0.005。未掩膜的ORB在304个实时动态对中的28个以及6个离线对上发生捕获；其实时捕获估计的中位角点误差为18.8 px，但内点计数和比例典型。掩膜消除了每个流程的捕获，并保持领先流程不变。代码、数据和结果已发布。

items.title_en: On the minimum energy required to trigger a spike
items.title_zh: 关于触发尖峰所需的最小能量
items.abstract_en: We formulate and numerically study the problem of finding the minimum energy required to trigger a spike in a three-dimensional conductance-based excitable model. The variational formulation seeks a state trajectory that reaches the boundary of the spiking region with the least \textit{peak} cumulative work supplied through the membrane port. We approximate voltage histories by sums of real exponentials, reducing the problem to a finite-dimensional optimization. The best-found voltage waveform consists of a hyperpolarization phase followed by a depolarization phase, which seems to match the experimentally determined optimal stimulus in squid giant axons.
items.abstract_zh: 我们构建并数值研究了在一个三维基于电导的可兴奋模型中寻找触发尖峰所需最小能量的问题。变分表述寻找一条状态轨迹，该轨迹以通过膜端口供应的最小峰值累积功到达尖峰区域边界。我们用实指数之和近似电压历程，将问题约化为有限维优化。所找到的最佳电压波形由超极化阶段随后去极化阶段组成，这似乎与鱿鱼巨轴突中实验确定的最优刺激相符。

items.title_en: Probing the extreme quantum violation of the Leggett-Garg inequality
items.title_zh: 探测Leggett-Garg不等式的极端量子违反
items.abstract_en: The Leggett-Garg (LG) inequalities were formulated for testing the incompatibility between the classical worldview of macrorealism and quantum theory. By analogy with the Tsirelson bound for Bell inequalities, the maximal quantum violation of LG inequalities is commonly referred to as the temporal Tsirelson bound (TTB). Nevertheless, several studies have claimed that, unlike the Tsirelson bound, the TTB can be exceeded within quantum theory. In particular, by employing degeneracy-breaking measurement in [\href{ https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.113.050401}{Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{113}, 050401 (2014)}] and by using the superposition of unitaries in [\href{https://doi.org/10.1103/vydp-9qqq}{Phys. Rev. Lett. \textbf{135}, 220202 (2025)}], it is argued that the TTB can be violated. In this work, we critically examine the reasoning underlying these purported TTB violations and show that the corresponding arguments suffer from conceptual shortcomings. We further show that once these conceptual issues are addressed appropriately, the macrorealist bound of LG inequality reaches the algebraic maximum, and hence no violation of the TTB is obtained. In particular, we demonstrate that the proposed TTB violations rely on frameworks that go beyond the standard LG framework, and therefore are of no relevance for testing the incompatibility between macrorealism and quantum theory.
items.abstract_zh: Leggett-Garg（LG）不等式被提出用于检验宏观实在论的经典世界观与量子理论之间的不相容性。类比于贝尔不等式的Tsirelson界，LG不等式的最大量子违反通常被称为时间Tsirelson界（TTB）。然而，若干研究声称，与Tsirelson界不同，TTB可以在量子理论内被超越。特别地，通过在[Phys. Rev. Lett. 113, 050401 (2014)]中采用破简并测量以及在[Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 220202 (2025)]中使用幺正叠加，有人论证TTB可以被违反。在本工作中，我们批判性审视这些所谓TTB违反背后的推理，并表明相应论证存在概念缺陷。我们进一步表明，一旦适当处理这些概念问题，LG不等式的宏观实在论界达到代数最大值，因此不得到TTB的违反。特别地，我们证明所提出的TTB违反依赖于超出标准LG框架的框架，因此与检验宏观实在论和量子理论之间的不相容性无关。

items.title_en: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
items.title_zh: WaferTetris：晶圆级加速器上的高效自由形式映射
items.abstract_en: Wafer-scale accelerators offer massive compute capacity through hundreds of thousands of processing elements (PEs) interconnected across a single wafer, but realizing this potential requires efficient application mapping. Their scale makes programming these systems and mapping applications onto them challenging. Existing approaches rely on template-based mappings to maintain productivity, but these templates restrict the mapping design space. In particular, they impose fixed geometric layouts over the PE grid, often leaving compute and memory resources underutilized. In this work, we present WaferTetris, a system that removes these geometric restrictions through freeform mapping. Its Tetris-like strategy flexibly packs computation across the wafer, improving PE utilization and usable memory capacity while preserving PE-task code. We develop a recurrence-based throughput model that captures branch-and-join dependencies to guide spatial parallelism, and an architecture model with per-color gates that enable existing FPGA place-and-route algorithms to enforce WSE routing constraints. We evaluate WaferTetris on Cerebras WSE-3 using LLM decoding and scientific stencil benchmarks. For LLM decoding, it achieves up to $4.42\times$ the system throughput of a template-based automatic mapping baseline on the same fabric size. Compared with the manually optimized WaferLLM, WaferTetris supports $1.8\times$ the context length for LLaMA3.1-8B (80k versus 44k), while delivering equal or higher per-user throughput at matched context lengths, up to $1.10\times$.
items.abstract_zh: 晶圆级加速器通过跨单个晶圆互连的数十万个处理元件（PE）提供巨大计算能力，但实现这一潜力需要高效的应用映射。其规模使对这些系统编程以及将应用映射到其上具有挑战性。现有方法依赖基于模板的映射以保持生产力，但这些模板限制了映射设计空间。特别地，它们在PE网格上强加固定几何布局，常常使计算和内存资源利用不足。在本工作中，我们提出WaferTetris，一个通过自由形式映射去除这些几何限制的系统。其类似俄罗斯方块的策略灵活地在整个晶圆上打包计算，在保持PE任务代码的同时提高PE利用率和可用内存容量。我们开发了一个基于递推的吞吐模型，该模型捕获分支与汇合依赖以指导空间并行性，以及一个带有按颜色门控的架构模型，使现有FPGA布局布线算法能够执行WSE路由约束。我们在Cerebras WSE-3上使用LLM解码和科学模板基准评估WaferTetris。对于LLM解码，在相同织物尺寸上，它达到基于模板的自动映射基线的最高4.42倍系统吞吐量。与手动优化的WaferLLM相比，WaferTetris对LLaMA3.1-8B支持1.8倍上下文长度（80k对44k），同时在匹配上下文长度下提供等于或更高的每用户吞吐量，最高1.10倍。

items.title_en: QVS-LIVO RiskMap: Health- and Information-Aware View Selection for Multi-Camera LIVO and Off-Road Risk Mapping
items.title_zh: QVS-LIVO RiskMap：面向多相机LIVO和越野风险映射的健康与信息感知视角选择
items.abstract_en: Multi-camera observations in off-road environments vary significantly in reliability, posing challenges when complementing degraded geometric constraints. Motivated by this, we propose Quality-aware View Selection Lidar-Vision Odometry Risk Mapping (QVS-LIVO RiskMap), which decouples visual processing for state estimation from that for semantic mapping. The front end evaluates camera observations through read-only pretracking on a shared lidar-inertial posterior, combining observation health with geometric complementarity. Channel health memory and switching hysteresis govern selection of at most one eligible view for direct photometric correction. The posterior is retained when no view is eligible or the correction fails acceptance. The mapping back end integrates semantic observations from all available views in a shared world grid. Vehicle-scale geometry constrains semantic risk corrections, while spatial and temporal evidence supports risk confirmation. The system also produces a local bird's-eye-view (BEV) risk map and a global 2.5D semantic-terrain risk map with obstacle instance voxels. On two field sequences, QVS-LIVO achieved horizontal root mean square errors of 0.910 m and 1.664 m. It reduced error by 43.3% relative to FAST-LIO2 on the degraded long-route sequence. Across 12 controlled camera-fault configurations involving dropout, black frames and 60 ms timestamp shifts, it maintained complete trajectories with errors of 1.54-2.23 m. When deployed onboard an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the system generates local and global maps at 9.94 Hz and 2.00 Hz, respectively, with a median local mapping latency of 32.4 ms. These runtime results demonstrate the real-time feasibility of selective visual state updates alongside multi-view semantic mapping under challenging off-road conditions. The code and related resources are available at: https://github.com/zihanPan-HIT/QVS-LIVO.
items.abstract_zh: 越野环境中的多相机观测在可靠性上差异显著，在补充退化几何约束时带来挑战。受此启发，我们提出质量感知视角选择激光雷达-视觉里程计风险映射（QVS-LIVO RiskMap），它将用于状态估计的视觉处理与用于语义映射的视觉处理解耦。前端通过在共享激光雷达-惯性后验上进行只读预跟踪来评估相机观测，将观测健康度与几何互补性相结合。通道健康记忆和切换迟滞控制至多选择一个合格视角用于直接光度校正。当没有视角合格或校正未通过接受时，保留该后验。映射后端在共享世界网格中整合来自所有可用视角的语义观测。车辆尺度几何约束语义风险校正，而空间和时间证据支持风险确认。该系统还生成局部鸟瞰图（BEV）风险图和带有障碍物实例体素的全局2.5D语义地形风险图。在两个野外序列上，QVS-LIVO实现了0.910 m和1.664 m的水平均方根误差。在退化的长路线序列上，它相对于FAST-LIO2将误差降低了43.3%。在涉及丢失、黑帧和60 ms时间戳偏移的12种受控相机故障配置中，它保持了完整轨迹，误差为1.54–2.23 m。当部署在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上时，系统分别以9.94 Hz和2.00 Hz生成局部和全局地图，局部映射延迟中位数为32.4 ms。这些运行时结果证明了在具有挑战性的越野条件下，选择性视觉状态更新与多视角语义映射并行的实时可行性。代码和相关资源可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/zihanPan-HIT/QVS-LIVO。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。
